Effective line: Ugh... Where am I? Who am I?
Suggested line: Ugh... where am I? And while I'm asking, who am I?

Effective line: I search for my name. For how I got here. But I find nothing.
Suggested line: I keep reaching for my name, or for how I got here, and there's nothing there at all.

Effective line: I try to rise, but I am weak. A low groan escapes my mouth.
Suggested line: I should get up. My legs have other ideas, and every part of me aches.

Effective line: A cold draft rises from the dark. It smells of old stone and older water. The stranger said the town is on the other side. Go in?
Suggested line: A cold draft rises out of the dark, smelling of old stone and older water. The stranger said the town lies on the other side. Go in?

Effective line: Easy. Stay down. Gather what strength you have. I can't imagine it's much after what they put you through.
Suggested line: Easy. Stay down a moment and get your breath back. After what they put you through, I'm amazed you're breathing at all.

Effective line: Keep your voice low. We are not the only ones in these woods tonight.
Suggested line: And keep your voice low. We're not the only ones in these woods tonight.

Effective line: I don't know this place. I don't know my own name. ...Who are you?
Suggested line: I don't know this place, and I don't know my own name. ...Who are you?

Effective line: A friend. That's all I can say. There isn't much time.
Suggested line: A friend. That's all I can tell you, and there isn't time for more.

Effective line: Can you still fight, still draw on the Paths? Hold out your hand.
Suggested line: Can you still draw on the Paths? Hold out your hand and let me see.

Effective line: That will have to do. The Path-ologists are hunting us.
Suggested line: Faint will have to do. The Path-ologists are already hunting us.

Effective line: That one, then. Cling to it. Hopefully you can walk the others again soon.
Suggested line: That one, then. Hold on to it. The others will come back to you, in time.

Effective line: Behind me is the Forgotten Cave. Follow it all the way through to {town}. Elder Maren will be waiting for you. Find her first.
Suggested line: The Forgotten Cave is just behind me, and it comes out at {town}. Elder Maren will be waiting for you on the other side. Find her before you do anything else.

Effective line: Hear that? They're close, but they don't know about this place. Few do.
Suggested line: Hear that? They're close, but they don't know about the cave. Hardly anyone remembers it now.

Effective line: You must escape. I'll draw them off the other way. I'll find you if I make it out.
Suggested line: Go, and don't stop for anything. I'll draw them off the other way, and when I'm clear, I'll find you. I always do.

Effective line: She's gone, and she's leading them away. By the sound of their shouting, I do not want to be caught by them.
Suggested line: She's gone, and she's taking the shouting with her. Whoever they are, I'd rather not meet them.

Effective line: The trees are too dense to pass through. To the cave.
Suggested line: The trees are packed too tight to get through. The cave it is, then.

Effective line: No point getting lost twice in one day. Back up the path to the glowing arch.
Suggested line: No point getting lost twice in one day. I'll head back up the path to the glowing arch.

Effective line: Whoever that was said help would be waiting on the other side. Whatever is inside the cave seems like a better option than those Path-ologists.
Suggested line: Whoever she was, she said help would be waiting on the other side. Whatever's in that cave, it has to be better than those Path-ologists.

Effective line: ...Hm. Woken from my slumber.
Suggested line: ...Footsteps. It has been a long time since anything woke me.

Effective line: It has been some time since anyone has walked this path.
Suggested line: No one has walked this way since the house fell silent. I have kept the door all the same.

Effective line: No matter. Only one may pass, and he is long dead.
Suggested line: Turn back. Only one may pass this door, and he is long dead.

Effective line: I shall perform my duty.
Suggested line: Then I will do what I was left here to do.

Effective line: What is that I sense in you? NO! You are not HIM!
Suggested line: ...That light in your hands. I know it. No. NO. You cannot be him. He is gone.

Effective line: Let the Paths guide you.
Suggested line: ...The door knows your hand. I do not understand it, but I will not stand against it. Pass, and let the Paths guide you.

Effective line: The light drains from the Warden's eyes.
Suggested line: The light goes out of the Warden's eyes slowly, like a lamp turned down for the night.

Effective line: Hmph... about time you showed up. {villain}'s soldiers have been out and about today.
Suggested line: Hmph. About time. {villain}'s soldiers have been up and down the road all day, and nobody has come out of that cave in ten years, so forgive me for staring.

Effective line: And look at the state of you! I said I'd help whoever she sends along, not take in a stray.
Suggested line: And look at the state of you. I told her I'd help whoever she sent along. I never said I'd take in a half-drowned stray.

Effective line: I don't love being wrapped up in this. I told her not to go through with whatever she has planned.
Suggested line: I didn't want any part of this, and I told her so. She went ahead anyway. She always does.

Effective line: But a body in that state needs a bed, and I have far too much pie. I can't just leave you out on your own, now can I?
Suggested line: But you need a bed, and I've baked far too much pie, so I can hardly leave you out here on your own, can I?

Effective line: ...I don't remember who I am, or where I am. I don't even know who rescued me.
Suggested line: I don't know who I am, or where this is. I don't even know the name of the woman who got me out.

Effective line: Hm. Well if you don't know then I'm not telling. There must be a reason she didn't give you her name. As for here, this is {town}. We solve everything here with cards. It looks like you already have a deck.
Suggested line: Hm. If she didn't give you her name, she had a reason, and I won't be the one to spoil it. As for where you are: this is {town}. We settle most things here with cards, and I see you've already got a deck.

Effective line: If you really don't remember anything, you might be here awhile. You should get acquainted with the townsfolk. Say hello to Sable, Tilly and Pip on the square, and buy a card from Sable. Then come back.
Suggested line: If your memory's really gone, you'll be here a while, so you'd best get to know people. Say hello to Sable, Tilly and Pip on the square, buy yourself a card from Sable, then come back to me.

Effective line: Beside you kneels someone hooded. They nudge you gently, then not so gently. You look up but cannot make out their face.
Suggested line: Someone in a hood is kneeling beside you, shaking your shoulder gently, then less gently. Their face stays in shadow.

Effective line: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant.
Suggested line: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant TO the Regional Merchant. The TO is load-bearing.

Effective line: Fact: the beets came in early this year. The bear has been informed. We have an understanding. I do not ask why it is here.
Suggested line: Fact: the beets came in early this year, and the bear has been informed. We have an understanding. I do not ask why it is here, and it does not ask about the beets.

Effective line: I don't know who you are, but I can't turn away someone in need. And you are definitely in need.
Suggested line: I still don't know what to make of you, dearie. But you need feeding more than you need questioning, so sit down a minute.

Effective line: You can have as much pie as you like, but don't go stealing my recipe.
Suggested line: Have as much pie as you like. Just keep your eyes off the recipe; better people than you have tried.

Effective line: I sense something within you that wasn't there before. I trust the Paths to guide you.
Suggested line: That tune's stayed with you, hasn't it? I can see it on your face. Good. Keep it somewhere safe, dearie, even when it hurts.

Effective line: Have you found answers to any of your questions? I can't deny, I am intrigued despite my better judgment.
Suggested line: Found any more answers out there? I keep telling myself it's none of my business, and I keep asking anyway.

Effective line: Somebody in the square says you have a look of the old court about you. That is no prince, I told them. That is a damp young man with good posture.
Suggested line: Somebody in the square says you've a look of the old court about you. 'That's no prince,' I told them. 'That's a damp young man with good posture.'

Effective line: And if you meet Wren in the Capital, tell her my pie is still the best thing in the kingdom. She'll argue. She'll be wrong.
Suggested line: When you find Wren in the Capital, tell her my pie is still the best thing in the kingdom. She'll argue, and she'll be wrong.

Effective line: Go on, dearie, the next zone won't free itself. At my pace, we'd have to outlive the regime.
Suggested line: Go on, dearie. The next road won't open itself, and if we left it to me, we'd be at it until the regime died of old age.

Effective line: Go on, the kingdom is waiting. The pie has less patience.
Suggested line: Go on, then. The kingdom has waited ten years for you; the pie won't wait ten minutes.

Effective line: Sit. When you are ready, the memories will come, and I will be here. With pie. Obviously.
Suggested line: Sit down. The rest of your memories will come when they're ready, and I'll be right here when they do. With pie, obviously.

Effective line: Ten years ago {kingdom} was whole. Beefcakes made the energy, Gourmands fed us, Necrocrats minded the dead, Refusemancers hauled the waste and grew the crops. Everyone complained. Everything worked.
Suggested line: Ten years ago {kingdom} was whole. Beefcakes kept the lights on, Gourmands fed us, Necrocrats minded the dead and Refusemancers turned rubbish into harvests. Everyone complained, and everything worked.

Effective line: Then {villain} took the Paths, one by one, and set his rulers over them. Every road out of town has a gatekeeper now: a bridge, a barrier, a pantry door, a wall of thorns.
Suggested line: Then {villain}, the Minister of Improvements, took the Paths one by one and set his own people over them. Now every road out of town has a gatekeeper: a bridge, a barrier, a pantry door, a wall of thorns.

Effective line: Beat a gatekeeper and its road opens. Buy cards from Sable, fix your deck at the Deck Station, and come back to me for pie. Not answers. Pie.
Suggested line: Beat a road's gatekeeper and that road opens. Before you try, buy a few cards from Sable and sort your deck at the Deck Station. Then come back to me for pie. Pie, mind. Not answers.

Effective line: The roads are waiting, dearie: the Gainlands, the Buffet, the D.N.A. and the Dump. One zone at a time.
Suggested line: Four roads out of town, dearie: the Gainlands, the Buffet, the D.N.A. and the Dump. Pick one and see it through before you start the next.

Effective line: You could still be anyone's spy. I have been wrong about people before. Once. In 1987.
Suggested line: For all I know, you're somebody's spy. I've been wrong about people before. Once, in 1987.

Effective line: Still here, dearie? {villain} would love you to sit by my fire forever. Don't give him the satisfaction. Give me back my chair.
Suggested line: Still here, dearie? {villain} would like nothing better than you sitting by my fire forever, so don't give him the satisfaction. And give me back my chair.

Effective line: The pie on the sill is cooling, dearie. Unlike you, it knows when to wait.
Suggested line: The pie on the sill needs another hour, dearie. You don't. Off you go.

Effective line: Off you go, dearie; I'll be here. I'm dependable at a speed you can barely measure.
Suggested line: Off you go, dearie. I'll be here when you get back. Tortoises are very dependable, just not quickly.

Effective line: Gate stays open. Always is. My girl's still up that road somewhere. In case.
Suggested line: Gate stays open. Always has. My girl's still up that road somewhere, and I'd hate for her to come home and find it shut.

Effective line: Hm. That road. The Capital. You want to know why nobody comes back.
Suggested line: Hm. That road goes to the Capital. You'll be wanting to know why nobody comes back from it.

Effective line: Four Paths kept that city alive. Beefcakes ran the lights, Gourmands the kitchens, Necrocrats the graveyards, Refusemancers the bins. {villain} chained all four.
Suggested line: Four Paths kept that city alive. Beefcakes ran the lights, Gourmands the kitchens, Necrocrats the graveyards, Refusemancers the bins. Then {villain} chained all four.

Effective line: You could walk in today. You would not walk far. Free the four zones: each one you free turns one service back on.
Suggested line: You could walk in today, but you wouldn't get far. Free the four zones first. Each one you free turns one of those services back on.

Effective line: Hm. Services still broken. Count them on the board by the road.
Suggested line: Hm. Services still broken up there. The board by the road keeps count, if you want to check.

Effective line: Hm, each freed zone restores a service and makes the castle less frightening. My knees remain a local problem.
Suggested line: Hm. Each zone you free turns another service back on, and the castle gets a little less frightening. My knees, sadly, are a local problem.

Effective line: Go on. Knock on that castle door. Hard. And if you see Isla... I'm still watching the road.
Suggested line: Go on, knock on that castle door, and knock hard. And if you see Isla up there... tell her I'm still watching the road.

Effective line: You start with plain neutral cards, darling: honest, dependable, dull. The Paths are where the power is. Buy some, then put them to work at the Deck Station.
Suggested line: Your deck's all plain neutral cards, darling: honest, dependable and dull. The power is in the Paths. Buy a few, then put them to work at the Deck Station.

Effective line: Where do my cards come from? The past. Next question. My prices are fair, mostly. {villain}'s taxes are not.
Suggested line: Where do my cards come from? The past, darling. Next question. My prices are fair, more or less; {villain}'s taxes on them are not.

Effective line: Ninety years ago the three of us bought one lantern between us. It never worked. Tilly's great-grandmother said: no receipt, no refund.
Suggested line: Ninety years ago the three of us went halves - well, thirds - on one lantern, and it never worked. Tilly's great-grandmother said no receipt, no refund.

Effective line: A FAULTY lantern. Four copper. With ninety years' interest, it is still four copper. We did the maths. We had time.
Suggested line: A FAULTY lantern, for four copper. We worked out ninety years' interest and it's still four copper. We had the time.

Effective line: Nobody comes in until it is refunded. Or until somebody beats us at cards. Everyone settles everything with cards round here.
Suggested line: Nobody comes in until it's refunded, or until somebody beats us at cards. That's how everything gets settled round here, living or otherwise.

Effective line: Halt. Equipment is issued on referral only. Security Protocol Two. Elder Maren does the referring.
Suggested line: Halt. Security Protocol Two. Equipment is issued on referral only, and Elder Maren does the referring.

Effective line: Elder Maren sent you. I could tell from your gait. It says 'referred'. Congratulations: your file is now thick enough to be a file.
Suggested line: Elder Maren sent you; I could tell from your gait, which now says 'referred'. Congratulations. Your file is finally thick enough to be a file.

Effective line: Before I issue gear, protocol asks for exactly one thing: win a fight. Any fight. Any win counts. I will know.
Suggested line: Before I issue gear, protocol requires exactly one thing: win a fight. Any fight counts, and I will know if you lie.

Effective line: Fact: things roam the edges of town. The outskirts, round the lanes. They are rude and they are close.
Suggested line: Fact: things roam the outskirts, on the lanes round the edge of town. They are rude, they are close, and they are not on my referral list.

Effective line: Security Protocol Four: check the outskirts. Enemies roam the edges of town. Any win counts.
Suggested line: Security Protocol Four: check the outskirts. Enemies roam the lanes round the edge of town, and any win counts.

Effective line: Press C. Click the Weapon slot on the figure. Choose the blade. Press Equip. Four steps. I have written them down for you. In my head.
Suggested line: Press C, click the Weapon slot on the figure, choose the blade and press Equip. Four steps. I have written them down for you, in my head.

Effective line: WELCOME TO THE UNDERCROFT, CHAMPION - ANNOUNCER GRAND BELLOWS, KEEPER OF THE SAND! Mind the third stair; it bites without an introduction.
Suggested line: WELCOME TO THE UNDERCROFT, CHAMPION! I AM ANNOUNCER GRAND BELLOWS, KEEPER OF THE SAND! (normal voice) Mind the third stair. It's loose, and it holds a grudge.

Effective line: Auntie Alembic. Alchemist. Do not touch anything. ...Fine. Touch that one. It likes you.
Suggested line: Auntie Alembic, dear: alchemist, and keeper of some very nervous glassware. Don't touch anything. ...Oh, fine, touch that one. It likes you.

Effective line: Bring me six essence each of two Paths, plus 100 gold, and I will brew you a card of BOTH. Random. Unpredictable. Occasionally on fire. I only take what the brew needs; the rest stays in your jars.
Suggested line: Bring me six essence each of two Paths, plus 100 gold, and I'll brew you a card of BOTH. Which card is up to the cauldron, and now and then it's on fire. I only take what the brew needs; the rest stays in your jars.

Effective line: Six essence of each of two Paths and 100 gold, dear; faith helps with the waiting. Lower your voice around the red flask - it takes things personally.
Suggested line: Six essence each of two Paths and 100 gold, dear, and the cauldron does the rest. Lower your voice near the red flask. It takes things personally.

Effective line: How it works: whenever a Path's final dungeon falls, that Path sends me its pack. Don't ask how. Lots of foil, no paperwork. The Necrocrats find it upsetting.
Suggested line: Here's how it works: whenever a Path's final dungeon falls, that Path sends me its pack. Don't ask how. There's a great deal of foil and no paperwork at all, which the Necrocrats find upsetting.

Effective line: Free a zone and I stock its pack. Until then it's just a rumour in a wrapper. Browse! Sniff, if you like. I won't judge. I sniff.
Suggested line: Free a zone and I'll stock its pack; until then it's just a rumour in a wrapper. Browse, sniff if you like. I won't judge. I sniff.

Effective line: THE CROWD! GOES! WILD! (normal voice) Please stay behind the rope. There is a rope.
Suggested line: THE CROWD! GOES! WILD! (normal voice) Could the crowd please stay behind the rope? I put up a rope.

Effective line: INTERMISSION! (normal voice) I'm having soup. THE SOUP IS WINNING.
Suggested line: INTERMISSION! (normal voice) Everybody sit down a minute. I've brought a flask of soup, and my voice needs it more than I do.

Effective line: VICTORY ON THE SAND - THE PRIZE IS YOURS! The echo would like it known that it believed in you first.
Suggested line: VICTORY ON THE SAND - THE PRIZE IS YOURS! (normal voice) Mind your head on the way up to collect it. The ceiling doesn't celebrate.

Effective line: ANOTHER WIN FOR THE BOOKS! (normal voice) Some coins for you. From the crowd. The crowd is me.
Suggested line: ANOTHER WIN FOR THE BOOKS! (normal voice) Here's a few coins from the crowd. The crowd is me, but I mean every one of them.

Effective line: PUZZLE SOLVED - THE CROWD GOES WILD! A triumph for thinking, shouted at full volume!
Suggested line: PUZZLE SOLVED - THE CROWD GOES WILD! (normal voice) Lovely bit of thinking, that. I could hear the gears turning from the booth.

Effective line: THE PUZZLE WINS THIS ROUND! (normal voice) Study the board. Try again. It's not going anywhere.
Suggested line: THE PUZZLE WINS THIS ROUND! (normal voice) Have a good long look at the board and try again. It's not going anywhere, and neither am I.

Effective line: No station yet. Walk into the town there and a cousin will wake up and rip one into the wall.
Suggested line: No station yet. Walk into that town yourself and a cousin will turn up and rip one into the nearest wall.

Effective line: Ripping out of a zone ends your visit: you arrive at full HP, and the roaming enemies there come back. Rips are free. Beefcakes charge for spotting, and spotting is also free.
Suggested line: Ripping out of a zone ends your visit: you arrive at full HP, and the roaming enemies there come back. Rips are free, and so is the spotting.

Effective line: The elevator lobby. A cousin ripped it into the wall beside the Out-Of-Order sign. It is the only thing in the building that works.
Suggested line: The elevator lobby, where a cousin ripped it into the wall beside the Out-Of-Order sign. It's the only thing in the building that works.

Effective line: A short walk from the heavy meal table. The cousin ripped it open just by the napkins.
Suggested line: A short walk from the heavy meal table. The cousin ripped it open right by the napkins, so you'll never arrive without one.

Effective line: Right by the harvest table. The Rip is slightly damp. So is everything.
Suggested line: Right by the harvest table. The Rip on duty is slightly damp, but then so is everything else out there.

Effective line: A rip into the hideout under the Capital. Do not ask how we found it. We followed the smell of Fig Sly's hot sauce through the fabric of space.
Suggested line: A rip into the hideout under the Capital. Don't ask how we found it; we followed the smell of Fig Sly's hot sauce straight through the fabric of space.

Effective line: The sky is surprisingly heavy. Do NOT skip sky day. And do not look at the seam. It is not a seam. It is a PUMP.
Suggested line: The sky is heavier than it looks, buddy, so we never skip sky day. Do not look at the seam. It's working very hard and it's shy about it.

Effective line: Reach a town and we send a cousin to rip a station there. All named Rip; around cousin four, naming became a cooldown exercise.
Suggested line: Reach a new town and we send a cousin to rip a station there. Every one of them is called Rip. Our mother found a name she liked and saw no reason to stop.

Effective line: Back for another rip, little buddy? Say where, and we will tear it right open. Rips are free.
Suggested line: Back for another rip, buddy? Say where and we'll tear it right open. Rips are free, same as always.

Effective line: Spotting is free, buddy. Hydration is a bring-your-own-water situation.
Suggested line: Spotting is free, buddy. Water, sadly, you'll have to bring yourself.

Effective line: Shhh. Keep it down, there is a Wrinkle sleeping behind the crates. Rip Tearson, Cousin #7, Rift Express. Allegedly.
Suggested line: Shhh. Keep it down, buddy, there's a Wrinkle asleep behind the crates. Rip Tearson, Cousin Number Seven, Rift Express. Allegedly.

Effective line: I was told this place did not exist, so I ripped a hole to it. Sometimes you just have to want it. And the sauce smell helped.
Suggested line: They told me this place didn't exist, so I ripped a hole to it anyway. Sometimes you just have to believe in yourself. The sauce smell helped.

Effective line: Spot this whole dimension, brother! Lift with your LEGS - lower back does not mean lower universe!
Suggested line: Spot this whole dimension, brother! Lift with your LEGS! Nobody ever tore the sky open with their lower back!

Effective line: You check for an approved way to have arrived. The memo offers none.
Suggested line: You turn the memo over, looking for an approved way to have arrived. There isn't one.

Effective line: You land in the Pantry and receive a napkin before you find your balance. Priorities are immaculate.
Suggested line: You land in the Pantry, and someone hands you a napkin before you've found your feet.

Effective line: You arrive at the Grange in a whiff of ozone, mulch and gym sock. The Express leaves a personal impression.
Suggested line: You arrive at the Grange in a whiff of ozone, mulch and gym sock, and the gym sock is definitely the Express.

Effective line: A hasty rip where you first woke up, between the trees. There is a hatch in the clearing now that nobody remembers being there. It smells like a hospital.
Suggested line: A hasty rip between the trees where you first woke up. There's a hatch south of the clearing now that nobody remembers being there, and it smells like a hospital.

Effective line: Rip Tearson, Cousin Number Eight, rift technician, tree enthusiast. This is the clearing where I found the hatch, buddy. I did not open it.
Suggested line: HNNNGH. Rip Tearson, Cousin Number Eight, rift technician and tree enthusiast. This is where I found the hatch, buddy, and no, I didn't open it.

Effective line: Say the word and I will rip you back to {town}. Or you can go down the hatch. I will hold the sky.
Suggested line: Say the word and I'll rip you back to {town}. Or, if you're going down the hatch, I'll hold the sky open till you're back up.

Effective line: Need a rip back to {town}, or are you heading down the hatch? Either way, I have been holding this sky since breakfast.
Suggested line: Back to {town}, buddy, or down the hatch? Either way, I've been holding this sky since breakfast and it's ready when you are.

Effective line: I went exploring up there, and I saw some very interesting things. The brambles south of the clearing just... let go. There is a path now, and at the end of it a hatch that was NOT there before. Little glowing roots. A smell like a hospital.
Suggested line: I went up there on my day off and saw some very interesting things. The brambles south of the clearing just... let go, and there's a path now, with a hatch at the end that was NOT there before. Glowing roots, and a hospital smell.

Effective line: Sable, Tilly and Pip, dearie, all on the square. And buy a card from Sable. You are not leaving this town with only what a cave gave you.
Suggested line: Sable, Tilly and Pip, dearie, all three on the square. And buy a card from Sable while you're there. I'll not have you facing the roads with nothing but what a cave gave you.

Effective line: Back already. Sable charmed you, Tilly was a colour, Pip measured you. That is {town}, dearie. Try leaving with the same hat.
Suggested line: Back already? Let me guess: Sable charmed you, Tilly turned a colour, and Pip measured you before you'd finished saying hello. That's {town}, dearie.

Effective line: Here: a trophy. Everybody gets one. I made it myself, so participate carefully.
Suggested line: Here, have a trophy. Everybody gets one, so don't let it go to your head. I made it myself, and the handle comes off if you wave it about.

Effective line: A deck you never chose is a deck you will lose with, says Maren. New cards first, then make the deck your own.
Suggested line: Maren says a deck you never chose is a deck you'll lose with. Open a pack for some new cards, then make the deck your own at the Deck Station.

Effective line: Now that deck of yours. A deck you never chose is a deck you will lose with.
Suggested line: Now, about that deck of yours. You didn't choose a single card in it, dearie, and a deck you never chose is a deck you'll lose with.

Effective line: New cards first. Open a pack: the Menu, top right, then Packs. Or press P, if you are the sort who presses things.
Suggested line: New cards first, so open a pack: the Menu at the top right, then Packs. Or press P, if you're the sort who presses things.

Effective line: Then the Deck Station, down Champions' Road south of the square. Swap what you like, save it to a slot, and come and tell me.
Suggested line: Then take it to the Deck Station, down Champions' Road south of the square. Swap in whatever you like, save it to a slot, and come and tell me how it went.

Effective line: No packs at all? Here, dearie. A General Pack. Slightly sat on. Cards are cards.
Suggested line: No packs at all? Here, dearie, have a General Pack. It's been sat on a little. Cards are cards, and these ones won't hold it against you.

Effective line: Open the pack first, dearie. Menu, then Packs. It will not open itself. I have asked.
Suggested line: Open the pack first, dearie: the Menu, then Packs. It won't open itself. I've asked it nicely.

Effective line: The Deck Station, dearie. Champions' Road, south of the square. Save it to a slot, or it doesn't count. I check.
Suggested line: The Deck Station is down Champions' Road, south of the square, dearie. Save it to a slot when you're done, or it doesn't count. I do check.

Effective line: Sorted and saved. Your own deck, at last. Now you may take personal offence when it loses.
Suggested line: Sorted and saved, and every card in it your own choice. Good. Now when it loses, you've nobody to blame but yourself, which is how it ought to be.

Effective line: Tilly Tonic's store room has been rattling, moaning and refusing visitors. Maren would like it to stop. So would Tilly.
Suggested line: Tilly Tonic's store room has been rattling and moaning for a week, and nobody can get in. Maren wants it sorted, and so, very much, does Tilly.

Effective line: Now, a favour. Tilly's store room, the corner house beside her shop, has been moaning for a week. Not Tilly. The room.
Suggested line: Now, a favour. Tilly's store room, the corner house beside her shop, has been moaning for a week. I don't mean Tilly, dearie. I mean the room.

Effective line: Ghosts, I expect. Petty ones: the worst kind. Nobody can get in for so much as a candle. Go and sort them out. Gently, if they let you.
Suggested line: Ghosts, I expect, and petty ones, which are the worst kind. Nobody's been able to get in for so much as a candle. Go and sort them out, gently if they'll let you.

Effective line: The store room door, beside Tilly's shop on the north side of the square. Ignore the rattling. That is just them being dramatic.
Suggested line: The store room door is beside Tilly's shop, on the north side of the square. Ignore the rattling, dearie; that's just them being dramatic.

Effective line: A refund. Ninety years of haunting, over a refund. I have had customers like that. I still have one.
Suggested line: A refund? Ninety years of moaning, all over one broken lantern. I've had customers like that. I still have a few.

Effective line: Well done, dearie. You settled the ghosts. Next, settle yourself somewhere dry.
Suggested line: Well done, dearie. You've settled the ghosts, so now go and settle yourself somewhere dry before you catch a chill.

Effective line: Maren says it is time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth issues gear, by the book: report to his smithy and win him one fight.
Suggested line: Maren says it's time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth issues gear strictly by the book: report to his smithy, then win one fight to earn it.

Effective line: Right. Time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth issues gear, at the smithy on the west side of the square.
Suggested line: Right, then. It's time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth hands out gear from his smithy, on the west side of the square.

Effective line: Bertram's smithy, west side of the square. Win him a fight, any fight, and he will stamp something. He lives to stamp something.
Suggested line: Bertram's smithy is on the west side of the square. Win him one fight, any fight at all, and he'll stamp something for you. He lives to stamp things.

Effective line: The Paths quarrel, dearie. Beefcake against Necrocrat, Gourmand against Refusemancer. Since before the roads. Possibly because of them.
Suggested line: The Paths quarrel, dearie: Beefcake against Necrocrat, Gourmand against Refusemancer. They always have. Once, they needed each other too much for it to matter.

Effective line: Evening! Old Hob. I dig. Not much call for it these ten years. Nobody's been collected, you see. Paperwork. Heh.
Suggested line: Evening! Old Hob, at your service. I dig, mostly, though there's not been much call for it these ten years. Nobody's been collected, you see. Paperwork. Heh.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's have a look for you... hm. Not for a good long while yet. Lovely! That's what I like to see.

Effective line: Mind the cairn at the end of the row. Something under it is still counting its turns. Rude to keep it waiting. Heh.
Suggested line: Mind the cairn at the end of the row. Something under it is still counting its turns, and it's rude to keep a thing like that waiting. Heh.

Effective line: Still digging. Slowly. Two particular graves, these ten years. I like to take my time with the important ones. Heh.
Suggested line: Still digging, slowly. Two particular graves, these ten years now. I like to take my time over the important ones. Heh.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's have a look for you... hm. Not for a good long while yet. Lovely! That's what I like to see.

Effective line: {villain} is gone, but Rip found something in the forest where you first woke: a hatch that was not there before. Something under it feels like yours. So does someone.
Suggested line: {villain} is gone, but Rip found something in the forest where you first woke: a hatch that wasn't there before. Whatever is down there feels like yours, and so does someone.

Effective line: Elder Maren wants you fed, kitted out and known in town. Say hello to the shopkeepers on the square and buy yourself a card. There is a trophy in it. Everyone gets the trophy.
Suggested line: Elder Maren wants you fed, kitted out and known in town. Say hello to the shopkeepers on the square and buy yourself a card. There's a trophy in it, though everyone gets the trophy.

Effective line: The kettle's on and the pie is cooling. Neither is for you. Both are for you.
Suggested line: Kettle's on and the pie's cooling. Neither's for you, dearie. Well. Both are.

Effective line: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll fix it when you know.
Suggested line: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll add a name when you've got one.

Effective line: Two typos, darling. One misprint. Such a small card, such a complicated past.
Suggested line: Two typos and a misprint, darling. Such a small card, such a complicated past.

Effective line: Fresh tonics! Tested them all this morning! I'm teal! Teal means it works!
Suggested line: Fresh tonics! I tested every one this morning, and I'm teal, so they work!

Effective line: Emergency tonic! Works on Tuesdays too! That's when I test the emergency tonic!
Suggested line: Emergency tonic! I keep inventing new emergencies just to test it on!

Effective line: Fact: bears cannot open the drawer. Nobody opens the drawer. Protocol Three.
Suggested line: Fact: bears cannot open the drawer. Neither can you. Security Protocol Three.

Effective line: Hydration. Stretching. Sorry, am I ordering again? I meant we could do them together.
Suggested line: Water, then a stretch. Sorry, was that an order? I meant we could do them together.

Effective line: Fresh bread! Flour in my whiskers again. Occupational dusting. Anyone want a roll?
Suggested line: Fresh bread! Flour in my whiskers again, but the rolls came out lovely. Want one?

Effective line: I knead a holiday. Then I knead the dough. Busy, busy badger.
Suggested line: I knead a holiday, but the dough won't hear of it. Busy, busy badger.

Effective line: The old cottage cheers at night now. From the cellar. I'm choosing to love it.
Suggested line: The old cottage cheers at night now, from the cellar. I've decided to find it lovely.

Effective line: Armed, are we. Good. Now, where to point you. Start with {zone}, dearie. It is {path} country, and so are you.
Suggested line: Armed now, are we? Good. Then it's time I pointed you somewhere. Start with {zone}, dearie. It's {path} country, and so, by the look of you, are you.

Effective line: {vendor} sells more {path} cards there than anyone in this town. Take gold. Take a bag. Take my advice, for once.
Suggested line: {vendor} sells more {path} cards out there than anyone in this town does, so take gold and a good big bag. And take my advice, for once.

Effective line: And inside {zone}, your Path stands taller. {buff}: {buff_text}
Suggested line: Inside {zone}, your Path stands a little taller. {buff}: {buff_text}

Effective line: So in {zone} the {rival} side gets the short end. {debuff}: {debuff_text} In {rival_zone}, it is your turn to suffer.
Suggested line: So in {zone}, it's the {rival} side that gets the short end. {debuff}: {debuff_text} In {rival_zone}, it's the other way round, and you're the one who suffers.

Effective line: {gatekeeper} holds the way in. Win that fight first. Then come back alive. Pie is not cheap.
Suggested line: {gatekeeper} holds the way in, and you'll have to win that fight before anything else. Then come back alive. I'll have a pie waiting, and I don't bake for people who don't come back.

Effective line: You did it. Grandmaster Flex is out. He made me stretch for forty minutes. I cried twice. Good tears.
Suggested line: You actually did it - Grandmaster Flex is out! First thing he did was make me stretch for forty minutes. I cried twice, but they were good tears. Stretchy ones.

Effective line: The bridge stays down now, but I still oil the crank every morning. Maintenance is how I say sorry.
Suggested line: The bridge stays down now, but I still oil the crank every morning. Maintenance is how I say sorry, and I've got a lot of sorry left to get through.

Effective line: Want to spar? Gently. I'll spot you. I'm a spotter. ...I'm SO glad I can say that quietly.
Suggested line: Want to spar? Gently, I mean. I'll spot you. I'm still a spotter, I just get to say it at a normal volume now, and honestly, it's a huge relief.

Effective line: Brick Bronson cracks his knuckles, grabs the crank, and lowers the bridge with one arm. Show-off.
Suggested line: Brick Bronson cracks his knuckles, takes the crank in one hand and lowers the bridge with it, making very sure you're watching.

Effective line: The planks thump down across the gorge. The Gainlands are open.
Suggested line: The planks thump down across the gorge, and the road into the Gainlands lies open.

Effective line: The bridge stays up by order of the regime and Chancellor Clench. Only iron matters! IRON! Also hydration!
Suggested line: THE BRIDGE STAYS UP BY ORDER OF CHANCELLOR CLENCH AND THE REGIME! ONLY IRON MATTERS! ...AND HYDRATION! HYDRATION ALSO MATTERS!

Effective line: YOU WANT THE CRANK? TEN REPS! NO REST! I HAVE NOT SAT DOWN SINCE SPRING! IT IS GOING GREAT!
Suggested line: YOU WANT THE CRANK? EARN IT! TEN REPS, NO REST! I HAVE NOT SAT DOWN SINCE SPRING AND I FEEL FANTASTIC!

Effective line: ...Oh no. Was I yelling? I was yelling. Sorry. That was the pre-workout talking, and it talks a lot.
Suggested line: ...Oh no. Was I yelling? I was yelling, wasn't I. I'm so sorry - that was the pre-workout talking, and it doesn't know when to stop.

Effective line: Chancellor Clench locked Grandmaster Flex in the House of Gains. People whispered the old man never broke. I didn't whisper. I yelled. Sorry again.
Suggested line: Chancellor Clench had Grandmaster Flex locked away under the House of Gains, ten years ago now. Folks still whisper that the old man never broke. I should've whispered with them instead of yelling.

Effective line: The bridge is yours, friend. Stretch before you cross. Hamstrings are friends, and friends don't let friends pull one.
Suggested line: The bridge is yours, friend. Stretch before you cross, though - a pulled hamstring is a terrible souvenir.

Effective line: HA! THE PUMP IS STILL MINE! GO HOME AND HYDRATE! THAT IS AN ORDER, NOT CONCERN!
Suggested line: HA! THE PUMP IS STILL MINE! GO HOME AND HYDRATE! THAT IS AN ORDER, NOT CONCERN! ...IT IS A LITTLE BIT CONCERN.

Effective line: COME BACK WHEN YOU CAN LIFT! THE BRIDGE STAYS UP - FINALLY, SOMETHING THAT HOLDS ITS FORM!
Suggested line: COME BACK WHEN YOU CAN LIFT! THE BRIDGE STAYS UP, AND SO DO I! NEITHER OF US IS ALLOWED TO SIT DOWN!

Effective line: The Gainlands bridge is drawn up and a very large man is guarding the crank. Get across and find out who is running the Gainlands now.
Suggested line: The bridge into the Gainlands is drawn up, and the very large man on the crank answers to the regime. Get across and find out who is running the Beefcakes now.

Effective line: The Gainlands: the Swole Station is safe, mostly because the regime forgets it exists. HP does not come back after battles - soak in the Cooldown Hot Tub or walk down to town. The House of Gains is on Leg Day Ridge.
Suggested line: The Gainlands: the Swole Station is safe, mostly because the regime forgets it exists. HP doesn't come back after battles, so soak in the Cooldown Hot Tub or walk down to town. The House of Gains is on Leg Day Ridge.

Effective line: The House of Gains looms over you, all iron-less steel and floodlights. The regime's flag snaps in the wind: a barbell with a red line through it.
Suggested line: The House of Gains looms over you, all bare stone and floodlights. Above it the regime's flag snaps in the wind: a barbell with a red line through it.

Effective line: You are already as recovered as a Beefcake gets. Go lift something. Preferably not Gary.
Suggested line: You're already as rested as a Beefcake ever gets. The tub has done all it can for you.

Effective line: "Passed out mid-rep. Happens to the best of us. Happened to me in the spring of... the spring of... well. Towel's on your tab.
Suggested line: "You passed out mid-rep, lad. Happens to the best of us. Happened to me in the spring of... the spring of... well, it was a spring. Towel's on your tab.

Effective line: Don't tell the regime. They'd only fine you for resting."
Suggested line: Just don't tell the regime you had a lie-down. They fine people for resting, and I've only got the one towel."

Effective line: You find a hidden stash. Excellent spotting technique, terrible lifting posture.
Suggested line: Behind a rock you find a hidden stash, wrapped in an old gym towel so the regime wouldn't spot it.

Effective line: Nailed the landing. Mostly, the ground nailed you.
Suggested line: You land. The ground takes most of the credit.

Effective line: You fall off the island and respawn at your last safe spot. Gravity declines your request for a spotter. (-1 HP)
Suggested line: You slip off the edge and come round at your last safe spot, bruised. Gravity has never spotted anyone in its life. (-1 HP)

Effective line: Terrible landing, though. Hold still; the view is the comfortable part."
Suggested line: Landing's a bit rough, mind. Tuck your elbows in and enjoy the view while you've got it."

Effective line: Brock is out of stock on locks. This one is always open.
Suggested line: Brock is always ready, and so is his throwing arm.

Effective line: Rita flexes both hands like she is about to open a very stubborn jar. "Delt Deck? Wild ride. I rip the portal, you walk in.
Suggested line: Rita flexes both hands like she's about to open a very stubborn jar. "Delt Deck? Easy. I rip the portal open, you walk through.

Effective line: No tools, no spells. Bare hands. Just lats."
Suggested line: No tools and no spells, just bare hands and a lot of back."

Effective line: Rita shakes her head. "No juice, no rip. Ripping takes power, and the grid is bone dry.
Suggested line: Rita shakes her head. "Can't rip a thing with the grid this dry. Portals run on power, same as everything else up here.

Effective line: Somebody needs to run the big hamster wheel up the hill. Do that, then come back."
Suggested line: Somebody has to run the big hamster wheel up the hill. Get it spinning, then come back and I'll have you through in no time."

Effective line: Tobias hefts you like a sack of oats. "Cross-country to the west meadow. Long way.
Suggested line: Tobias hefts you like a sack of oats. "West meadow, cross-country. It's a long way, so I'm putting everything into this one.

Effective line: I'll put everything into the throw. You can tell me what you thought of it when your thoughts catch up."
Suggested line: You can tell me how it was once your thoughts catch up with you."

Effective line: Tobias squints at you. "Cross-country is for Gainers only. Show me a Gym Rat card and I'll chuck you clear across the map. Coach Brutus Benchley sells them."
Suggested line: Tobias squints at you. "Cross-country chucks are for Gainers only. Show me a Gym Rat card and I'll send you clear across the Gainlands. Coach Brutus Benchley sells them."

Effective line: Shredna rolls her shoulders. "Calf Cove. Did the old yeti say hello? ...Don't tell me. I don't care. Did he, though?
Suggested line: Shredna rolls her shoulders. "Calf Cove. Did the old yeti say hello? ...No, don't tell me, I don't care. Did he, though?

Effective line: Old Man Mountain vouches for you, so Calf Cove's open. Mind the edges; the view really drops off."
Suggested line: Old Man Mountain vouches for you, so Calf Cove's open. Mind the edges out there; the view drops off very suddenly."

Effective line: Dmitri cracks his neck, slowly, both ways. "Glute Garden is a long throw. Very long.
Suggested line: Dmitri cracks his neck slowly, one way and then the other. "Glute Garden's a long throw. A very long throw.

Effective line: I need you to be aerodynamic. Try not to think about it. Thinking adds drag."
Suggested line: I need you aerodynamic, so try not to think about it. Thinking adds drag."

Effective line: Raelynn tears a seam in the air with one grunt. "Home? Home is always an option. Mind the gap. It bites."
Suggested line: Raelynn tears a seam in the air with one grunt. "Heading home? Home's always open. Mind the gap on your way through; it bites."

Effective line: Results may vary. Please wait for the shake to settle before deciding whether you have.
Suggested line: Results may vary. Please let the shake settle before you drink it, and your stomach settle after.

Effective line: Protein, powder and cards. Mostly cards. The protein is optional. The yelling is not.
Suggested line: Protein, powder and cards, but mostly cards. The protein is optional; the yelling is not.

Effective line: Professor Pump teaches: 4 questions on Beefcake knowledge. Bring your own notes. Notes are on the signs.
Suggested line: Professor Pump asks 4 questions on Beefcake knowledge. Every answer is written on a sign somewhere in the Gainlands, so read as you go.

Effective line: Run it to power the grid. No actual hamsters. The hamsters get breaks.
Suggested line: Run it to power the grid. There are no actual hamsters inside; the hamsters get breaks.

Effective line: (Chalk sold at Benchley's. Chalk is a lie.)
Suggested line: (Chalk sold at Benchley's, at a price he calls motivational.)

Effective line: The regime's stronghold. Authorized personnel only. Authorization takes thirty seconds, by order of the Minister of Efficiency.
Suggested line: The regime's stronghold. Authorized personnel only. Authorization takes exactly thirty seconds, and someone inside is timing you.

Effective line: Ask a Beefcake. They have loads. The regime takes most of it.
Suggested line: Ask any Beefcake: they've got loads of it, and the regime takes most of it.

Effective line: You hear confiscated protein powder rattle inside a walking tub. Whey out of line.
Suggested line: A walking tub of confiscated protein powder rattles past, and it does not like the look of you.

Effective line: Pure mandatory pre-workout. Zero chill. Vibrates through walls.
Suggested line: A sprite of pure mandatory pre-workout buzzes past, vibrating so hard it goes straight through a wall.

Effective line: Shh. Welcome to the Gainlands. The regime has ears. Big ones. Old Man Mountain. We Beefcakes keep the kingdom's lights on and its folks moving. Wheels, mills... and if you're in a hurry, we throw you.
Suggested line: Shh, keep it down - the regime has big ears up here. Welcome to the Gainlands. They call me Old Man Mountain. We Beefcakes keep the kingdom's lights on and its people moving... and if you're in a hurry, we throw you.

Effective line: Ten years back, {villain}'s people put Chancellor Clench in charge. Grandmaster Flex's own star pupil. They locked Flex under the House of Gains and took every weight. Every... every plate.
Suggested line: Ten years back, {villain}'s people put Chancellor Clench in charge - Grandmaster Flex's own star pupil, if you can believe it. They locked Flex under the House of Gains and took every weight. Every... every last plate.

Effective line: We haven't crumbled. Tired, mind. If you fall, I catch you. Rule one: never lift alone. Rule two: never skip leg day. Rule three... I forget. Two is plenty.
Suggested line: We're tired, but we haven't crumbled. If you fall, I'll catch you: rule one, never lift alone. Rule two, never skip leg day. Rule three is... I've forgotten rule three. Two's plenty.

Effective line: And that gate up on the overlook, past the ridge? Sealed. It opens when the kingdom is whole again, and not a day before. I asked it nicely.
Suggested line: And that gate up on the overlook, past the ridge, won't budge for anybody. It opens when the kingdom is whole again, and not a day before. I asked it nicely. Twice.

Effective line: Back for more? Good. The only bad rep is the one nobody spotted.
Suggested line: Back again? Good. The only bad rep is the one nobody was there to spot.

Effective line: Beat the regime and I'll buy the first round of shakes. The illegal flavour... ah, that's the one worth remembering.
Suggested line: You beat the regime and I'll buy the first round of shakes. Even the illegal flavour. Especially the illegal flavour... ah, I can nearly taste it.

Effective line: The old king used to come up for the Lifting Festival every summer, with his boy. Little fella tried my dumbbell and sat down hard on his royal behind.
Suggested line: The old king came up for the Lifting Festival every summer, and he brought his boy. The little fella tried my dumbbell once and sat down very hard on his royal behind.

Effective line: Laughed about it, too. Four colours in his hands, plain as day. You've got a look about you... never mind. Old man talk. Where was I.
Suggested line: He laughed about it, too, and his hands lit up four colours, plain as day. You've a look of him, you know... no, never mind me. Old man talk. Where was I?

Effective line: That gate up on the overlook? Sealed. Opens when the kingdom is whole again. Not a day before. I asked it nicely.
Suggested line: That gate up on the overlook is still sealed. It opens when the kingdom is whole again, and not a day before. I check on it most mornings, just in case.

Effective line: Foreman Gus: wheels turning, grid humming, hamsters... *volunteers*... fed. Pre-workout's in the water, but so far I'm only feeling the water.
Suggested line: Foreman Gus. I keep the wheels turning, the grid humming and the hamsters - sorry, the volunteers - fed. They put pre-workout in the water. So far I'm mostly feeling the water.

Effective line: The regime wants a hundred and ten percent. The wheels go to a hundred. The extra ten is me, crying quietly.
Suggested line: The regime wants a hundred and ten percent. The wheels only go to a hundred. The extra ten comes out of the crew, and nobody writes down where it went.

Effective line: They want the same out of the city wheels up in the Capital. Those crews get told it's cardio. It isn't.
Suggested line: The crews on the city wheels up in the Capital have it worse. They're told it's cardio, for their own good. It's neither.

Effective line: Grid still humming? If it goes quiet, somebody's resting, and the regime writes that down as a personal insult.
Suggested line: Grid's still humming. If it ever goes quiet, it means somebody sat down, and the regime takes that very personally.

Effective line: LET'S GO! NEW RECRUIT! Coach Brutus Benchley! Retired champion, current motivator, part-time merchant! Protein, powder, pasteboard! Supplements for your DECK!
Suggested line: LET'S GO! A NEW RECRUIT! Coach Brutus Benchley - retired champion, current motivator, part-time merchant! Protein, powder and pasteboard! SUPPLEMENTS FOR YOUR DECK!

Effective line: *whispering* Mind the loose floorboard behind the counter. Nothing under it... just iron, which officially isn't anything.
Suggested line: *whispering* Mind the loose floorboard behind the counter. There's nothing under it. Just some iron, which officially doesn't exist.

Effective line: LET'S GO, RETURNING CUSTOMER! The cards are pumped and my whistle has been SAVING ITS BREATH!
Suggested line: LET'S GO, RETURNING CUSTOMER! The cards are pumped and my whistle's been SAVING ITS BREATH for you!

Effective line: Aha, a student! Professor Pump, Beefcake scholar, lecturing from this very log. I have written seventeen books.
Suggested line: Aha, a student! I'm Professor Pump, Beefcake scholar, and I lecture from this very log. I've written seventeen books, you know.

Effective line: Fifteen concern biceps. The other two were a history of the Lifting Festival; the regime burned those, so I rewrote them from memory. You cannot confiscate a well-trained brain-cep.
Suggested line: Fifteen of them concern the biceps. The other two were a history of the Lifting Festival, and when the regime burned those, I rewrote them from memory. You can't confiscate a well-trained brain-cep.

Effective line: Back for another set of questions? Splendid - knowledge gains are retained even when you stop flexing.
Suggested line: Back for another set of questions? Splendid! Knowledge gains stay with you, even on your rest days.

Effective line: Zero, with no reward this time. A clean baseline; research begins somewhere.
Suggested line: Zero, I'm afraid, and no reward this time. Still, it's a clean baseline, and all research has to begin somewhere.

Effective line: Consult the signs before your next attempt. Your eyes may do the heavy reading.
Suggested line: Do read the signs before your next attempt. Let your eyes do the heavy lifting for once.

Effective line: One. A muscle twitch of knowledge. Take this pat on the back. It's a small one.
Suggested line: One. A twitch of knowledge, at least. Take this small pat on the back.

Effective line: Two. Half-credit, graded on a bicep curve. In the Gainlands half a rep still counts. Just not for much.
Suggested line: Two. Half-credit, graded on a bicep curve. In the Gainlands half a rep still counts, just not for very much.

Effective line: FOUR! A perfect set! You may now call yourself a Certified Gainer, Class A. The reward is real. The certificate is imaginary.
Suggested line: FOUR! A perfect set! You may now call yourself a Certified Gainer, Class A. The reward is real; the certificate, sadly, is imaginary.

Effective line: Another lap! The Gainlands pay a little less for repeat attendance. The regime calls it a "processing fee". A D.N.A. phrase, I suspect.
Suggested line: Another lap! The Gainlands pay a little less for repeat attendance. The regime calls it a 'processing fee', which sounds suspiciously like the D.N.A. to me.

Effective line: Not a pass yet; read the signs around the Gainlands and return. We are training recall, not regret.
Suggested line: Not a pass yet, I'm afraid. Read the signs around the Gainlands and come back. We're training recall here, not regret.

Effective line: The regime banned my show for 'unauthorized fun'! These cameras are STILL ROLLING - you can't spell resistance without... well, SPANDEX HELPS!
Suggested line: The regime banned my show for 'unauthorized fun'! But these cameras are STILL ROLLING, because you can't confiscate a man's ENTHUSIASM! They tried! It came back!

Effective line: REHYDRATE AND TRY AGAIN! The beat and the legwarmers are standing by - only one of those has legs!
Suggested line: REHYDRATE AND TRY AGAIN! The beat is standing by! The legwarmers are standing by! I am STANDING BY, and my calves are SO ready!

Effective line: Mmmph! Oh good, a spotter! Hi. Gary. Lovely to meet you.
Suggested line: Mmmph! Oh, thank goodness, a spotter! Hi, I'm Gary. Lovely to meet you. Sorry I can't shake hands.

Effective line: I've been under this barbell since lunch... possibly since the regime took over. No rush, but I would like to become a standing appointment.
Suggested line: I've been under this barbell since lunch. Possibly since the regime took over - it's hard to tell from down here. No rush. Bit of a rush.

Effective line: It's the last barbell they didn't confiscate. I loaded one more plate than my confidence.
Suggested line: It's the last barbell they didn't confiscate, so I got excited and loaded one more plate than my confidence.

Effective line: It's fine. It's FINE. Could you give it a little push? Bit of a rush, actually.
Suggested line: It's fine. It's FINE. Could you give it a little push? Whenever you're ready. Now would be good.

Effective line: Gym's open! The weights are not. The scales stayed, though - standard measures, from the Capital. Say what you like, they never lie.
Suggested line: Gym's open! The weights aren't. The scales stayed, though - standard measures, sent up from the Capital. Say what you like about the Minister, those scales never lie.

Effective line: Towels are ten gold now. Clench taxes sweat.
Suggested line: Towels are ten gold now, because Clench taxes sweat.

Effective line: "You're a hero! Take this. I borrowed it from the gym.
Suggested line: "You're a hero! Take this, I borrowed it from the gym.

Effective line: It's not mine. It's yours now. That's how borrowing works, I think."
Suggested line: It's not mine, so now it's yours. I think that's how borrowing works."

Effective line: You jump into the Colossal Hamster Wheel and run. And run. The grid hums, the lights across the Gainlands brighten, and somewhere a portal ripper rolls up her sleeves.
Suggested line: You jump into the Colossal Hamster Wheel and run until your legs burn. The grid hums, lights brighten across the Gainlands, and somewhere a portal ripper rolls up her sleeves.

Effective line: The wheel is already spinning happily. Let it coast. You deserve a snack.
Suggested line: The wheel's still spinning happily on its own. Let it coast; you've earned a snack.

Effective line: You taste a legendary chocolate-peanut-butter shake. Even your muscles want the recipe - big recovery!
Suggested line: A legendary chocolate-peanut-butter shake. Even your muscles want the recipe. Big recovery!

Effective line: You hit a double biceps. The mirror gasps. You gasp. +1 HP.
Suggested line: You hit a double biceps, and you and the mirror gasp at the same moment. +1 HP.

Effective line: Your pump has peaked; come back after your next visit. Even your reflection needs a cooldown.
Suggested line: Your pump has peaked for this visit; come back next time. Even your reflection needs a cooldown.

Effective line: You flex, the mirror flexes back, nothing to heal. Looking great regardless.
Suggested line: You flex, the mirror flexes back, and there's nothing left to heal. You look great regardless.

Effective line: Lights flicker while the regime pipes every watt to the House of Gains. Run the Colossal Hamster Wheel up the hill for us - a little resistance.
Suggested line: The lights keep flickering because the regime pipes every watt up to the House of Gains. Run the Colossal Hamster Wheel up the hill and we'll keep a little for ourselves. Call it quiet resistance.

Effective line: Then buy a shake at the protein stand in the Swole Station for crew morale. Quiet gains - the revolution comes with a straw.
Suggested line: Then buy a shake at the protein stand in the Swole Station. It's for crew morale. Mostly mine.

Effective line: Run the Colossal Hamster Wheel up the hill, then buy a shake at the protein stand in the Swole Station. Quiet gains - tell me when you're done.
Suggested line: Run the Colossal Hamster Wheel up the hill, then buy a shake at the protein stand in the Swole Station. Come and find me when you're done.

Effective line: The Swole Station's lights are back on. Grid's humming. I'd make a speech, but all my energy went into the lights. Take your reward.
Suggested line: The Swole Station's lights are back on and the grid's humming. I'd make a speech, but all my energy went into the lights. Here, take your reward.

Effective line: The grid's running smooth, and some of it's even staying here. I'd hug you, but I'm a foreman. We nod. ...That was a big nod.
Suggested line: The grid's running smooth, and some of the power's even staying here for once. I'd hug you, but I'm a foreman, so I'll nod. ...That was a big nod, for me.

Effective line: Which brings me to rule one. Gary's under a barbell again. Go and spot him; follow the groaning. Then check your form at a Flex Mirror. The regime can't confiscate a reflection. They tried.
Suggested line: Which brings me back to rule one. Gary's stuck under a barbell again - follow the groaning and give him a spot. Then check your form at a Flex Mirror. The regime tried confiscating reflections once. It didn't take.

Effective line: Do both and I'll have Shredna rip you a portal to Calf Cove. Nobody's been out there in months. The calves are... unreal.
Suggested line: Do both and I'll have Shredna rip you a portal out to Calf Cove. Nobody's been out there in months, and the calves... well, you'll see.

Effective line: You spotted Gary AND checked your form? Beautiful. Here, a Pre-Workout Jitters. On the house.
Suggested line: You spotted Gary and checked your form? Beautiful. Here, have a Pre-Workout Jitters, on the house.

Effective line: Calf Cove is yours. Mind the edge. Always mind the edge. I didn't, once, back in... never mind.
Suggested line: Calf Cove's yours now. Mind the edge out there - always mind the edge. I didn't, once, back in the spring of... never mind.

Effective line: Regime brutes, golems and sprites keep eating my deliveries! Beat any three roaming enemies in the Gainlands in card duels! THOSE SHAKES HAD MY NAME ON THEM!
Suggested line: Regime brutes, golems and sprites keep EATING my deliveries! Beat any three roaming enemies in the Gainlands in card duels! THOSE SHAKES HAD MY NAME ON THEM! I WRITE IT ON EVERY LID!

Effective line: THREE DOWN! Deliveries back on schedule! Here's a Leg Day for your trouble. Do NOT skip it. That's not a joke. That's the card.
Suggested line: THREE DOWN! Deliveries are BACK ON SCHEDULE! Here, take a Leg Day for your trouble, and do NOT skip it, champ! I mean that as a coach AND as a card dealer!

Effective line: Every machine hums at exactly the right wattage. The lift hums. The gate hums.
Suggested line: Every machine settles at exactly the right wattage, and the Lift, the Gate and the Mill all hum together.

Effective line: The mill hums. Somewhere, a hamster sighs in relief. A small, heavy parcel drops into the tray.
Suggested line: Somewhere a hamster sighs with relief, and a small, heavy parcel drops into the tray.

Effective line: Just measuring. Lovely broad shoulders round here. Very roomy work, when it comes. It hasn't, lately. Heh.
Suggested line: Just measuring, don't mind me. Lovely broad shoulders up here - very roomy work, when it comes. Not that it's come lately. Heh.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's see, you're... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.

Effective line: Shirt number two hundred and twelve. Very proud of it. Notice my form?
Suggested line: HNNNGH. Two hundred and twelfth shirt this year. Did you notice my form, buddy?

Effective line: You beat Primm. The kingdom's whole again. Which means the gate on the overlook can open. Mount Swolympus.
Suggested line: You beat {villain}, and the kingdom's whole again. Which means that gate on the overlook can finally open... Mount Swolympus. I never thought I'd live to see it.

Effective line: Only the worthy reach the top. In my experience the worthy bring water. Or a protein shake. Get me one from the stand and the gate's yours.
Suggested line: Only the worthy reach the top, mind. In my experience the worthy bring water, or a protein shake. Fetch me one from the stand and the gate's yours.

Effective line: A shake from the stand in the Station. Any flavour. Not the illegal one. ...Fine. The illegal one.
Suggested line: A shake from the stand in the Station, any flavour. Not the illegal one. ...Oh, go on, then. The illegal one.

Effective line: Ahh. Worthy. Definitely worthy. Slightly lumpy.
Suggested line: Ahh. Worthy. Very worthy. A bit lumpy, but worthy.

Effective line: The gate's open and the ridge is fixed. Mostly. Climb to the top and say hello to the Ancient Spotter. He's held that bar for a thousand years. Ask about his back.
Suggested line: The gate's open and the ridge path is mended, mostly. Climb to the top and say hello to the Ancient Spotter - he's held that bar for a thousand years. Ask him about his back.

Effective line: The Spotter's waiting at the summit. Don't make him wait another thousand years.
Suggested line: The Spotter's waiting at the summit. Don't keep him waiting another thousand years, lad.

Effective line: 'Nobody. Skips. Leg day.' He presses another rep. 'In my cave. Show me yours. No standing ovation required.'
Suggested line: 'Nobody. Skips. Leg day.' He presses another rep. 'Not in my cave. Prove it. I won't get up.'

Effective line: The gates swing open on a hall lined with posters of Chancellor Clench. There are no weights anywhere. Not a dumbbell.
Suggested line: The gates swing open on a hall papered with posters of Chancellor Clench, and there isn't a single weight anywhere in it, not even a dumbbell.

Effective line: Not a kettlebell. Not a single decorative plate.
Suggested line: Every rack along the walls stands empty, right down to the little pegs where the decorative plates used to hang.

Effective line: Somewhere beneath your feet, something is not quite silent. It is breathing. Slowly. On purpose.
Suggested line: Somewhere far beneath your feet, something is breathing, slow and even, as if it has been counting every breath for a very long time.

Effective line: Iron-less steel, floodlights, and a banner reading MANDATORY CARDIO. Nobody has ever left through here.
Suggested line: Bare steel and floodlights under a banner reading MANDATORY CARDIO. Iron is banned here, and nobody has ever left through these gates.

Effective line: An enforcer searches your bag for weights while a clerk clicks a stopwatch. Minister Quota wants every search done in thirty seconds. He is at forty.
Suggested line: An enforcer searches your bag for weights while a clerk times him with a stopwatch. Minister Quota wants every search done in thirty seconds, and he's already at forty.

Effective line: The prisoners are very quiet. The guards are very loud. Only one of these is a problem.
Suggested line: The prisoners keep very quiet and the guards are very loud, and it doesn't take long to work out which of them is afraid.

Effective line: The warden has never once lifted a weight. He has never needed to. He is very, very angry. (Elite)
Suggested line: The warden has never lifted a weight in his life, has never needed to, and is furious with everyone who has. (Elite)

Effective line: At the bottom of the prison: one cell, one prisoner, one very long breath.
Suggested line: At the very bottom of the prison there is a single cell, and from inside it comes one long, slow breath.

Effective line: The warden drops his keyring. At the end of the corridor, behind a door with no handle, someone is doing a very slow, very controlled push-up.
Suggested line: The warden's keyring clatters to the floor. At the end of the corridor, behind a door with no handle, someone is doing a push-up so slow and controlled it seems to take a full minute.

Effective line: Rows of lockers hold the old champions' gear, every strap labelled by weight class. A laminated sign reads LOCKER 13 IS A STATE OF MIND. One door hangs ajar, humming a training-montage tune to itself.
Suggested line: Rows of lockers hold the old champions' gear, every strap labelled by weight class. A laminated sign reads LOCKER 13 IS A STATE OF MIND. One door hangs ajar, and something inside is humming a marching tune to itself.

Effective line: It smells of victory, eucalyptus and somebody else's victory. It is also warm. You feel sturdier and very slightly watched.
Suggested line: The towel is still warm and smells of eucalyptus and somebody else's victory. You feel sturdier with it round your neck, and very slightly watched.

Effective line: Protein bars, a roll of gold and a note: 'Spotter knows.' Somewhere a whistle blows. You keep the gold and the shame.
Suggested line: Inside are protein bars, a roll of gold and a note that says 'Spotter knows.' Somewhere down the hall a whistle blows, and you leave with the gold and a guilty conscience.

Effective line: He miscounts your reps on purpose, to be encouraging. You leave taller, if not stronger, and he presses a Gym Bro's number into your hand.
Suggested line: The ghost miscounts your reps on purpose, always upward, to be encouraging. You walk away standing taller, if not stronger, and he presses a Gym Bro's number into your hand.

Effective line: A barricade of stacked weight plates, painted regulation red. Behind it, a ferret in a pinstriped suit is timing a guard's push-ups with a silver stopwatch.
Suggested line: Someone has built a barricade out of weight plates painted regulation red. Behind it, a ferret in a pinstriped suit is timing a guard's push-ups with a silver stopwatch.

Effective line: Forty-one. Forty-two. Stop. Eleven percent slower than yesterday. We will discuss it at your review.
Suggested line: Forty-one, forty-two, and stop. Eleven percent slower than yesterday, which we will discuss at your review.

Effective line: And you. You walked in at a pace of seven out of ten. Disappointing. But measurable.
Suggested line: And you walked in at a pace of seven out of ten. Disappointing, but at least it's measurable.

Effective line: Hold still. I'm measuring you. Grip: low. Stride: uneven. Resolve... unusually high. That is an inefficiency. Let's remove it.
Suggested line: Hold still while I measure you. Grip, low. Stride, uneven. Resolve... unusually high, and that is an inefficiency I intend to remove.

Effective line: I will note it. I note everything. The Chancellor will not enjoy this figure.
Suggested line: I'll note it, the way I note everything. The Chancellor is not going to enjoy this figure.

Effective line: You face Chancellor Clench's personal guard. Their uniforms are pressed; their technique could use ironing out. (Elite)
Suggested line: You face Chancellor Clench's personal guard, whose uniforms are pressed to perfection and whose technique is mostly shouting. (Elite)

Effective line: Trophies of every leader the regime ever overthrew. There is an empty one for Grandmaster Flex.
Suggested line: The regime keeps a trophy for every leader it ever overthrew, and one pedestal stands empty, waiting for Grandmaster Flex.

Effective line: Careful, son. The guards time their rounds by their squats.
Suggested line: Quietly, son. The guards time their rounds by counting their squats, and they lose count.

Effective line: Their squats are not regular, so neither are the rounds. Listen for the knees on the stairs.
Suggested line: So the rounds come whenever they come. Listen for knees cracking on the stairs, and you'll hear them in good time.

Effective line: You're Grandmaster Flex? You're... smaller than the posters.
Suggested line: You're Grandmaster Flex? Everyone up there talks about you as if you were twice this size.

Effective line: Ten years in the dark does that. They took the plates, the protein, the pump. I had nothing.
Suggested line: Ten years in the dark will do that. They took my plates, my protein, every bar I ever lifted, and left me with nothing at all.

Effective line: So I had everything. My breath. My body. My mind.
Suggested line: And nothing, it turns out, is a fine place to start. I still had my breath, my body and my mind, so I trained them every day.

Effective line: Come, son. We will climb out together. And I would like a word with Clench. He was the best student I ever had.
Suggested line: Come, son, we'll climb out together. I'd like a word with Clench on the way. He was the best student I ever had. He still is.

Effective line: "Breathe in. Hold. Breathe out," says Grandmaster Flex.
Suggested line: "Breathe in slowly and hold it. Now let it all go," says Grandmaster Flex, breathing along with you.

Effective line: This trophy is reserved. For the Chancellor. For anyone but you.
Suggested line: Reserves, off your pedestal! This trophy belongs to the Chancellor, not to some stranger off the wheels!

Effective line: Chancellor Clench stands before an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains. It is his.
Suggested line: Chancellor Clench stands in front of an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains, and he guards it like a throne.

Effective line: "Master." The word sticks in his throat. "I was your best, you know. Your star pupil."
Suggested line: "Master." The word sticks in his throat. "I was your best, you know - your star pupil."

Effective line: "You said I would go further than you ever did. Then you said strength lived in the heart and the head. I knew better."
Suggested line: "You told me I'd go further than you ever did. Then you started on about strength living in the heart and the head, and I knew better."

Effective line: "I took your iron, your protein, your followers. You have come back with nothing, Master."
Suggested line: "I took your iron, your protein and your followers, and you've climbed back up here with nothing, Master."

Effective line: "Look how far I went, Master. What do you think you can do?"
Suggested line: "Look how far I went, Master. What exactly do you think you can do about it now?"

Effective line: Strength is control. Control is paperwork. Paperwork is HEAVY. Two more plates!
Suggested line: Control is strength, paperwork is control, and do you know how HEAVY paperwork gets? Two more plates!

Effective line: The regime's throne room is a gym with a single throne-shaped bench press. It is the only barbell in the House.
Suggested line: The regime's throne room is a gym with one throne-shaped bench press in it, the only barbell left in the House.

Effective line: "Nobody goes down," he says. "Unless."
Suggested line: "Nobody goes down," he says. Then, after a long and meaningful pause: "Unless..."

Effective line: You win the wrestle. He wins the first three rounds of it. The way down is open, and so is your lip.
Suggested line: You win the wrestle, though he wins the first three rounds of it. The way down is open, and so is your lip.

Effective line: He will guard it with his life until you leave. Then it is yours again.
Suggested line: He'll guard it with his life until you leave the House, and then it's yours again.

Effective line: You see no bar or bench, only stone worn smooth by ten years of training. Your chest tightens at the sight of the cell; you do not know why.
Suggested line: There's no bar or bench in the cell, only stone worn smooth by ten years of training. Something about the bare walls tightens your chest, and you couldn't say why.

Effective line: The lock gives. Grandmaster Flex rises, slowly, unsteadily, and bows. He is so thin you could count his ribs.
Suggested line: The lock gives. Grandmaster Flex rises slowly, a little unsteady on his feet, and bows to you. He is so thin you could count his ribs.

Effective line: You read the plate on the empty pedestal: GRANDMASTER FLEX (PENDING). It has been dusted. Recently.
Suggested line: The plate on the empty pedestal reads GRANDMASTER FLEX (PENDING), and someone has dusted it very recently.

Effective line: Medals jingle. Grandmaster Flex winces. "They are not ours to take.
Suggested line: The medals jingle as you scoop them up, and Grandmaster Flex winces. "They are not ours to take, son."

Effective line: Still. The regime owes this house a debt, and gold settles debts." You feel a little guilty, and a little richer.
Suggested line: "Still, the regime owes this house a great deal, and gold settles debts." You feel a little guilty, and a little richer.

Effective line: Some things are not for taking. Grandmaster Flex nods once, slowly, in approval.
Suggested line: You leave the hall exactly as you found it, and Grandmaster Flex gives you one slow nod of approval.

Effective line: You bring that... that stick of a man into my house? Look at him, Master. Ten years on bread and water.
Suggested line: You brought that... that stick of a man into MY house? Look at you, Master. Ten years on bread and water, and you still won't stay down.

Effective line: Hold my coat.
Suggested line: Stand back a little, son. It has been a long time, and I would like some room.

Effective line: You only ever took the weight. I taught you the heart, and you stopped listening before I got to the mind.
Suggested line: You only ever wanted the weight, my boy. I was teaching you the heart, and you stopped listening before I ever got to the mind.

Effective line: ...What. How. Where were you HIDING all of that?
Suggested line: ...How? Ten years in a hole with nothing - where were you HIDING all of that?

Effective line: True strength is not the ability to lift heavy things. It comes from the heart, and from the mind.
Suggested line: Strength was never about how heavy a thing is, Clench. It lives in the heart and the mind, and nobody can lock those in a cell.

Effective line: The heavy things were only ever practice. Now, my boy. Shall we?
Suggested line: The heavy things were only ever practice, my boy. Now, shall we?

Effective line: Chancellor Clench stands before an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains. It is his.
Suggested line: Chancellor Clench stands in front of an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains, and he guards it like a throne.

Effective line: Flex does not gloat. He kneels beside his fallen pupil and offers a hand. "You hated yourself for needing the iron, my boy.
Suggested line: Flex doesn't gloat. He kneels beside his fallen pupil and offers him a hand. "You hated yourself for needing the iron, my boy.

Effective line: You watch Grandmaster Flex enter the throne room in his prison rags. No one speaks.
Suggested line: Grandmaster Flex walks into the throne room in his prison rags, and the whole hall falls silent.

Effective line: You hear him breathe in, slow and even. Ten years without iron have left him thin.
Suggested line: He breathes in, slow and even. Ten years without iron have worn him thin as wire, but he stands perfectly straight.
