Effective line: Before you, the ruler of the House of Gains takes one step back.
Suggested line: Across the room, the ruler of the House of Gains takes one step back.

Effective line: The weights are back! I cried. Then I did a set. Then I cried again.
Suggested line: The weights are back! I cried, then I did a set, and then I cried all over again.

Effective line: Ask a Beefcake. They have loads. And now they keep it.
Suggested line: Ask any Beefcake. They have loads of it, and now they get to keep some.

Effective line: Back under the old management. The old management is still jacked.
Suggested line: Back under the old management. The old management can still bench a hay cart.

Effective line: YOU DID IT. Flex is out, Clench is down, and I got to watch. Best day since... since the last best day. I'm spotting you from now on, like it or not.
Suggested line: You did it! Flex is out, Clench is down, and I got to watch the whole thing. Best day since... oh, since the last best day, whenever that was. I'm spotting you from now on, like it or not.

Effective line: The weights are back in the gym. There's Gary, lifting. With a spotter. Beautiful. Before you go... that boy I told you about, the old king's son, at the Festival.
Suggested line: Weights back in the gym, and there's Gary, lifting with a proper spotter. Beautiful. Before you go... that boy I told you about, the old king's son, at the Festival...

Effective line: When you lifted that last regime brute, you made the same face he did. Exactly the same face.
Suggested line: When you heaved that last regime brute off his feet, you made the same face he made on my dumbbell. The very same face. Funny, the things you remember.

Effective line: Free, strong and spotted. Thank you, friend. I climbed Swolympus once, you know. These ten years were steeper.
Suggested line: Free, strong and properly spotted, all of us. Thank you, friend. I climbed Swolympus once, you know, and these ten years were steeper.

Effective line: That gate up on the overlook? Sealed. Opens when the kingdom is whole again. Not a day before. I asked it nicely.
Suggested line: That gate up on the overlook is still sealed. It opens when the kingdom is whole again, and not a day before. I asked it nicely. Twice.

Effective line: Foreman Gus. Still on the wheels. Listen to that.
Suggested line: Foreman Gus, still on the wheels. But listen to them now - not a single whistle.

Effective line: I might cry into the wheel for energy. Voluntarily, for once.
Suggested line: I might even take a day off. No idea how it's done, but I hear you start by sitting down.

Effective line: CARDS ON SHELVES, IRON ON RACKS! I can finally shout about the floorboard, and I'VE FORGOTTEN HOW!
Suggested line: CARDS ON SHELVES, IRON ON RACKS! And I don't have to whisper about the floorboard any more, which is good, because I WAS NEVER ANY GOOD AT IT!

Effective line: Welcome, friend. Grandmaster Flex. Ten years in the dark, and the first thing I wanted was a window. The second was a stretch.
Suggested line: Welcome, friend. Grandmaster Flex, at your service. After ten years in the dark, the first thing I wanted was a window, and the second was a good long stretch.

Effective line: They took my plates, my protein, my pre-workout. So I breathed. Breathe in. Hold. ...That is what I did for ten years.
Suggested line: They took my plates, my protein, everything I had ever lifted. So I breathed: in, hold, and out again. That is what I did for ten years, and it was enough.

Effective line: I counted my own heartbeats until they became songs. They thought they were breaking me. They were teaching me.
Suggested line: I counted my own heartbeats until they turned into songs. They thought they were breaking me down there, son, but they were teaching me.

Effective line: Clench is learning to lift from zero. The strongest take the longest. Yesterday he spotted Gary without being asked. The gym is open to everyone now; come whenever you like.
Suggested line: Clench is learning to lift from zero, and the strongest always take the longest. Yesterday he spotted Gary without being asked. The gym is open to everyone now, so come whenever you like.

Effective line: Quota's gone. Left for the Capital before the dust settled. She always did leave early.
Suggested line: Quota's gone, off to the Capital before the dust had even settled. She always did like to leave early.

Effective line: We'll keep the schedule. It will make good kindling. Breathe, son. Nobody here is on the clock any more.
Suggested line: We'll keep her schedule, since it will make good kindling. And breathe, son - nobody here is on the clock any more.

Effective line: She's back. The real Grand Chef. She tasted my soup and said 'more salt' and I have never been so happy.
Suggested line: She's back - the real Grand Chef. She tasted my soup, frowned and said 'more salt', and I have never been so happy in my life.

Effective line: The pantry door stays wide open, and people come in for biscuits. At last, a proper open-door pastry.
Suggested line: The pantry door stays wide open now, and people wander in for biscuits all day long. I keep a tin by the hinge for them.

Effective line: A friendly duel? For old times' sake. Loser washes the ladle. It is a very big ladle.
Suggested line: Fancy a friendly duel, for old times' sake? Loser washes the ladle, and I should warn you, it's a very big ladle.

Effective line: An enormous pantry door blocks the lane. Locked. The keyhole is the size of a dinner plate.
Suggested line: An enormous pantry door blocks the lane, locked tight, with a keyhole the size of a dinner plate.

Effective line: Chef Fennel Gravois hands over a key the size of a ladle. It turns with a satisfying clunk.
Suggested line: Chef Fennel Gravois hands over a key the size of a ladle, and it turns in the lock with a satisfying clunk.

Effective line: The great pantry door swings open. Somewhere beyond, something smells incredible. Underneath it, faintly, something smells of hot iron.
Suggested line: The great pantry door swings open on a smell of roasting meat and fresh bread, and underneath it, faintly, the smell of hot iron.

Effective line: TASTE IT. TASTE IT! The Special Sauce is in everything. My soup. My tea. My SOUL.
Suggested line: TASTE IT! The Special Sauce is in everything now - my soup, my tea, my very SOUL - and isn't it WONDERFUL?

Effective line: The pantry is closed by order of the Grand Chef. The key stays on my apron. For the war effort!
Suggested line: The pantry is closed by order of the Grand Chef, and the key stays on my apron. It's all for the war effort!

Effective line: You want in? Beat me first. Yes, Chef! No, YOU, Chef!
Suggested line: You want the key? You'll have to beat me for it! Yes, Chef! No - YOU, Chef!

Effective line: TASTE IT. It is for the war effort. The BISCUIT is for the war effort.
Suggested line: TASTE IT! Even the BISCUIT is for the war effort!

Effective line: The simmer let go. The sauce let go. Plain bread. No sauce. I could weep. I am weeping.
Suggested line: The sauce has let go of me. Is that plain bread, with no sauce on it at all? I could weep. In fact, I am weeping.

Effective line: The Grand Chef stopped tasting her own sauces. The real one ALWAYS tasted. Same face. Ask yourself who was wearing the apron.
Suggested line: The Grand Chef stopped tasting her own sauces years ago, and the Chef I trained under ALWAYS tasted. Same face, same apron... so who has been wearing it?

Effective line: The Test Kitchen is at the far end of the Buffet, and it was never making casserole. Take a biscuit. Take two. Heroes need carbs.
Suggested line: Whatever's wrong here starts in the Test Kitchen, at the far end of the Buffet, and it was never making casserole. Take a biscuit for the road. Take two.

Effective line: The pantry door stays shut until you learn to cook. Consider this a closed-course meal.
Suggested line: The pantry door stays shut until you've learned to cook. Come back when you're properly seasoned!

Effective line: The great pantry door is locked and the chef with the key is extremely seasoned. Win the key and find out what the Grand Chef is really cooking.
Suggested line: The great pantry door is locked, and Chef Fennel Gravois won't give up the key. Win it, and find out what's really cooking in the Grand Chef's kitchens.

Effective line: Your HP is already full. A chef refills your plate anyway. Here, being full is treated as a misunderstanding.
Suggested line: Your HP is already full, but a chef refills your plate anyway. Around here, being full is treated as a misunderstanding.

Effective line: "You fainted into the gravy, so we fished you out. There's a fishing fee... sorry, sorry, I don't set the catch of the day.
Suggested line: "You fainted into the gravy, so we fished you out. There's a, um, fishing fee... sorry. Sorry! I don't set the prices, I just hold the ladle.

Effective line: Don't tell the taste testers. If anyone asks, say 'Yes, Chef.' It works for everything."
Suggested line: Don't tell the taste testers you fainted. If anyone asks you anything, just say 'Yes, Chef.' It works for everything."

Effective line: The fountain's tank is dry for now. It refills on your next visit. Soup takes time.
Suggested line: The fountain's tank is dry for now. Soup takes time, and it will be full again on your next visit.

Effective line: Real saffron. It grows in the Candy Field. Ask a sous-chef if you are lost."
Suggested line: Real saffron, mind you, which grows in the Candy Field. Ask a sous-chef if you lose your way."

Effective line: That is Basil's request. Speak to Basil in the Grand Pantry. Yes, Chef!"
Suggested line: It is Basil's request, so speak to Basil in the Grand Pantry. Yes, Chef!"

Effective line: Hop on when it docks. Ride. Hop off on the other side.
Suggested line: Hop on when it docks and hop off on the other side.

Effective line: Step on at one side. Step off at the other. Patience is a garnish.
Suggested line: Step on at one side and off at the other. Patience is a garnish.

Effective line: (There is no change. It is gravy. Everything is gravy.)
Suggested line: (There is no change. Everything here is gravy.)

Effective line: Sharp cheese ahead. Do not lean on or lick the walls; we cannot keep putting this delicately.
Suggested line: Sharp cheese ahead. Please do not lean on the walls, and please, please do not lick them.

Effective line: Read the recipe card. Vibes are not one of the four ingredients.
Suggested line: Read the recipe card. Guessing is not one of the four ingredients.

Effective line: Pure momentum with a side of sauce. A failed prototype that escaped. Nobody knows what it is running from. It is probably the cannon.
Suggested line: A failed prototype meatball, all momentum and sauce, that escaped the Test Kitchen and hasn't stopped rolling since. Whatever it's running from, it's probably the cannon.

Effective line: Psst. Basil, line cook. Ladle in one hand, nerves in the other. We Gourmands feed the kingdom and protect it: chefs cook, golems guard. Lately the golems have been... practising.
Suggested line: Psst. I'm Basil, line cook - ladle in one hand, nerves in the other. We Gourmands feed the kingdom and protect it: the chefs cook and the golems guard. Lately, though, the golems have been... practising.

Effective line: Ten years ago {villain}'s people came to the Buffet, and the Grand Chef... changed. Chef ALWAYS tastes, and this Chef doesn't. She just smiles at the soup.
Suggested line: Ten years ago {villain}'s people came to the Buffet, and after that the Grand Chef... changed. Chef ALWAYS tastes, and this Chef never does. She just stands there smiling at the soup.

Effective line: She put the Special Sauce in every pot. Our rules: nobody leaves hungry, nobody double-dips, and we say "Yes, Chef." Quietly. Nobody asks about the Test Kitchen. I'm not asking.
Suggested line: Then she put the Special Sauce in every pot. The old rules still hold - nobody leaves hungry, nobody double-dips, and we say "Yes, Chef." Quietly. And nobody asks about the Test Kitchen. I'm not asking.

Effective line: You came back... good, good. A Gourmand never stops stirring, so technically this panic is a cooking method.
Suggested line: You came back! Good, good. I've been stirring the same pot for an hour, just to give my hands something to do. A Gourmand never stops stirring.

Effective line: Chef laughed for a week. Last month I mentioned that cake to her, and she didn't remember it. Chef remembers every cake she's ever baked.
Suggested line: Chef laughed about it for a week. Last month I mentioned that cake to her, and she didn't remember it at all - and Chef remembers every cake she's ever baked.

Effective line: We're always out of something. Honey, basil, ghost pepper... half our deliveries go to the Test Kitchen, and nothing comes back. I once fetched a whole pig. Wrong pig. It's still angry.
Suggested line: We're always out of something - honey, basil, ghost pepper. Half our deliveries go to the Test Kitchen and nothing comes back. I once fetched them a whole pig. Wrong pig, and he's still cross about it.

Effective line: Madame Mirepoix. Dessert dealer and card shark of the Grand Pantry. Tonight's tasting menu: three cards, lightly foiled, served with disdain.
Suggested line: Madame Mirepoix, darling: dessert dealer and card shark of the Grand Pantry. Tonight's tasting menu is three cards, lightly foiled, served with a little disdain.

Effective line: Gourmand-issue, inspected by the Test Kitchen as of this year. They stamped my decorative cake. Right on the rosette. I have not forgiven them.
Suggested line: Every card is Gourmand-issue and, as of this year, inspected by the Test Kitchen. They stamped my decorative cake, darling, right on the rosette, and I have not forgiven them.

Effective line: You can fetch? Wonderful! We need three ingredients, quick. Our stolen deliveries are scattered all over the Buffet: truffle by the broccoli, salt by the river, honey up the Butte.
Suggested line: You can fetch? Oh, wonderful. Our deliveries keep getting stolen and dropped all over the Buffet: there's truffle by the broccoli, salt by the river and honey up the Butte.

Effective line: Pick up any three and come back. I'll make it worth your while. I'm begging with my whole apron.
Suggested line: Bring me any three and I'll make it worth your while. I'm begging with my whole apron here.

Effective line: Three whole ingredients! The Pantry is saved! For today!
Suggested line: Three whole ingredients! The Pantry is saved - for today, anyway, which is the only day I'm worried about.

Effective line: Here, a little something. It's a card. It's soup. It's soup you can play.
Suggested line: Here, take this for your trouble. It's a card, and somehow it's also a soup. Soup you can play, if you can believe it.

Effective line: The pantry's stocked until tomorrow, when we do it all again. I'm not complaining. I'm fetching. They look similar from a distance.
Suggested line: The pantry's stocked until tomorrow, when we do it all again. I'm not complaining, I'm fetching. From a distance they look very similar.

Effective line: I am going to cry. Discreetly. Here is your reward, you scrappy little thing. Thank you.
Suggested line: And so am I, discreetly. Here is your reward, you scrappy little thing, and thank you.

Effective line: Um. A word? Quietly? Old Meatloaf, our oldest golem, has stopped working. The Test Kitchen tried to strip him for parts. We got him back in two pieces. He hasn't spoken since Tuesday.
Suggested line: Um, could I have a word? Quietly? Old Meatloaf, our oldest golem, has stopped working. The Test Kitchen tried to strip him for parts, and we only got him back in two pieces. He hasn't spoken since Tuesday.

Effective line: He's walking! He's sizzling! Old Meatloaf is back on duty! I'm not crying. I'm standing near onions.
Suggested line: He's walking, and he's sizzling! Old Meatloaf is back on duty! I'm not crying, I'm just standing near some onions.

Effective line: Old Meatloaf is the best golem in the kingdom. Don't tell the others. They know.
Suggested line: Old Meatloaf is the best golem in the kingdom. Don't tell the others - they already know, and they're very gracious about it.

Effective line: He says it to you. You are not a chef. He does not mind.
Suggested line: He says it to you, though you are not a chef. He doesn't mind.

Effective line: I have never found a recipe for the Special Sauce. I looked. I even licked the index.
Suggested line: I have never found a recipe for the Special Sauce, and believe me, I looked. I even licked the index.

Effective line: One. A pinch of knowledge, barely seasoned. Here is a small token. It is a thimble of encouragement.
Suggested line: One. A pinch of knowledge, barely seasoned, so here is a small token: a thimble of encouragement.

Effective line: Two. Half-baked. A fine place to start. Half-baked things can still be rescued.
Suggested line: Two. Half-baked, which is a fine place to start; half-baked things can always be rescued.

Effective line: Three! Nearly perfect. Perfect would make me suspicious. Take your reward and a warm roll.
Suggested line: Three! Nearly perfect, and perfect would only make me suspicious. Take your reward and a warm roll.

Effective line: Not a pass. Wrong, but deliciously wrong. Walk the Endless Buffet, read the signs, and come back. There is no limit on attempts.
Suggested line: Not a pass, I'm afraid - wrong, but deliciously wrong. Walk the Endless Buffet, read the signs and come back; there's no limit on attempts.

Effective line: Seven seasons on tape, and people STILL do my WHOOSH! Please rewind; the dramatic entrance is at the beginning.
Suggested line: Seven seasons on the air, and people STILL do my WHOOSH in the street! I'd do it for you now, but I save it for the cameras.

Effective line: My Turbo Tots toys were recalled. Not for safety: for spinning too well. Tonight's audience is ten sprouts and a very patient cloche. Let's COOK!
Suggested line: My Turbo Tots toys were recalled for spinning too well, and tonight's audience is ten sprouts and a very patient cloche. But the show goes on! Let's COOK!

Effective line: Back for another shift, champ? The cameras are always rolling. They are not. They ran out of film in two-thousand-three. Smile anyway.
Suggested line: Back for another shift, champ? Smile for the cameras! They ran out of film years ago, but a professional smiles anyway.

Effective line: Remember: the ticket is your friend. The ticket does not judge. The ticket is judging, but kindly.
Suggested line: Remember, the ticket is your friend. It's judging you, of course, but kindly.

Effective line: Your very first shift on the show! Here is your bonus, free, no obligation. It is a scroll.
Suggested line: Your very first shift on the show! Here's your bonus, free and with no obligation: a scroll!

Effective line: A single sad bubble rises. It pops. That was all it had to say.
Suggested line: A single sad bubble rises and pops. That was all it had to say.

Effective line: Just measuring. Mind you, the Chef's soups add years to people. Bad for business. Good for everybody else. Heh.
Suggested line: Just measuring. Mind you, the Chef's soups add years to people, which is bad for business and good for everybody else. Heh.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's see now... you're not down for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.

Effective line: Halt, traveller. This gate opens for a duel of honour. Lids up. Yes, Chef.
Suggested line: Halt, traveller! This gate opens only for a duel of honour, so lids up. Yes, Chef.

Effective line: This deck is underdressed, darling. A little butter. A little foil. Voila.
Suggested line: This deck is underdressed, darling. A little butter, a little foil, and voila.

Effective line: Have you eaten? Sit. Eat. Then save the kingdom. In that order.
Suggested line: Have you eaten? Sit. Eat. The kingdom can wait until you've had your soup.

Effective line: A full table is a safe table. Pull up a chair. That is an order.
Suggested line: A full table is a safe table. Pull up a chair, dear - that's an order.

Effective line: I tasted my soup today. As me. Too salty. It was mine.
Suggested line: I tasted my own soup today, as me. Too salty, but it was mine.

Effective line: Third-class apprentice. Many dishes. I am trying. The dishes are also trying.
Suggested line: I am a third-class apprentice now, with many dishes. I am trying. So are the dishes.

Effective line: Over here. Quietly. Have you ever eaten somewhere with no menu? ...I'm brave. I'm brave.
Suggested line: Over here, quietly. Have you ever eaten somewhere with no menu at all? ...I'm brave. I'm brave.

Effective line: The card is in one of the hidden stashes around the Buffet. Golden. You'll know it. Chef always said gold means sit down.
Suggested line: The card's in one of the hidden stashes around the Buffet. It's golden, so you'll know it when you see it. Chef always said gold means sit down.

Effective line: That's it! One seat, three courses, survival optional. I'm excited. I think. It feels a lot like the other thing.
Suggested line: That's it! One seat, three courses, survival optional. I'm excited, I think - it feels a lot like being terrified.

Effective line: You pass incoming ingredient crates and outgoing unlabelled ones. Research appears to be a one-way conversation.
Suggested line: You pass crates of ingredients going in and unlabelled crates coming out, and nothing in between that looks like a meal.

Effective line: Frozen failures line the walls. Some of them are still moving. One of the freezers is humming louder than the rest.
Suggested line: Frozen failures line the walls, and some of them are still moving. One freezer hums louder than the rest, as if something inside wants to be heard.

Effective line: A hot meal, an honest one. The only unmodified food in the building. Restore HP.
Suggested line: A hot, honest meal: the only unmodified food in the building. Restore HP.

Effective line: The unfinished war machine looms. It is enormous, held together by gravy and willpower.
Suggested line: The unfinished war machine looms over you, enormous, and held together by gravy and willpower.

Effective line: The cook behind the counter whispers: "The Grand Chef stopped tasting her own soup ten years ago. Nobody noticed. Everybody noticed. Nobody said."
Suggested line: The cook behind the counter leans in and whispers: "The Grand Chef stopped tasting her own soup ten years ago. Every one of us noticed, and not one of us said a word."

Effective line: Inspection! ATTEN-TION! Who put a dent in my souffle cannon? Battle stations! This is not a drill, it is a souffle!
Suggested line: ATTEN-TION! Inspection! Who put a dent in my souffle cannon? Battle stations, all of you! This is not a drill, it is a souffle, and it will rise on schedule!

Effective line: And what is THIS? A civilian. In my bay. Unsupervised. With flavour on his breath.
Suggested line: And what is THIS? A civilian, unsupervised, in my bay, with flavour on his breath. Disgraceful.

Effective line: Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense. Taste is a weakness, son. Paste is a strategy.
Suggested line: Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense, and you will stand up straight when you hear it. Taste is a weakness, son. Paste is a strategy.

Effective line: Whisk formation! Field-test the prototype on the intruder. I have a ration meeting.
Suggested line: Whisk formation! Field-test the prototype on the intruder while I attend a ration meeting. I want a full report, and I want it bland.

Effective line: He salutes the machine. The machine salutes back with a ladle. The Colonel marches out before it has finished preheating.
Suggested line: He salutes the machine, the machine salutes back with a ladle, and the Colonel marches out before it has finished preheating.

Effective line: It is delicious. It is probably cursed. You feel strong and slightly sticky, and your units will not stop smelling of gravy.
Suggested line: It is delicious and almost certainly cursed. You feel strong and slightly sticky, and your units will not stop smelling of gravy.

Effective line: Some of the pantry is still clean. The jars are labelled DO NOT OPEN, WE MEAN IT. You do not open them. You sell them.
Suggested line: A few shelves are still clean, stacked with jars labelled DO NOT OPEN, WE MEAN IT. You respect their wishes and sell them unopened.

Effective line: Blueprints, recipe cards and signed memos fill the cabinets. Every note signed by the Grand Chef is in perfect copperplate, without one gravy stain. Real chefs' notes are mostly gravy stain.
Suggested line: Blueprints, recipe cards and signed memos fill the cabinets. Every note signed by the Grand Chef is in perfect copperplate without a single gravy stain, and a real chef's notes are mostly gravy stain.

Effective line: The chef who wrote these has never held a ladle. The impostor is exposed, and so is how little they have been cooking.
Suggested line: Laid beside the old recipe cards, it is plain: whoever signed these memos has never held a ladle. The person giving orders in this kitchen is not the cook who used to.

Effective line: Evidence, and a buyer for it. The buyer asks no questions, which is the best kind of buyer.
Suggested line: Blueprints like these are evidence, and evidence always has a buyer. The one you find asks no questions, which is the best kind.

Effective line: Load the smoothie! Purée setting! FIRE!
Suggested line: Load the smoothie, set it to puree, and FIRE!

Effective line: The Grand Chef turns from the stove. She smiles the smile from every portrait in the Pantry. She has worn it for ten years without a crease.
Suggested line: The Grand Chef turns from the stove wearing the smile from every portrait in the Pantry, and in ten years it has never once creased.

Effective line: "Ah. A taste tester. Welcome to the future of dining. The future is efficient. The future does not need to be tasted."
Suggested line: "Ah, a taste tester. Welcome to the future of dining, which is efficient, and which does not need to be tasted."

Effective line: Welcome to the Test Kitchen. Everything here is delicious. I have been told.
Suggested line: Welcome to the Test Kitchen. Everything here is delicious, or so I have been told.

Effective line: Delicious. Delicious. I have been told that is the word. ...Why will it not stay on?
Suggested line: Delicious... delicious. I was told that is the word. ...Why will this face not stay on?

Effective line: You never taste your own soup, do you? ...Neither do I. I cannot.
Suggested line: They always asked whether I tasted the soup. ...I never did. I never could.

Effective line: The Grand Chef's private kitchen. Her apron is spotless. Her chin is a little off.
Suggested line: The Grand Chef's private kitchen. Her apron is spotless, and something about her chin is a little off.

Effective line: A sous-chef is hiding behind the sacks of flour. "She does not taste the soup," he whispers. "She never tastes the soup.
Suggested line: A sous-chef is crouched behind the sacks of flour, shaking. "She doesn't taste the soup," he whispers. "Not once, not in ten years.

Effective line: He eats like a man who has not eaten in a week. "Thank you," he says. "Be careful.
Suggested line: He eats like a man who hasn't had a proper meal in a week, and when he's finished he grips your hand. "Thank you. Please be careful.

Effective line: The real Chef is down there somewhere. I know she is." You feel better for it.
Suggested line: The real Chef is down there somewhere. I know she is." You leave feeling better for having fed him.

Effective line: They never looked at their Chef. They looked at the food.
Suggested line: They never looked at their Chef, only at the food.

Effective line: "Delicious." That is the word I was given for it. I say it often. I do not know what it means.
Suggested line: "Delicious" is the word I was given for it. I say it often, and I have never known what it means.

Effective line: I have no name or face of my own. I cannot even taste what I make.
Suggested line: I have no face of my own and no name, and I cannot even taste what I make. I do not know what is left of me.

Effective line: How will they know it's you? After ten years?
Suggested line: After ten years, how will they know it's really you?

Effective line: Not with a speech. Not with papers. With dinner.
Suggested line: Not with a speech, and not with papers. With dinner.

Effective line: Come here, you. No face, no name. What you are called does not matter. What you do is what matters.
Suggested line: Come here, you. No face and no name, and I don't care a crumb about either. What you're called doesn't matter half as much as what you do.

Effective line: You wore my face for ten years and never once learned to taste. Today you start. Let me give you something to start with.
Suggested line: You wore my face for ten years and never once learned to taste. Today you start, and I'll give you something to start with.

Effective line: So take my old name. Escoffina. I was always prouder of the work than of the title.
Suggested line: Take my old name, then: Escoffina. I was always prouder of the work than of the title, and the name could do with someone starting fresh.

Effective line: ...Escoffina. I will try to cook honestly. I will try to be someone worth the name.
Suggested line: ...Escoffina. I will try to cook honestly, and to become someone worth the name.

Effective line: Leaving the Endless Buffet ends this visit. Town heals you fully. The golems are back to guarding plates, not people. The buffet is still endless.
Suggested line: Leaving the Endless Buffet ends this visit. Town heals you fully. The golems guard plates again instead of people, and the buffet is as endless as ever.

Effective line: Nobody leaves hungry. Innovation Season is over. Dinner is back.
Suggested line: Nobody leaves hungry. Innovation Season is over, and dinner is back.

Effective line: The taste testers are free. They like food again. Please give them seconds.
Suggested line: Our taste testers are free and enjoying food again. Please give them seconds.

Effective line: To {town}, through the great pantry door. Wipe your feet; we just mopped. Free samples by the door. Take two. Nobody is checking.
Suggested line: To {town}, through the great pantry door. Wipe your feet, as we have just mopped, and take two free samples on your way out. Nobody is checking.

Effective line: The repurposed cannon now fires bread at pigeons. This is what we meant by a feeding programme.
Suggested line: The old cannon has been refitted to fire bread rolls for the pigeons, who have never been happier.

Effective line: The real Chef is back in her own kitchen, tasting her own soup. We all cried. Say it with me: Yes, Chef. Louder. YES, CHEF! ...Oh, that felt good. We mean it this time.
Suggested line: The real Chef is back in her own kitchen, tasting her own soup, and we all cried into our aprons. Yes, Chef. YES, CHEF! ...Sorry. I whispered it for ten years, and it feels so good to mean it.

Effective line: The Special Sauce is down the drain and the golems guard plates again. Yes, Chef - finally an order I can stomach!
Suggested line: The Special Sauce is down the drain and the golems guard plates again. Yes, Chef. I can say it out loud now. I keep saying it to the walls, just to hear it.

Effective line: Tarragon! Sous-Chef! Fetcher of things! I caught up with lunch!
Suggested line: Tarragon, Sous-Chef and fetcher of things! Sorry, I'm out of breath. I finally caught up with lunch.

Effective line: Ingredients are coming back from the Test Kitchen by the cartload, even pigs! A happy pig this time; I've had enough professional disagreements.
Suggested line: Ingredients are coming back from the Test Kitchen by the cartload, pigs included, and this time the pig is happy about it. I've had quite enough professional disagreements with pigs.

Effective line: People wave when I fetch things now! And nobody asks for cannonballs - I prefer a lighter lunch.
Suggested line: People wave when I fetch things now, and nobody's asked me for a single cannonball. Flour, eggs, a little thyme... sorry, I'm making lists again.

Effective line: Have you eaten? Sit. I am the Grand Chef, and forgive the apron: the impostor kept it cleaner, but I wear it with feeling.
Suggested line: Have you eaten? Sit, sit. I'm the Grand Chef, and forgive the apron: the impostor kept it cleaner, but I wear it with feeling.

Effective line: Ten years in the walk-in freezer, and I never once forgot the taste of honest soup. They put that sauce in every pot and called it innovation.
Suggested line: Ten years in the walk-in freezer, and I never forgot the taste of honest soup. Meanwhile they put that sauce in every pot and called it innovation.

Effective line: Let me cook for you. I promise there is nothing in it but food.
Suggested line: Let me cook for you. I promise there's nothing in it but food.

Effective line: And you, my dear: you do not know your name yet. Good. That is not a flaw, it is a blank page. Go and do something worth signing.
Suggested line: And you, my dear, don't know your name yet. That isn't a flaw, it's a blank page. Go and do something worth signing.

Effective line: Escoffina. Apprentice. Second class.
Suggested line: Escoffina. Apprentice. Second class, which is one class more than I had last month.

Effective line: Third, if you count the dishes. Chef says what I am called does not matter, only what I do. So I am doing a great many dishes.
Suggested line: Chef says what I am called matters less than what I do, so I am doing a great many dishes. It is a start.

Effective line: I made a sauce today. A real one. I tasted it. As me. It had too much salt.
Suggested line: I made a sauce today, a real one, and I tasted it myself. As me. It had far too much salt.

Effective line: I have a face of my own now. I am still deciding what to do with it. I am trying.
Suggested line: I have a face of my own now, and I am still deciding what to do with it. I am trying.

Effective line: The Colonel's gone. His office is empty. He took the paste recipe with him.
Suggested line: The Colonel's gone. He cleared out his office overnight and took the paste recipe with him.

Effective line: It's one word long. The word is 'paste'.
Suggested line: It's one word long, and the word is 'paste'.

Effective line: He left before dessert. He always did. They say he's feeding the whole Capital now, from a factory.
Suggested line: He left before dessert, the way he always did. They say he's feeding the whole Capital now, out of a factory.

Effective line: Grey, from a tap. Somebody ought to teach that man to cook.
Suggested line: Grey food, from a tap. Somebody ought to teach that man to cook.

Effective line: The afterlife is processing again. Agnes says the queue moved four whole numbers yesterday. We had cake.
Suggested line: The afterlife is processing again. Agnes says the queue moved four whole numbers yesterday, so we had cake.

Effective line: I have a new stamp. It says HELPED. I have used it nine times. I am counting.
Suggested line: I've got a new stamp that says HELPED. I've used it nine times so far, and yes, I'm counting.

Effective line: You may challenge me again, if you like. No permit required. That one is my favourite rule.
Suggested line: You can challenge me again if you like, and you won't need a permit to do it. That's my favourite rule. I wrote it myself.

Effective line: The barrier is down. A sign with a stamp on it says the road needs a permit. Nobody has ever been issued one.
Suggested line: The barrier is down, and a stamped sign beside it says the road needs a permit. Nobody has ever been issued one.

Effective line: Halt. This checkpoint requires a permit. Permits are not issued. Please take a number.
Suggested line: Halt. Passage through this checkpoint requires a permit, and no permit has ever been issued. Please take a number.

Effective line: Your number is zero. It is always zero. Now serving: nobody.
Suggested line: Your number is zero, as is everyone's. This checkpoint is now serving nobody, and will continue to do so.

Effective line: The authorization is valid. Policy says I must stop you. I have read all of the policy. Twice.
Suggested line: The authorization is valid, and policy states that I must stop you. I have read all of the policy, twice.

Effective line: Your number is zero. It is always zero. Please hold.
Suggested line: Your number is zero, as it always is. Please hold.

Effective line: APPROVED. ...That was the wrong stamp. That felt... nice. Disregard.
Suggested line: APPROVED. ...That was the wrong stamp, and it felt... nice. Disregard that.

Effective line: ...I can hear my own thoughts again. I think I was Pending for a decade. Old habits die hard. Unlike me.
Suggested line: ...I can hear my own thoughts again. I think I've been Pending for ten years. It was very quiet in there, and very orderly, and none of it was me.

Effective line: {villain} did not corrupt us. He used our own rules: a perfectly valid transfer of authority, notarized and filed.
Suggested line: {villain} didn't need to corrupt us. He used our own rules: a perfectly valid transfer of authority, notarized and filed. We stamped it ourselves.

Effective line: The Hall of Final Approvals is at the top of the D.N.A. Go carefully. Or fill out a form. Ideally both.
Suggested line: The Hall of Final Approvals is at the top of the D.N.A., and whoever sits in it holds the authorization. Go carefully, or fill out a form first. Ideally both.

Effective line: Not yet, then. Take a number. It is still zero.
Suggested line: Not yet, then. You may take another number, though it will also be zero.

Effective line: Urgent delivery. Signature required. Signature will be taken.
Suggested line: Urgent delivery! A signature is required, and if one is not given, one will be taken.

Effective line: Unpaid. Undead. Eager to impress the new management. At last, some hands-on experience.
Suggested line: Unpaid, undead and eager to impress the new management. At last, some hands-on experience!

Effective line: Has wanted a quick sync since 1994. Now enforces the new regulations with great, unenthusiastic precision.
Suggested line: He has wanted a quick sync with you since 1994. Now he enforces the new regulations with great, unenthusiastic precision.

Effective line: The machine screams. The coffee screams. You drink it anyway. -1 HP.
Suggested line: The machine screams, then the coffee screams, and you drink it anyway. -1 HP.

Effective line: A coin rolls out of the dispenser. The machine regrets nothing. +gold.
Suggested line: A coin rolls out of the dispenser instead of coffee, and the machine shows no remorse at all. +gold.

Effective line: You drink the coffee. Almost drinkable. Someone may be disciplined. (+HP)
Suggested line: The coffee is almost drinkable. Someone in the breakroom may be disciplined for this. (+HP)

Effective line: Perfect brew! The machine seems proud of itself. Full recovery of... something.
Suggested line: A perfect brew. The machine gives a proud little hum, and you feel fully restored.

Effective line: You sink into the Breakroom Couch. Somehow it is both ice cold and slightly damp. HP restored.
Suggested line: You sink into the Breakroom Couch, which is somehow both ice cold and slightly damp. HP restored.

Effective line: The suggestion box is empty now. The committee read your suggestion. It was not implemented. It was, however, laminated.
Suggested line: The suggestion box is empty. The committee read your suggestion and did not implement it, but they did laminate it.

Effective line: first clear! here's a bonus. been in my desk since '09. finally found the right occasion to open the drawer.
Suggested line: first clear! here's a bonus. it's been in my desk drawer since '09, waiting for the right occasion, and this is it.

Effective line: it's a memory game. literally. we're all memories here. anyway.
Suggested line: a memory game, in a building full of people who are mostly memories. i thought it was clever. Agnes didn't laugh.

Effective line: ok so: flip two cards at a time. find all 8 pairs in 14 moves or fewer. fewer moves, more stars. easy. ish.
Suggested line: so: flip two cards at a time and find all 8 pairs in 14 moves or fewer. fewer moves means more stars. easy-ish.

Effective line: out of moves. my virtual pet lasted an hour. want another go? you get a better deal than the pet.
Suggested line: out of moves. hey, you still lasted longer than my virtual pet does. want another go?

Effective line: nice flipping! top 8, number one. sorry, me. we had a good run.
Suggested line: nice flipping! you're number one in my top 8 now. sorry, me. we had a good run.

Effective line: Oh! A customer! Hello. Gerald, breakroom barista. Also Number 4,000,212. They're on 3. I brought a book. Several. All of them, actually.

Effective line: Even the dead deserve humanity. Our job is to help the lost souls. Following orders be damned: we treat everyone with respect.
Suggested line: Everyone in that queue was somebody, dear, and the dead deserve to be treated as people. No order outranks that, not his and not anyone's.

Effective line: Mortimer Grimsby. Formerly CE-No. Currently number 4,000,214 in the Waiting Room of Eternity. Gerald was 4,000,212.
Suggested line: Mortimer Grimsby, formerly CE-No, currently number 4,000,214 in the Waiting Room of Eternity. Gerald was 4,000,212, and he has been very patient with me.

Effective line: You had 4,000,213. You did not wait. I keep thinking about that.
Suggested line: You had 4,000,213, and you did not wait. I keep thinking about that.

Effective line: I made others wait far longer. It is worse knowing that now.
Suggested line: I made others wait far longer than you, and every one of them was a person. It is worse, knowing that now.

Effective line: Intake's moving again! Agnes waved me straight through. First time in ten years nobody asked me for Form 27-B. Heh.
Suggested line: Intake's moving again! Agnes waved me straight through. First time in ten years nobody's asked me for Form 27-B, and my appointment book is filling up nicely.

Effective line: Archdruid Compostella is herself again. She hugged me. She smells like rain and a little bit like compost. Perfect.
Suggested line: Archdruid Compostella is herself again, and she hugged me! She smells like rain and a little bit like compost, which is exactly how an Archdruid ought to smell.

Effective line: Want a practice round? I promise not to thorn at you. Much. The raccoons are judging, so be nice.
Suggested line: Fancy a practice round? I'll try very hard not to thorn at you. The raccoons have come to watch, so let's both be on our best behaviour.

Effective line: The Rot keeps this path for the Rotheart. Turn back. Turn back. Turn... into compost.
Suggested line: ...this path belongs to the Rotheart now... turn back... before the green decides you would make good compost...

Effective line: If you will not leave, the hungry green will keep you. Forever. Very nicely. Like mulch.
Suggested line: ...if you won't leave, the green will keep you... it keeps everything now... nothing it holds is ever allowed to go...

Effective line: Oh. Oh no. Did I thorn at you? I'm so sorry. The Rot speaks very softly, right up until it doesn't.
Suggested line: Oh no, did I thorn at you? I'm so sorry. The Rot talks very softly in your head, right up until the moment it's doing all the talking.

Effective line: The Rot took Archdruid Compostella first, at the Rotheart, deep in the Verdant Dump. Everything grew out from her. Me too, the day a very tidy lady with shears came calling.
Suggested line: The Rot took Archdruid Compostella first, down at the Rotheart in the deepest part of the Verdant Dump. Everything grew out from there, and it got into me the day a very tidy lady with shears came calling.

Effective line: The path is clear. Go gently in there. And if you see a raccoon, say hi. They're very good boys.
Suggested line: The path's clear now. Go gently in there, and if you meet a raccoon, say hello for me. They're very good boys, whatever anyone tells you.

Effective line: ...the green is patient... it has all the time in the world... and so does the garbage...
Suggested line: ...the green is patient... nothing ends here any more... come back when you're ready to stay...

Effective line: ...come back... the green can wait... it has nowhere to leaf...
Suggested line: ...come back... the green can wait... it has forgotten how to do anything else...

Effective line: The path to the Rotheart is a tunnel of living roots. The air is warm, wet and humming.
Suggested line: The way to the Rotheart runs through a tunnel of living roots, and the air down here is warm, wet and humming.

Effective line: Something very large is breathing, somewhere underneath. It is not you.
Suggested line: Somewhere underneath you, something very large is breathing slowly, the way a sleeper does when the dream is a bad one.

Effective line: You eat roast roots and a pie with a crust like a fence post. The mug is mostly apple. A goat watches every bite. HP restored.
Suggested line: You eat roast roots and a pie with a crust like a fence post, washed down with a mug that's mostly apple, while a goat watches every bite. HP restored.

Effective line: You are already full of HP. Granny Gristle offers you a third helping anyway. It is a very small turnip.
Suggested line: Your HP is already full, but Granny Gristle offers you a third helping anyway: one very small turnip.

Effective line: "Fell over in the muck, dearie. We rolled you out. Mucking-out fee is yours. Call it a soil charge. Heh!
Suggested line: "Went down in the muck, dearie, so we rolled you out. Mucking-out fee is yours, mind. I call it a soil charge. Heh!

Effective line: Haybale was free. Mind you, it is growing. Best get up before you put down roots."
Suggested line: The haybale was free, though it's started growing, so best get up before you put down roots."

Effective line: You already took the one lying here. Come back next visit; the Dump restocks itself overnight. It is very good at that.
Suggested line: You already took the one lying here. Come back next visit; these days the Dump restocks itself overnight, whether anyone asks it to or not.

Effective line: The bin burps, steams and hands you a warm Compost Cocktail. It smells like a promise. You feel sturdier. (+1 max HP this visit)
Suggested line: The bin burps, steams and hands you a warm Compost Cocktail that smells faintly of promise, and you feel sturdier. (+1 max HP this visit)

Effective line: The Compost Bin needs two piles of good junk. You have fewer than two. It waits for you to get your scrap together.
Suggested line: The Compost Bin needs two piles of good junk, and you have fewer than two. It sits there, patient and faintly steaming.

Effective line: The bin is full of cocktails for this visit. Come back next visit. It will have fermented.
Suggested line: The bin has given all the cocktails it can for this visit. Come back next time, once it has had a chance to ferment.

Effective line: You kneel. A seed in the shrine splits and blooms. A druid voice that sounds like moss says: "Grow."
Suggested line: You kneel, and a seed in the shrine splits and blooms. A druid's voice, soft as moss, says: "Grow."

Effective line: The trough is empty. The animals are staring at you. Bring a pile of good junk.
Suggested line: The trough is empty and every animal in the pen is staring at you. Bring them a pile of good junk.

Effective line: The animals are full. One goat is lying on its back. Come back next visit.
Suggested line: The animals are full, and one goat is lying on its back to prove it. Come back next visit.

Effective line: You plant a crop and pat the soil. It wriggles a little. Come back in a bit and it will be ready.
Suggested line: You plant a crop and pat the soil, which wriggles a little under your hand. Come back in a while and it will be ready.

Effective line: The crop is still growing. A sprout waves at you. You give it space; it seems rather attached to the plot.
Suggested line: The crop is still growing. A sprout waves at you, and you leave it to get on with things.

Effective line: That one is already back in the pen. It is sulking. It will get over it.
Suggested line: That one is already back in the pen, sulking. It will get over it eventually.

Effective line: The vine bridge sways and creaks cheerfully. It is made of vines, ambition and a lot of compost.
Suggested line: The vine bridge sways and creaks cheerfully under you, held together by vines, goodwill and a great deal of compost.

Effective line: It has grown! You try to picture the spot without it. The druids look pleased with themselves.
Suggested line: It has grown! Already you can't quite picture the spot without it, and the druids look very pleased with themselves.

Effective line: You cannot dismount out here, the scree will eat your boots. Find a flat spot first.
Suggested line: You can't dismount out here; the scree would eat your boots. Find a flat spot first.

Effective line: A barricade of junk. Far too heavy to push on foot. Something fast and stubborn could charge through it.
Suggested line: This barricade of junk is far too heavy to push on foot, but something fast and stubborn could charge straight through it.

Effective line: You fall in! Someone fishes you out with a pitchfork. You drip on dry ground. (-1 HP)
Suggested line: You fall in! Someone fishes you out with a pitchfork and leaves you dripping on dry ground. (-1 HP)

Effective line: Compost doesn't sort itself. Well. Lately it tries. That's the problem.
Suggested line: Compost doesn't sort itself. Well, lately it tries, and that's the whole problem.

Effective line: New stairs. Same climb. And the stairs grew two more steps overnight.
Suggested line: Built these stairs last week, and they've grown two more steps overnight. Same climb, only longer.

Effective line: A sprout mound with a sign: PLANT A MAGIC BEAN HERE. You do not have one. Beans lie around the Dump, one per visit per field.
Suggested line: A sprout mound with a sign: PLANT A MAGIC BEAN HERE. You don't have one, but beans lie around the Dump, one per field each visit.

Effective line: A sprout mound at the foot of Rust Peak. You plant a Magic Bean and wait. Above, a hubcap spins.
Suggested line: A sprout mound at the foot of Rust Peak. You plant a Magic Bean and wait, and somewhere above you a hubcap starts to spin.

Effective line: A sack of fertilizer plus time makes a harvest. Visit-length time. Do not stare at it.
Suggested line: A sack of fertilizer and a little time make a harvest, ready before you leave. It grows faster if nobody stares at it.

Effective line: The door is warm because something in there is thriving. It is thriving very, very hard. It is thriving at us. Please do not open it.
Suggested line: The door is warm because something behind it is thriving, very hard, and lately it seems to be thriving in our direction. Please don't open it.

Effective line: A trash golem towers over you, moss coating its fridge body. Something sprouts from its ears. Inside, the little light is still on.
Suggested line: A trash golem towers over you, moss coating its fridge body and shoots sprouting from its ears. Inside, the little light is still on.

Effective line: A scarecrow druid faces you, a cabbage growing where its heart should be. You see no crows. The garden has bigger problems.
Suggested line: A scarecrow druid faces you with a cabbage growing where its heart should be. There isn't a crow in sight; the garden has bigger problems now.

Effective line: Welcome to the Compost Grange. Brother Bramble, Warden of the Stream. Please close the door behind you. And lock it. And check the window.
Suggested line: Welcome to the Compost Grange. I'm Brother Bramble, Warden of the Stream. Would you close the door behind you, and lock it, and maybe check the window? The vines keep trying it.

Effective line: We are the Refusemancers: druids of waste removal and agriculture. Our animals turn the kingdom's garbage into fertilizer for its crops. The Buffet calls us garbage eaters. They eat our carrots.
Suggested line: We're the Refusemancers, druids of waste removal and agriculture: our animals turn the kingdom's garbage into fertilizer for its crops. The Buffet calls us garbage eaters, and then they eat our carrots.

Effective line: Our magic runs through nature itself, and {villain} used it against us. Our Archdruid, Compostella, went first. Something got into her roots.
Suggested line: Our magic runs through nature itself, and {villain} turned it against us. Our Archdruid, Compostella, went down to tend the deep roots and never came back up, and nothing has been right since.

Effective line: Now nothing rots, so nothing feeds the soil. Everything is too alive, and the whole Dump is sick with growing. Also, SOMEBODY ate the compost AGAIN.
Suggested line: Now nothing rots, so nothing feeds the soil. Everything is too alive and the whole Dump is sick with growing, and on top of all that, SOMEBODY has eaten the compost AGAIN.

Effective line: Back at the Grange? Sort your boots: compost, metal, glass, paper. Check for tendrils. We already have enough houseplants.
Suggested line: Back at the Grange? Do sort your boots at the door - compost, metal, glass, paper - and check them for tendrils. We have quite enough houseplants already.

Effective line: The Archdruid planted a tree for every royal birthday. There is a row of them past the stream. Eleven trees. Then nothing.
Suggested line: The Archdruid planted a tree for every royal birthday, and there's a row of them past the stream. Eleven trees, and then nothing.

Effective line: I water the twelfth spot anyway. I couldn't tell you why. It feels as if somebody is still coming.
Suggested line: I water the twelfth spot anyway. I couldn't tell you why, except that it feels as if somebody is still coming.

Effective line: Not long ago, somebody carried a sleeping young man through these woods at night. He glowed, faintly. Four colours.
Suggested line: Not long ago, somebody carried a sleeping young man through these woods in the dead of night. He was glowing faintly, in four colours. I've never seen anything like it.

Effective line: The raccoons saw. Raccoons see everything.
Suggested line: The raccoons saw it too. Raccoons see everything; they just won't tell you about it.

Effective line: Granny Gristle, junk-trader! Born in a haybale, raised in a barn, retired to a shed. This is the shed. It's started growing. It's got a window I never put in.
Suggested line: Granny Gristle, junk-trader! Born in a haybale, raised in a barn and retired to a shed, and this is the shed. It's started growing, mind. There's a window in the back I never put in. Heh!

Effective line: Everything here's Refusemancer-issue: grown, composted, well rinsed. Found, not stolen, dearie. The raccoon found it. I just held it very tightly.
Suggested line: Everything here's Refusemancer-issue: grown, composted and well rinsed. Found, not stolen, dearie. The raccoon found it, and I just held on to it very tightly.

Effective line: Cards grown strong, rinsed well, faint smell of earth. Hear that hum? Well, I never promised a silent auction. Heh!
Suggested line: Cards grown strong and rinsed clean, with a faint smell of earth. Hear them humming? Well, I never promised you a silent auction. Heh!

Effective line: They're looking at me again. I prefer a root vegetable that minds its own business. Heh!
Suggested line: The turnips are looking at me again. I like a root vegetable that minds its own business, I do. Heh!

Effective line: Oh good, a pair of legs! Billie Muckfoot, animal handler. Like the goat. I speak fluent goat. It's mostly screaming. Lately it's about the plants: the fields keep trying to eat my herd.
Suggested line: Oh good, a pair of legs! I'm Billie Muckfoot, animal handler, and I speak fluent goat, which is mostly screaming. Lately the screaming's about the plants: the fields keep trying to eat my herd.

Effective line: Any luck with the herd? Look for the goat first. It'll be eating something it shouldn't. If the thing is eating it back, shout.
Suggested line: Any luck with the herd? Look for the goat first; it'll be eating something it shouldn't. If the something is eating it back, shout for me.

Effective line: Find each one out in the Dump and walk it back towards the pen before dark. Don't chase. Walk firmly. Make eye contact.
Suggested line: Find each one out in the Dump and get it back to the pen before dark. Don't chase them. Walk up firmly and make eye contact.

Effective line: Three escapees, out in the fields. The goat is eating something. The pig is in a puddle. The raccoon is writing a strongly worded letter.
Suggested line: Three escapees, all out in the fields: the goat's eating something, the pig's found a puddle, and the raccoon is probably writing me a strongly worded letter.

Effective line: All three home! The pen's never looked so full. Here's your reward.
Suggested line: All three home, and the pen's never looked so full! Here, you've earned this.

Effective line: The herd's home and it's plotting. Thanks! Moss Mulligan at the centre bridge will grow you a crossing now. Tell her I sent you.
Suggested line: The herd's home and already plotting the next escape. Thank you! Moss Mulligan will grow you a crossing at the centre bridge now. Tell her I sent you.

Effective line: Granny Gristle is out of fertilizer and the crops are sulking. Gather three sacks from around the Dump. Hold your nose. Hold the sack.
Suggested line: Granny Gristle is out of fertilizer and the crops are sulking. Gather three sacks from around the Dump, and hold your nose while you do.

Effective line: I need three sacks from around the Dump. They're lying where the animals left them. Don't ask how. I never have. Heh!
Suggested line: I need three sacks from around the Dump, lying wherever the animals left them. Don't ask me how they got bagged up, dearie. I never have. Heh!

Effective line: Three whole sacks! The crops are going to sing. Not literally.
Suggested line: Three whole sacks! The crops'll be singing by morning, and I mean that more than I'd like to.

Effective line: Mostly not. Here's your reward. Found, not stolen. Heh!
Suggested line: Here's your reward. Found, not stolen, and only a little bit damp. Heh!

Effective line: The fields are fed. Plant your own with a sack of fertilizer and a little patience. Can't sell you patience. Nobody stays to browse it.
Suggested line: The fields are fed, dearie. Plant your own with a sack of fertilizer and a little patience. I'd sell you the patience too, but nobody ever stays long enough to buy it. Heh!

Effective line: Somebody dumped a dam of junk across the feeder channel on the north bank, and the stream cannot breathe. Borrow a mount from the stables, charge the dam, and my compost boots are yours.
Suggested line: Somebody has dumped a dam of junk across the feeder channel on the north bank, and the stream can't breathe. Borrow a mount from the stables and charge it, and my compost boots are yours.

Effective line: The junk dam on the north bank. Ride the goat from the north stable and charge it. Do not slow down. Dams can smell hesitation.
Suggested line: It's the junk dam on the north bank. Take Gideon the goat from the north stable and charge it at full tilt. He's never slowed down for anything, and I'd hate for him to start now.

Effective line: The stream is flowing! It is practically dancing. Here: compost boots, still warm. They squelch with pride.
Suggested line: The stream's flowing again, practically dancing! Here are the compost boots, still warm. They squelch, but it's a proud sort of squelch.

Effective line: The stream is clear. For now. The kingdom will refill it by Thursday. That is why we are here.
Suggested line: The stream's clear, for now. The kingdom will have it full again by the end of the week, but that's what we're here for.

Effective line: Ah, a visitor. Druid Thistlewick, Keeper of the Dump's Questions. I have sat in this ring of old appliances for forty years.
Suggested line: Ah, a visitor. I am Druid Thistlewick, Keeper of the Dump's Questions, and I have sat in this ring of old appliances for forty years.

Effective line: The dishwasher and I have an understanding. Lately it talks back. Forty years, and NOW it wants to clear the air.
Suggested line: The dishwasher and I have an understanding, though lately it has started talking back. Forty years, and NOW it wants to clear the air.

Effective line: Sort your thoughts like your bins: compost, recycle, regret. Answer well for gold and seeds. Answer poorly for a gentle, rustling sigh.
Suggested line: Sort your thoughts as you would your bins: compost, recycling, regret. Answer well and there is gold and seed in it for you; answer poorly and you will receive a gentle, rustling sigh.

Effective line: Zero. We have found room for growth. Rather a lot of room. No reward this time.
Suggested line: Zero. We have found room for growth, rather a lot of it, I'm afraid. No reward this time.

Effective line: One. A single seed. Plant it, water it, and try again.
Suggested line: One. A single seed, but every garden starts with one. Plant it, water it, and try again.

Effective line: I voiced Captain Compost Badger and his Sorting Squad back in the nineties! Nobody knew! All that fame went to a badger in a cape!
Suggested line: I was the voice of Captain Compost Badger and his Sorting Squad at every harvest puppet show for twenty years! Nobody knew! All that fame went to a badger in a cape!

Effective line: Back for another run, champ? The conveyor is hungry. The bins are patient. I have pie.
Suggested line: Back for another run, champ? The conveyor's hungry, the bins are ready, and I've got pie for afterwards!

Effective line: Your very first run at the fair! Here's your bonus, free, no obligation. It's a salve.
Suggested line: Your very first run at the fair! Here's your first-timer's bonus, no strings attached: a jar of compost salve!

Effective line: Compost salve! Rub it in! The salve, champ. Not the victory.
Suggested line: Rub it in, champ! The salve, I mean, not the victory. Nobody loves a gloater!

Effective line: Nothing has died in this valley in ten years. Not a beetle. Not a leaf. Unnatural, that.
Suggested line: Nothing's died in this valley in ten years, not so much as a beetle or a leaf. Unnatural, that.

Effective line: I've taken up knitting. Heh.
Suggested line: Gives a fellow a lot of free time. I've taken up knitting. Heh.

Effective line: Reduce! Reuse! Recy-CLUE: that one goes in the green bin!
Suggested line: Reduce! Reuse! And rinse your jars, folks - a sticky jar is a sad jar!

Effective line: The vines whisper now. It's not right. Also SOMEBODY ate the compost AGAIN.
Suggested line: The vines have started whispering. Also, SOMEBODY ate the compost AGAIN.

Effective line: Everything grows back, child. Even me. Especially me.
Suggested line: Everything goes back to the soil in the end, child. That's what lets it grow.

Effective line: About the barn... I will help mend it. The goat may prefer that I begin elsewhere.
Suggested line: About the barn, child... I'll help mend it. The goat would rather I started elsewhere.

Effective line: SOMEBODY has been eating ALL the compost. Little paw prints. A tiny crown.
Suggested line: SOMEBODY has been eating ALL the compost. There are little paw prints everywhere, and next to the bin I found... a tiny crown.

Effective line: Chase off two of the scavengers in the Dump and the trail will lead you to the alley under the big dumpster. Gently, please. They're only hungry. And GUILTY.
Suggested line: Chase off two of the scavengers in the Dump and their trail should lead you to the big dumpster. Gently, please - they're only hungry. And GUILTY.

Effective line: Two scavengers in the Dump. Fresh paw prints, freshly stolen compost. A trail of evidence with TERRIBLE table manners.
Suggested line: Two scavengers out in the Dump, please. Follow the fresh paw prints; it's a trail of evidence with TERRIBLE table manners.

Effective line: Under the tipped-over dumpster there's a gate made from a bicycle wheel. That's the way to the Trash Panda Throne. Bring a peg for your nose.
Suggested line: Under the tipped-over dumpster there's a gate made from an old bicycle wheel, and that's the way to the Trash Panda Throne. Do bring a peg for your nose.

Effective line: The compost was for the kingdom. We are the kingdom. Checkmate. ...Is it warm in here?
Suggested line: We were only testing the compost on the realm's behalf. Very thoroughly. ...Is it warm in here? It is very warm in here.

Effective line: The vines part for you, slowly. They do not seem to be letting you in. They seem to be letting you go deeper.
Suggested line: The vines part for you slowly, and it doesn't feel like being let in. It feels like being drawn deeper.

Effective line: The entrance is a cracked archway wrapped in black-green vines. They tighten as you pass.
Suggested line: A cracked archway wrapped in black-green vines that tighten a little as you pass beneath them.

Effective line: Normal-looking plants, mostly. A little too green. Every leaf turns, very slightly, to follow you.
Suggested line: Ordinary plants at first glance, only a shade too green, and every leaf turns very slightly to follow you.

Effective line: Mushrooms the size of sheds. Some of them are looking at you. Some of them have hats.
Suggested line: Mushrooms the size of garden sheds crowd the path, and a few of them tilt their caps to watch you go by.

Effective line: A ring of pale mushrooms murmurs as you pass. They know your name. They are not sure why.
Suggested line: A ring of pale mushrooms murmurs as you pass. They seem to know your name, though they can't think how.

Effective line: The vines are choosing who gets through. They are reading your deck very closely.
Suggested line: The vines are choosing who gets through, and they're reading your deck very closely before they decide.

Effective line: The mill wheel is gripped by roots as thick as a cart. Someone has been trimming them. Very neatly. Into the shape of a smiling man in a circlet.
Suggested line: Roots as thick as a cart grip the mill wheel. Someone has trimmed them, very neatly, into the shape of a smiling man in a circlet.

Effective line: Mind the topiary, dear. That's His Perfection from the left. The right side is still growing in.
Suggested line: Do mind the topiary, dear. That's His Perfection, seen from the left - the right side is still filling in.

Effective line: Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper. I outlawed composting. So untidy. All that rot, lying about in heaps, being honest.
Suggested line: Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper. I'm the one who outlawed composting. All that rot lying about in heaps, being honest with everybody - so untidy.

Effective line: Nothing rots here any more.
Suggested line: Nothing rots down here any more, and the whole place feels wrong for it.

Effective line: Isn't it lovely? I brought the Archdruid a little seed, a gift. Life that never ends. She was so very sad, and now nothing ever has to go.
Suggested line: Isn't it lovely? I brought the Archdruid a little seed as a gift - life that never ends. She was so very sad, and now nothing ever has to go.

Effective line: Such a pretty weed. Such a shame. Do hold still, dear.
Suggested line: Such a pretty little weed, and such a shame. Do hold still, dear, this won't take a moment.

Effective line: Gentlemen, if you would. He is well over regulation height.
Suggested line: Gentlemen, if you would? He's grown well over regulation height.

Effective line: Well. You've made a dreadful mess of my hedges. I shall send a note.
Suggested line: Well. You've made a dreadful mess of my hedges, and I shall be sending a note.

Effective line: Brother Bramble's notes are pinned to a root: 'NOTHING ROTS. NOTHING FEEDS THE SOIL. THE SOIL IS STARVING.
Suggested line: Brother Bramble's notes are pinned to a root in a worried hand: 'Nothing rots, so nothing feeds the soil, and the soil is STARVING.'

Effective line: IT IS ALIVE. IT IS ALL TOO ALIVE. AND WHO IS EATING THE COMPOST?'
Suggested line: Underneath, pressed much harder: 'Everything down here is far TOO alive. And WHO has been eating the COMPOST?'

Effective line: The pool is the colour of a bruise and it is sobbing very quietly. Things float in it that used to be useful. A boot, mostly.
Suggested line: The pool is the colour of a bruise, and it's sobbing very quietly around a boot that bobs in the middle of it.

Effective line: Somebody will pay for this. Somebody always does. It is usually a hedgehog.
Suggested line: Somebody will pay good gold for a bottle of this. Down here, that somebody is usually a hedgehog.

Effective line: You tell it that it is doing great. It sobs harder, then gives you a very old Mulch Mole it was keeping safe, and a bit of its warmth.
Suggested line: You tell it that it's doing very well. It sobs harder, then gives you a very old Mulch Mole it was keeping safe, along with a little of its warmth.

Effective line: A tunnel of drifting spores. A well-built deck walks straight through. A loose one starts to sprout.
Suggested line: A tunnel of drifting spores. A well-built deck walks straight through, but a loose one starts to sprout.

Effective line: The Refusemancers' seed bank, long since overrun. Some of the seeds are still good. Some of them have opinions.
Suggested line: The Refusemancers' seed bank, long since overrun. Some of the seeds are still good, and some of them have opinions.

Effective line: The oldest tree in the Dump, grown into the Rotheart. It does not recognize you. It does not recognize anything. (Elite)
Suggested line: The oldest tree in the Dump, grown into the Rotheart. It doesn't recognize you, or anything else, any more. (Elite)

Effective line: You breathe in rain and old compost. Beneath you, a worm moves through the loose soil. You let your shoulders drop.
Suggested line: It smells of rain and old compost, and somewhere beneath you a worm is working through the loose soil. Your shoulders drop for the first time in hours.

Effective line: The golem folds into the floor. The tunnel ahead is smoother, warmer, and has a pulse.
Suggested line: The golem folds back into the floor, and the tunnel ahead turns smoother and warmer, with a pulse running through it.

Effective line: A tag in very tidy handwriting: PROPERTY OF THE PATH-OLOGISTS. LIFE THAT NEVER DIES.
Suggested line: A tag hangs from it in very tidy handwriting: PROPERTY OF THE PATH-OLOGISTS - LIFE THAT NEVER DIES.

Effective line: But the seed itself will not let go of her. And she will not let go of it.
Suggested line: But the seed won't let go of her, and she won't let go of it.

Effective line: Thick, pulsing roots run from every wall into the chamber beyond: the Rotheart's lifelines. You could cut them. It will hurt, her more than you.
Suggested line: Thick, pulsing roots run from every wall into the chamber beyond: the Rotheart's lifelines. You could cut them, and it would hurt her far more than you.

Effective line: The roots keep pulsing. The Rotheart keeps its strength.
Suggested line: The roots keep pulsing, and the Rotheart keeps its strength.

Effective line: Her eyes are open. They are not hers.
Suggested line: Her eyes are open, but whatever is looking out of them isn't her.

Effective line: "I... am... THE... DUMP," she says, in many voices at once, sorrowful and enraged. "I am what you throw away. I am what grows back. I am HUNGRY."
Suggested line: "I... am... THE... DUMP," she says in many voices at once, grieving and furious. "I am WHAT YOU THROW AWAY... I am what GROWS BACK... and I am HUNGRY."

Effective line: I am what you throw away. I am what grows back. I am HUNGRY.
Suggested line: I AM what you throw away... I AM what grows back... and I am so... HUNGRY...

Effective line: Five cards drift through the spores. If enough of them are infrastructure, they will hold you steady. If not, the spores will sweeten your lungs.
Suggested line: Five cards drift through the spores. If enough of them are infrastructure they'll hold you steady; if not, the spores will settle sweetly in your lungs.

Effective line: A ring of pale mushrooms murmurs as you pass. "Stay," they say, in a thousand tiny voices. "Eat.
Suggested line: A ring of pale mushrooms murmurs as you pass. "Stay," they say in a thousand tiny voices, "and eat."

Effective line: Listen. Join."
Suggested line: "Listen," they add, softer. "Join us."

Effective line: They tell you things. Where the roots run, where the Rot is thin, where the Archdruid used to walk. You hold onto what you can.
Suggested line: They tell you where the roots run, where the Rot wears thin and where the Archdruid used to walk, and you hold on to as much as you can.

Effective line: It helps. It is not entirely your own thought.
Suggested line: It helps, though some of what you now know doesn't feel like your own thought.

Effective line: The mushrooms scream, very quietly. You pretend not to hear. A passing trader is delighted, and pays well.
Suggested line: The mushrooms scream very quietly as you pick them, and you pretend not to hear. A passing trader is delighted and pays well.

Effective line: The wall ahead pulses with a slow, wet heartbeat. A seam runs down the middle. Behind it, warm light.
Suggested line: The wall ahead pulses with a slow, wet heartbeat, and warm light leaks through a seam down its middle.

Effective line: The wall takes your hands, warm and wet. It hurts. Then it does not.
Suggested line: The wall takes your hands, warm and wet. It hurts for a moment, and then it doesn't.

Effective line: Roots grow along your arms, and, oddly, you feel better rooted in the world.
Suggested line: Fine roots creep along your arms and then let go, and oddly you feel steadier on your feet than you have in days.

Effective line: It bleeds sap and fury. A glittering stone falls out. It is worth a lot of gold, and a bit of your arm.
Suggested line: It bleeds sap and fury, and a glittering stone drops out of the cut. It'll fetch good gold, though it costs you a long scrape down one arm.

Effective line: You hear the vines settle overhead. For a moment, nothing moves beneath your feet.
Suggested line: Overhead the vines settle, and for a moment nothing moves beneath your feet.

Effective line: "...What a terrible dream," Compostella whispers. "The seed. It is still in my roots. It will not die, and I cannot make it."
Suggested line: "...What a terrible dream," Compostella whispers. "The seed is still in my roots, child. It won't die, and I can't make it."

Effective line: It is the seed. {villain}'s gift: life that never dies. When the great tree I grew up beneath fell, I could not bear it.
Suggested line: It's the seed, {villain}'s gift - life that never dies. I grew up beneath a great tree, child, and when she fell, I couldn't bear it.

Effective line: I planted the seed in her place. It took. It has been growing in my grief for ten years. Nothing here rots, because of me.
Suggested line: I planted the seed where she had stood, and it took. It's been feeding on my grief for ten years. Nothing here rots, and that's my doing.

Effective line: A seed that never dies isn't a gift. It's a grief that never ends. Let it rot.
Suggested line: Something that can never die isn't a gift. It's a grief that never gets to end. Let it rot.

Effective line: Everything I ever loved, I gave back to the soil. Except this one. I could not.
Suggested line: Everything I ever loved, I gave back to the soil when its time came. Everything except her.

Effective line: ...Then we let it die, together. Hold still. Hold me.
Suggested line: ...Then we let it die, together. Hold on to me while it goes.

Effective line: ...It is rotting. Honest compost, the first in ten years. Oh. I can hear the soil again.
Suggested line: ...It's rotting. Honest compost, the first in ten years. Oh, I can hear the soil again.

Effective line: The river's still lovely. Still a nightmare to climb out of. Some things healing can't fix.
Suggested line: River's still lovely, and still a nightmare to climb out of. Healing only goes so far.

Effective line: Compost sorts itself the normal way again. Slowly. With help. As it should.
Suggested line: Compost's rotting down the normal way again - slowly, with help, the way it should.

Effective line: The raccoon in the crown says thank you. He also wants your lunch. Still no.
Suggested line: The raccoon in the crown says thank you. He'd also like your lunch. I've told him no.

Effective line: New stairs. Same climb. Worth pausing on, now.
Suggested line: Same climb as ever, but the view's worth stopping for now.

Effective line: Every terrace a little greener. Even the top one. Especially the top one.
Suggested line: Every terrace is a little greener now, and the top one most of all.

Effective line: Archdruid's back on her rounds. She waters the weeds too. Says they had a rough decade.
Suggested line: Archdruid's back on her rounds. Waters the weeds too - says they've had a hard ten years.

Effective line: The trees went back to green overnight. Nobody's talking about that either, but happily.
Suggested line: Trees went back to their proper green overnight. Folk keep stopping just to look.

Effective line: Funny thing. The flowers smell like flowers again. I'd forgotten that was a smell.
Suggested line: Funny thing - the flowers smell like flowers again. I'd forgotten they had a smell.

Effective line: Nothing goes to waste. The Rot has gone. The doors may be opened again.
Suggested line: Nothing goes to waste. The Rot is gone, and the doors may be opened again.

Effective line: - Water things. They like it. They are only plants.
Suggested line: - Water the plants. They're only plants again, and they like it.

Effective line: To {town}. Moss Mulligan's thorn wall is mulch, and she says sorry again. Vines are just vines now. Still sort your boots.
Suggested line: To {town}. Moss Mulligan's thorn wall is mulch now, and she says sorry again. The vines are just vines, but please still sort your boots.

Effective line: Source of the sickness, now closed for healing. The vines are only vines. Mostly. Visitors welcome.
Suggested line: Source of the sickness, now closed for healing. The vines are only vines (mostly), and visitors are welcome.

Effective line: I never thought I'd say it: the Dump is healing. The vines are only vines, the mushrooms are only mushrooms, and the Archdruid is herself again. She is mortified.
Suggested line: I never thought I'd get to say it, but the Dump is healing. The vines are only vines, the mushrooms are only mushrooms, and the Archdruid is herself again. She's terribly embarrassed.

Effective line: Breathe in. Go on. You may breathe deeply now. That smell is honest compost.
Suggested line: Go on, breathe in. You can breathe deeply down here now, and that smell is HONEST COMPOST. Isn't it wonderful?

Effective line: This morning Compostella walked straight to the row of royal trees and planted a twelfth. She didn't say why.
Suggested line: This morning Compostella walked straight to the row of royal trees and planted a twelfth. She didn't say why, and I didn't like to ask.
