Effective line: She just smiled at you on the way past.
Suggested line: She only smiled at you on her way past. I've been wondering about that all morning.

Effective line: The stream is clean, the fields are calm and the zucchini has gone back to being a zucchini. Thank you. We owe you more than compost.
Suggested line: The stream's clean, the fields are calm and the zucchini has gone back to being a zucchini. We owe you a great deal more than compost.

Effective line: Granny Gristle, junk-trader! The shed is just a shed again. The turnips are only turnips.
Suggested line: Granny Gristle, junk-trader, back in business! The shed's just a shed again, dearie, and the turnips are only turnips.

Effective line: I had a little cry, then I planted a field. Shop's open, dearie. Welcome back to the sane side of farming. Heh!
Suggested line: I had a little cry, then I went and planted a whole field. Shop's open, dearie, and every bit of it was thrown out by somebody who was wrong. Heh!

Effective line: Billie Muckfoot, animal handler! The herd's back, and the goat's eating a sign.
Suggested line: Billie Muckfoot, animal handler! The whole herd's home, and the goat's already eating a sign.

Effective line: The sign's not eating back. I've never been so happy to see a goat ruin something.
Suggested line: And the sign isn't eating him back this time. I've never been so happy to watch a goat ruin something.

Effective line: Every animal present and entirely un-mutated. I could cry. I might.
Suggested line: Every animal's home and not one of them mutated. I could cry, honestly, and I might.

Effective line: Into a bucket. For the plants.
Suggested line: Into a bucket, though. The plants could use it.

Effective line: Archdruid Compostella. I am told what happened to the barn. I cannot remember doing it. The barn, I gather, remembers me. I will help put it right.
Suggested line: Archdruid Compostella, child, and yes, I've been told about the barn. I don't remember doing it, but I gather the barn remembers me, so I'll be helping to put it right.

Effective line: Ten years of the Rot in my roots. It spoke so quietly. It said I was needed. It said the whole world was waiting to grow.
Suggested line: The Rot sat in my roots for ten years and spoke so quietly. It told me I was needed, and that the whole world was waiting on me to grow.

Effective line: It was my own grief, wearing a seed. Thank you for helping me let it rot.
Suggested line: It was my own grief all along, dressed up as a seed. Thank you for helping me let it rot.

Effective line: The Dump will heal. The goat may take longer to trust me. Plant something, child. Anything. It will be glad of you.
Suggested line: The Dump will heal, though the goat may take a little longer to trust me. Plant something, child. Anything at all. It'll be glad of you.

Effective line: You are carrying a loss you cannot name yet, child. When you find its name, do not bury it in a jar. Death is not the end of them.
Suggested line: You're carrying a loss you can't name yet, child. When you find its name, don't shut it away in a jar the way I did. Death is not the end of them.

Effective line: It looks like the Archdruid. It is still growing. Please do not water.
Suggested line: It looks like the Archdruid, and it's still growing. Please do not water it.

Effective line: It used to be the Rot-Idol. Now it is topiary. Please do not water.
Suggested line: This used to be the Rot-Idol. It's only topiary now, but please still do not water it.

Effective line: The Groundskeeper's gone. Packed her shears and left for the Capital the moment the Archdruid woke.
Suggested line: The Groundskeeper's gone. She packed her shears and left for the Capital the very moment the Archdruid woke.

Effective line: She left one pair behind, in a compost heap. Granny Gristle is keeping them. 'Found, not stolen,' she says. Twice.
Suggested line: She left one pair behind in a compost heap, and Granny Gristle has kept them. 'Found, not stolen,' she told me, twice, before I'd even asked.

Effective line: Hear that? Things rotting properly again. Lovely sound. Means something's about to grow. Heh.
Suggested line: Hear that? Things rotting properly again. Lovely sound, that - it means something's about to grow.

Effective line: The Doppelganger is exposed, the Special Sauce is recalled, and the real Grand Chef is back in her kitchen. The golems guard plates again. Nobody leaves hungry.
Suggested line: The Doppelganger is exposed, the Special Sauce is recalled, and the real Grand Chef is back in her own kitchen with the golems guarding plates again. Nobody leaves hungry.

Effective line: The Rotheart is silent. The vines are only vines again. The Archdruid is herself and deeply apologetic about the barn. The land starts, slowly, to heal.
Suggested line: The Rotheart has gone silent and the vines are only vines again. The Archdruid is herself once more, deeply apologetic about the barn, and slowly the land begins to heal.

Effective line: The intake's open again, did you hear? Busy week! Gerald's number came up. Lovely chap. Brought his own mug.
Suggested line: The intake's open again, did you hear? Busy week. Gerald's number finally came up, lovely chap, and he brought his own mug for the journey.

Effective line: Agnes stayed, of course. Somebody has to fix the forms. I've put her down for later. Much later. Heh.
Suggested line: Agnes stayed on, of course. Somebody has to fix the forms, and I've pencilled her in for later. Much later. Heh.

Effective line: Freeing a zone loosens something in your head. Whenever it does, go and tell Elder Maren.
Suggested line: Every zone you free seems to shake something loose in your memory. Each time it happens, go and tell Elder Maren; she'll want to hear it.

Effective line: Checked my book. You're not in it. Not for a good long while. Heh.
Suggested line: Checked my book. You're not in it, not for a good long while. Heh.

Effective line: Business has been slow for ten years. Not my fault. Paperwork. Heh.
Suggested line: Business has been ever so slow these ten years. Paperwork, not me. Heh.

Effective line: You're pale. Sit, sit. Something came back to you, didn't it?
Suggested line: You've gone pale as flour. Sit down, sit. Something's come back to you, hasn't it?

Effective line: Tell me. All of it, however small.
Suggested line: Tell me all of it, however small it seems. The small things are usually the ones that matter.

Effective line: Light. Four colors of it, warm as bathwater, spilling across a ceiling I can't quite see.
Suggested line: There's light, four colors of it, warm as bathwater, spilling across a ceiling I can't quite see.

Effective line: A woman is humming. A tune with no words, rising and falling like breathing.
Suggested line: A woman is humming a tune with no words, and it rises and falls like someone breathing in their sleep.

Effective line: A hand rests on my head. Gentle. Certain. It smells of lavender and woodsmoke.
Suggested line: A hand rests on my head, gentle and certain, and it smells of lavender and woodsmoke.

Effective line: ...A lullaby. That tune is from the old days. From the court. Few remember it, and fewer hum it.
Suggested line: ...A lullaby. That tune is from the old days, from the court, and there are very few left who remember it. Fewer still who'd hum it.

Effective line: Eat some pie. Don't ask me why my eyes are wet.
Suggested line: Have some pie. And don't ask me why my eyes are wet, because I won't tell you.

Effective line: And look at you. With a zone free, the corruption's grip on the land is slipping, and it is slipping off you with it.
Suggested line: And look at you. With one zone free, the corruption's grip on the land is slipping, and it's slipping off you along with it.

Effective line: You should be able to carry a second Path now. Go on, try it at the Deck Station.
Suggested line: You ought to be able to carry a second Path now. Go to the Deck Station and try building a deck with two; I'd like to hear how it feels.

Effective line: One zone free and back for pie already. Fine. One slice per zone, dearie. Those are the rules now.
Suggested line: One zone free and you're back for pie already. Fine, but it's one slice per zone from now on, dearie. I've just made that rule.

Effective line: Three roads still shut. I'd go myself, dearie, but I'd arrive next spring.
Suggested line: Three roads are still shut. I'd see to them myself, dearie, but at my pace I'd arrive next spring.

Effective line: The square sang last night. Badly. Best thing I've heard in ten years. Don't you dare tell them.
Suggested line: The square sang last night, and badly. It was the best thing I've heard in ten years, so don't you dare tell them.

Effective line: One zone free. Hm. And the old cottage at the end of Champions' Road has started cheering at night. From the cellar. I am choosing not to ask.
Suggested line: One zone free. Hm. And the old cottage at the end of Champions' Road has started cheering at night, from somewhere down in the cellar. I've decided not to ask.

Effective line: You freed a whole Path. On your own. With a deck you'd known for a week.
Suggested line: You freed a whole Path on your own, with a deck you've only had for a week.

Effective line: Let me see your hands. Steadier. Good. That's the first thing I've been able to tick off in a long time.
Suggested line: Let me see your hands. Steadier than they were. Good. That's the first thing I've been able to tick off my list in a long time.

Effective line: Still a friend. Still all I can give you.
Suggested line: A friend. That's still all I can tell you, and I'm sorry it isn't more.

Effective line: I'm not staying in town. The old woman with the shell looks at me like I owe her a pie.
Suggested line: I'm not coming into town. The old woman with the shell looks at me like I owe her something, and she's probably right.

Effective line: Keep going. I'll know when the next one falls. The woods go quiet when a Path comes loose.
Suggested line: Keep going. I'll know when the next one falls, because the woods go quiet whenever a Path comes loose.

Effective line: Another one. Don't hide it behind your teacup. Say it.
Suggested line: Another one, is it? Don't hide behind your teacup, dearie. Just say it.

Effective line: White rooms. White light that never changes with the hour.
Suggested line: White rooms, and a white light that never changes, whatever the hour.

Effective line: They never use my name. They call me 'the Subject.' They say 'again.'
Suggested line: No one there ever uses my name. They call me 'the Subject', and whatever I do, they only say 'again.'

Effective line: Glass, and coats, and 'again.' So that is where you have been.
Suggested line: Glass, and white coats, and 'again.' So that's where you've been all this time.

Effective line: You have earned the truth, so here is the first piece of it: I am not only a tortoise who bakes.
Suggested line: You've earned some truth from me, so here's the first piece of it: I'm not just an old tortoise who bakes.

Effective line: There is a resistance in this kingdom, and I am its contact in {town}. Wren leads it, from a hideout in the Capital.
Suggested line: There's a resistance in this kingdom, and I'm its contact here in {town}. A woman called Wren leads it, from a hideout in the Capital.

Effective line: I wasn't sure of you before. I am sure now. Mostly.
Suggested line: I wasn't sure of you before. I am now, near enough, and I don't say that about many people.

Effective line: Two zones free. The square's louder now. I complain about it every morning and mean none of it.
Suggested line: Two zones free, and the square's louder for it. I complain about the noise every morning and don't mean a word of it.

Effective line: Auntie Alembic keeps asking after you. I tell her you're busy. For once it's even true.
Suggested line: Auntie Alembic keeps asking after you. I tell her you're busy, and for once it's even true.

Effective line: Two zones free. Auntie Alembic has opened her shop on the square, the Alchemist's.
Suggested line: Two zones free, and Auntie Alembic has opened the Alchemist's on the square. She brews cards from two Paths at once, if you can stand the steam.

Effective line: She asks for your leftovers. From her, that is a compliment.
Suggested line: She's been asking for your leftovers. From her, that's a compliment.

Effective line: Two Paths. People in town are singing again. Badly, but they're singing.
Suggested line: Two Paths free, and I could hear the town singing from all the way out here. Badly, but singing.

Effective line: Even when you were someone who couldn't. Ask me something easier.
Suggested line: Even when you were somewhere you weren't allowed to leave. Ask me something easier.

Effective line: You're shaking. Sit. Slowly now.
Suggested line: You're shaking. Sit down, slowly now. Here, take my hand.

Effective line: A throne room at night. Candles guttering, banners with four colors woven as one.
Suggested line: A throne room at night, the candles guttering under banners with four colors woven into one.

Effective line: A man in white and gold kneels before the king. Soft voice. Then he stands.
Suggested line: A man in white and gold kneels before the king and speaks in a soft voice. Then he rises, and his soft voice is the last soft thing in the room.

Effective line: Hands on my shoulders. Two people pushing me behind them, toward the dark.
Suggested line: Two pairs of hands are on my shoulders, pushing me behind them, toward the dark.

Effective line: I know that man's face. I have always known it. {villain}.
Suggested line: I know that man's face, and I think I have always known it. {villain}.

Effective line: A man in white and gold, kneeling, and then standing. And a lab with glass on every side.
Suggested line: A man in white and gold, kneeling and then standing. And before that, those rooms with glass on every side.

Effective line: I know that glass, because I helped to blow it. I founded the study of the Paths, long ago, for the best of reasons.
Suggested line: I know that glass, because I helped to blow it. Long ago I founded the study of the Paths, and I did it for the best of reasons.

Effective line: {villain} took my work and turned it into a cage. My best student kept the lab running for him. And I ran.
Suggested line: {villain} took my work and made a cage of it, and my best student kept the lab running for him. And I ran.

Effective line: I have been hiding here ever since, with my hands in pie dough, where nobody would ask what else they had made.
Suggested line: I've been hiding here ever since, with my hands in pie dough, where nobody would think to ask what else those hands had made.

Effective line: That is my secret. Now you hold it, the same as I hold yours.
Suggested line: That's my secret. Now you're holding it, the same way I've been holding yours.

Effective line: One Path left under {villain}'s thumb. The whole town is holding its breath. I can hold mine for a week. They cannot.
Suggested line: One Path left under {villain}'s thumb, and the whole town's holding its breath. I can hold mine for a week, being a tortoise. They can't.

Effective line: Three zones free, dearie. Finish the fourth before my pie goes stale. That gives you about a week.
Suggested line: Three zones free, dearie. Do finish the fourth before this pie goes stale; I'd give it about a week.

Effective line: You walk like somebody with somewhere to be now. I preferred the damp young man. He visited more.
Suggested line: You walk like somebody with somewhere to be these days. I liked the damp young man better. He visited more.

Effective line: Three zones free. Only one Path left under {villain}'s thumb. I will not say what I'm feeling. I will say it is a lot of feelings.
Suggested line: Three zones free. Only one Path is left under {villain}'s thumb now, and I won't tell you what I'm feeling about it, except that it's a great deal.

Effective line: Three. I used to think you were someone else. Someone I lost when we were kids. Now I'm starting to think...
Suggested line: Three. At first I told myself you just reminded me of someone. Someone I lost when we were kids. Now I'm starting to think...

Effective line: No. Not until I'm certain. Too many people around here say things before they're certain.
Suggested line: No, not until I'm certain. Too many people around here say things before they're sure, and I won't be one of them.

Effective line: You knew me. Before.
Suggested line: You knew me before all this.

Effective line: There is something in your face today. The look of someone who has been handed a key. Tell me.
Suggested line: There's something in your face today, the look of someone who's just been handed a key. Tell me what it opens.

Effective line: A boy of eleven, in a coat too fine for the cold. Someone calls across a courtyard: '{prince}!'
Suggested line: A boy of eleven stands in a coat too fine for the cold. Someone calls across a courtyard: '{prince}!'

Effective line: I turn. A woman's voice. A man's voice. The {royal_house} crest on every door: four signs in a ring.
Suggested line: I turn toward a woman's voice, and then a man's, and on every door is the {royal_house} crest: four signs in a ring.

Effective line: {prince_full}. The son of the king and queen. Presumed dead.
Suggested line: {prince_full}, son of the king and queen. The whole kingdom believes he died ten years ago.

Effective line: And I knew. The Warden opens that tunnel for one family only. I knew the moment you walked out of it, and I was too frightened to say so.
Suggested line: I knew, you see. The Warden opens that tunnel for one family only, and I knew it the moment you walked out of it. I was too frightened to say so.

Effective line: Four signs in a ring. The same as on my stick. I have carried it for ten years and told nobody why.
Suggested line: Four signs in a ring, the same as the ones carved on my stick. I've carried it for ten years and never told a soul why.

Effective line: And my lab, my life's work, was used on that boy. Forgive me, if you ever can.
Suggested line: And my lab, my life's work, was used on that boy. On you. Forgive me if you ever can. I'd understand if you couldn't.

Effective line: There is nothing to forgive. You gave me a bed and pie when you thought I might be a spy.
Suggested line: There's nothing to forgive. You gave me a bed and pie when you still thought I might be a spy.

Effective line: You have the look of someone who was told something he did not want to hear. {villain}?
Suggested line: You've the look of someone who was told something he didn't want to hear. Was it {villain}?

Effective line: Sit. Tell me what he said.
Suggested line: Sit down and tell me what he said. All of it.

Effective line: So he knew you from the first. He told you, and you came to me for the rest.
Suggested line: So he knew you from the very first. He told you who you are, and you've come to me for the rest of it.

Effective line: I knew too, dearie. The Warden opens that tunnel for one family only. I knew, and I was too frightened to say it.
Suggested line: I knew too. The Warden opens that tunnel for one family only, and I knew it the moment you came out of it. I was just too frightened to say so.

Effective line: So hear it from the one who held your hand at court: you are {prince_full}, and I am so sorry for what was done to you in my name.
Suggested line: So hear it from someone who held your hand at court: you are {prince_full}, and I'm so sorry for what was done to you with the things I built.

Effective line: All four Paths free, and {villain} still sitting in his castle. Go and knock, dearie. Loudly.
Suggested line: All four Paths free, and {villain} still sitting in his castle as if nothing's changed. Go and knock, dearie. Loudly.

Effective line: The roads are open. Even I use them. I passed a hare this morning. He has asked for a recount.
Suggested line: The roads are open, and even I've been using them. I passed a hare this morning; he's asked for a recount.

Effective line: Eat something first. Then the castle. Nobody topples a tyrant well on an empty stomach.
Suggested line: Eat something first, then go to the castle. Nobody ever toppled a tyrant properly on an empty stomach.

Effective line: All four Paths are free. {kingdom} is whole again, or nearly. And up in his castle, {villain} is counting what he has left.
Suggested line: All four Paths are free, and {kingdom} is whole again, or nearly. Up in his castle, {villain} will be counting what he has left.

Effective line: Rest. Then we finish this.
Suggested line: Get some rest. Then we finish this, together.

Effective line: All four. The kingdom is breathing again. Like voices through a wall, except the wall is coming down.
Suggested line: All four. Can you hear it? The kingdom's breathing again, like voices through a wall, except now the wall's coming down.

Effective line: Far away in {town}, the Old Well hums like a full kettle. Both streams have answered. Go back to the well.
Suggested line: Far away in {town}, the Old Well hums like a full kettle. Both streams have answered, and the well is calling you back.

Effective line: A well with opinions. Fine. I'm keeping the bottle.
Suggested line: A well with opinions. I'm keeping the bottle anyway.

Effective line: I always thought the key was lost. It was not, dearie. Somebody hid it in a chest in this very town. Find it, and we will see what the door is for.
Suggested line: I always thought the key was lost, but it wasn't, dearie. Somebody hid it in a chest right here in town. Find it, and we'll see what the door is for.

Effective line: The key is in a hidden chest in town. Look in the odd corners, dearie. This town has never quite managed a straight one.
Suggested line: The key's in a hidden chest somewhere in town. Look in the odd corners, dearie; this town has never quite managed a straight one.

Effective line: You found it. Look at the bow: four little carvings, in a ring. Hm. Never mind. I am too old for stairs, dearie. You are not.
Suggested line: You found it. Look at the bow: four little carvings in a ring. Hm. Never mind that. I'm too old for stairs, dearie, and you're not.

Effective line: The iron hatch beside the well. Go on. Whatever is under it belonged to the Old Kingdom, not to me. Mind the stairs.
Suggested line: The door's the iron hatch beside the well. Go on down. Whatever's under it belonged to the Old Kingdom, not to me, so mind the stairs.

Effective line: A giant chest was too good to be true. Someone is conning travellers with them, and he took your gold. Find the chests, and find him.
Suggested line: That giant chest was too good to be true. Someone is conning travellers with chests like it, and he's taken your gold. Find the rest of the chests, and you'll find him.

Effective line: Far away, a great lock ground open. A hidden lever in every Path zone answers a seal somewhere near Crosspath. Find them all.
Suggested line: Somewhere far off, a great lock has ground open. Each Path zone hides a lever that answers a seal near Crosspath. Find all four.

Effective line: You found me! Nobody finds me. Which means this is a trick. Mine.
Suggested line: You found me! Nobody finds me, which can only mean this is a trick. Mine, obviously.

Effective line: One seal. One Path. The hand is real. Show me the rest of it.
Suggested line: One seal for one Path, and the hand is real. Show me the rest of it.

Effective line: The last seal opens. The Paths agreed to bury this. They also agreed you might come.
Suggested line: The last seal opens. The four Paths agreed to bury this, and they agreed that one day you might come for it.

Effective line: Find the hideout through the manhole near the gate. Help the Wrinkles, one quest per Path; seal rifts and reach {villain}'s Castle at the north end. Each freed Path mends a broken city service.
Suggested line: Find the Wrinkles' hideout: knock at the manhole near the gate. Help them with one quest for each Path, seal the rifts, and reach {villain}'s Castle at the north end. Each Path you free mends a broken city service.

Effective line: Ow! The Capital has hurt you again. (-HP)
Suggested line: The Capital catches you hard, the way it catches everyone. (-HP)

Effective line: 'Dragged you in by the collar. Correction fee is yours. Drink. Then we can discuss your habit of arriving unconscious.'
Suggested line: 'I dragged you in by the collar, and the correction fee comes out of your purse. Drink. Then we can talk about this habit you have of arriving unconscious.'

Effective line: 'Falling in the approved queue area: minor offence. Fine payable. Stand up, citizen. I cannot measure you along the ground.'
Suggested line: 'Falling down in the approved queue area is a minor offence, and the fine is payable now. Up you get, citizen. I cannot measure you while you are lying along the ground.'

Effective line: You are through the walls. Somewhere a loudspeaker clears its throat. You are now, officially, a Visitor in {capital}, the Capital of {kingdom}.
Suggested line: You're through the walls. Somewhere above you a loudspeaker clears its throat, and you are now, officially, a Visitor in {capital}, the Capital of {kingdom}.

Effective line: You crawl out through the old tunnel and push the rubble aside. The Outskirts again, and a long way from anybody's approved queue.
Suggested line: You crawl out through the old tunnel and shove the rubble aside, and you're back in the Outskirts, a long way from anybody's approved queue.

Effective line: You push past rubble and a toppled statue. You find stairs and read an old plaque: 'THE OLD JOINT WORKS. BUILT BY ALL FOUR PATHS, TOGETHER.'
Suggested line: Past the rubble and a toppled statue, a flight of stairs leads down to an old plaque: 'THE OLD JOINT WORKS. BUILT BY ALL FOUR PATHS, TOGETHER.'

Effective line: The tunnel runs under the wall, under the gate and under every one of {villain}'s checkpoints. You walk under them all. It is the best moment you have had all day.
Suggested line: The tunnel runs under the wall, under the gate and under every one of {villain}'s checkpoints, and you walk beneath them all without being measured once. It's the best moment you've had all day.

Effective line: A manhole by the wall, with a scratch on its lid like a tiny wrinkle. You knock three times, for no reason you can name.
Suggested line: There's a manhole by the wall with a scratch on its lid, like a tiny wrinkle. You knock three times, for no reason you can name.

Effective line: A pause. Then the lid lifts and a hand beckons. A voice mutters, 'Wrinkle?' You decide that, yes, you are.
Suggested line: After a pause the lid lifts and a hand beckons you down. 'Wrinkle?' a voice mutters, and you decide that, yes, you probably are.

Effective line: Already improved. He has a moustache now. He looks, for the first time, like a person.
Suggested line: Someone has already improved this one. With the moustache he looks, for the first time, like a person.

Effective line: You post a complaint. 'Noted,' says the box, gently. You wait. That appears to have been the whole service.
Suggested line: You post a complaint. 'Noted,' says the box, gently, and after a long wait you understand that this was the whole service.

Effective line: You post a complaint. A klaxon sounds. A Perfection Inspector appears from nowhere, measures your frown, writes you up and walks off.
Suggested line: You post a complaint, and a klaxon sounds. A Perfection Inspector appears from nowhere, measures your frown, writes you up and walks off.

Effective line: The box rattles. It is full. It has had enough of your feedback for one visit.
Suggested line: The box rattles, full to the slot. It has had quite enough of your feedback for one visit.

Effective line: This one is too big. It runs all the way up into the castle. It will have to close when he does.
Suggested line: This one is too big to seal. It runs all the way up into the castle, and it will only close when he does.

Effective line: A banished compost heap, hiding in a cellar where it was not allowed to be. It is warm. It is alive.
Suggested line: A banished compost heap is hiding in a cellar where it was never allowed to be, still warm and still very much alive.

Effective line: An old glass jar with one seed in it. The seed is glowing very faintly green. Nobody has planted anything in the Capital for ten years. It has not given up.
Suggested line: An old glass jar holds a single seed, glowing very faintly green. Nobody has planted anything in the Capital for ten years, and the seed hasn't given up.

Effective line: The second wheel has been turning since some of its runners were too small to reach the pedals. A foreman's whistle hangs from a hook. You pocket it.
Suggested line: The second wheel has been turning since some of its runners were too small to reach the pedals. A foreman's whistle hangs on a hook nearby, and you pocket it.

Effective line: The third wheel's crew are children in school caps. 'It is a school activity,' says a banner. Nobody has rung the bell.
Suggested line: The third wheel's crew are children in school caps. 'It is a school activity,' says a banner, but nobody has rung the bell in years.

Effective line: You pull the lever, break the wheel's rhythm and get them off. They are very small and very proud and they will not stop saying 'Rollo sent you?'.
Suggested line: You pull the lever and lift them down one by one. They're very small and very proud, and they keep asking, 'Did Rollo send you?'

Effective line: This crew is free. They are lying on the ground, looking at the sky. It is the best they have felt in ten years.
Suggested line: This crew is free. They're lying on their backs looking up at the sky, and it's the best they've felt in ten years.

Effective line: The Pell plot is tended and quiet. Fresh flowers. The family comes every morning now.
Suggested line: The Pell plot is tended and quiet, with fresh flowers on it. The family comes every morning now.

Effective line: The iron gate is sealed with a notice: 'NO BURIAL WITHOUT A STAMPED PERMIT (FORM 27-B/6, FINAL APPROVAL).' You have no stamp. Widow Pell said something about a stamp, hidden somewhere in Grave Row.
Suggested line: The iron gate is sealed with a notice: 'NO BURIAL WITHOUT A STAMPED PERMIT (FORM 27-B/6, FINAL APPROVAL).' Widow Pell said a stamp was hidden in Grave Row, north of the permit office.

Effective line: 'Form 27-C requires Form 27-B.' 'Form 27-B requires Form 27-C.' 'It is a loop,' you say.
Suggested line: 'Form 27-C requires Form 27-B,' she says, 'and Form 27-B requires Form 27-C.' You point out, gently, that this is a loop.

Effective line: Every citizen shall run the wheels for six hours a day. The wheels never stop. The lights never go out. Your legs are not your own.
Suggested line: Every citizen shall run the wheels for six hours a day, so that the wheels never stop and the lights never go out. Your legs are not your own.

Effective line: Same as yesterday. Same as tomorrow. You may stop consulting the menu.
Suggested line: The same as yesterday and the same as tomorrow. You may stop consulting the menu.

Effective line: To the Crease. There is a smell of cooking down there. Real cooking. Nobody mentions it.
Suggested line: To the Crease. There's a smell of real cooking coming up this shaft, and nobody ever mentions it.

Effective line: Closed. Forgotten. Not on any map. (Try the south-west corner.)
Suggested line: Closed and forgotten, and on nobody's map. (Try the south-west corner.)

Effective line: Founded by people {villain} could not iron out. No dues. No forms. No smiling.
Suggested line: Founded by the people {villain} could not iron out. No dues, no forms, and nobody here has to smile.

Effective line: Another one through the shafts. Sit. I am Wren. I was Royal Archivist, once. Now I keep the records this city is not supposed to have.
Suggested line: Another one through the shafts. Sit down. I'm Wren; I was the Royal Archivist once, and now I keep the records this city isn't supposed to have.

Effective line: Maren sent word from {town} that someone might come. This is the Crease. We are the Wrinkles: the people {villain} could not iron out. We have tea and grudges. The tea is better.
Suggested line: Maren sent word from {town} that someone might come. This is the Crease, and we're the Wrinkles, the people {villain} couldn't iron out. We have tea and grudges. The tea's better.

Effective line: He is in the castle at the north end, and he truly believes he is helping. That is the hard part. Talk to the streets. Each of them holds a piece of him.
Suggested line: He's in the castle at the north end, and he truly believes he's helping, which is the hard part. Talk to the people in the streets. Each of them carries a piece of what he did, and I want it all in the record.

Effective line: The records say he began well. His first decree put a hot lunch in front of every schoolchild. Remember that. It excuses nothing.
Suggested line: The records say he began well. His first decree put a hot lunch in front of every schoolchild, and I want you to remember that. It excuses nothing, but remember it.

Effective line: You brought me something from the streets. It goes in the true record, in ink, where he cannot correct it.
Suggested line: You brought me something from the streets. It goes in the true record, in ink, where he can't correct it.

Effective line: Two pieces of him now. A man who needs to be right. A man who cannot bear to be disagreed with. I can almost see his shape.
Suggested line: That's two pieces of him now: a man who needs to be right, and a man who can't bear to be disagreed with. I can almost see his shape.

Effective line: Three. He is afraid, you know. Not of you.
Suggested line: That's three. He's afraid, you know, and not of you.

Effective line: Of everything that will not obey. A small, sad fear, for a man with so much gold.
Suggested line: He's afraid of everything that won't obey him. It's a small, sad fear for a man with so much gold.

Effective line: All four. I have the whole of him now. He is not a monster.
Suggested line: That's all four, and I have the whole of him now. He is not a monster.

Effective line: He is a man who made a list of everything he could not control, and made it illegal.
Suggested line: He's a man who made a list of everything he couldn't control, and then made it illegal.

Effective line: Hesper Dray. Nurse. Sit. Drink.
Suggested line: Hesper Dray. I'm the nurse down here, so do as I say: sit, and drink.

Effective line: Tea. Strong, bitter, unapproved. Drink while it is still three things the Ministry dislikes.
Suggested line: It's tea, strong and bitter and unapproved. Drink it while it's still three things the Ministry dislikes.

Effective line: The rifts? His hold is failing. Everything he forced together keeps coming apart, and he keeps stitching.
Suggested line: The rifts? That's his hold failing. Everything he forced together keeps coming apart at the seams, and he keeps stitching.

Effective line: Shh. Keep it down. Old Fern. Composter.
Suggested line: Keep your voice down, will you? I'm Old Fern. Composter, which in this city is about the worst thing a person can be.

Effective line: I turned this city's waste back into soil. Now that's 'untidy', and so am I. Criminally untidy. Worms in my hat to prove it.
Suggested line: I spent forty years turning this city's scraps back into soil, and now that's 'untidy'. So am I, apparently. I've got worms in my hat to prove it.

Effective line: They shoved the rubbish behind the facade and called it 'Behind'. The land's sick. Nothing grows. Help me save what's left.
Suggested line: They swept the rubbish behind the facade and pretended it wasn't there. Now the soil's sick, nothing grows in the Reek, and I'm too old to dig alone. Help me save what's left.

Effective line: Any luck? The heaps are in cellars and holes all over the Reek. They think they're hiding. They're being rescued.
Suggested line: Any luck? The heaps are tucked into cellars and holes all over the Reek. They think they're hiding from the inspectors. Tell them they're coming home.

Effective line: Oh. A visitor. Forgive me, I've forgotten how this goes. I am Widow Pell. My husband died three years ago, in his chair in the front parlour.
Suggested line: Oh, you've come to the door. Forgive me, it's been a long while since anyone did. I'm Widow Pell. My husband died three years ago, in his chair in the front parlour.

Effective line: I cannot bury him. Form 27-B needs Form 27-C, and 27-C needs 27-B. He has waited in his chair for three years.
Suggested line: And I can't bury him. Form 27-B needs a 27-C, and the 27-C needs a 27-B, so he's still in his chair, waiting, the way he always used to wait for me.

Effective line: I talk to him in the parlour. He was always the patient one. I'm not, it turns out. Please, if you can help.
Suggested line: I still talk to him in there. He was always the patient one of us, and it turns out I'm not. If you can help at all, please.

Effective line: The stamp, remember. Someone hid the Stamp of Final Approval where nobody official would look: somewhere in Grave Row, among papers nobody reads.
Suggested line: Someone hid the Stamp of Final Approval where no official would ever look: in Grave Row, north of the permit office, among papers nobody reads.

Effective line: Rollo Spokes... foreman. Beefcake. Learned the wheels... in the Gainlands. Back then, a wheel stopped at night.
Suggested line: Name's Rollo Spokes... wheel foreman, Beefcake, out of the Gainlands. Back home... a wheel stopped at night... and so did the man on it.

Effective line: Now the facade needs light... so we pedal. Free. Forever. We were told... it was cardio. My calves have calves.
Suggested line: Here, the facade needs lighting... so we pedal it. No pay, no end. They told us it was cardio... My calves have calves.

Effective line: My crews run six hours a day... for ten years. Nobody's told them they can stop. Somebody ought to.
Suggested line: My crews have pedalled six hours a day for ten years... and nobody's ever told them they can stop. Somebody ought to... somebody they'll believe.

Effective line: Three wheels... pull the brakes. And that big cable by the east wall... feeds the facade. Cut it.
Suggested line: Three wheels in the Yards... pull each brake and talk to the crew. Then the big cable by the east wall, the one that feeds the facade... cut it.

Effective line: The crews won't stop... till somebody says it's all right. You say it.
Suggested line: The crews won't get off... till somebody tells them it's all right to. So you tell them... and mean it.

Effective line: Hands where I can see them. Good. Chef Marlo. Once of the Market of the Four Paths. Now a 'Nutrient Distributor'. Recipes stay in my apron.
Suggested line: Hands where I can see them... good, no inspector's gloves. I'm Chef Marlo. I cooked at the Market of the Four Paths, once. Now I'm a 'Nutrient Distributor', and my recipes stay in my apron.

Effective line: Three recipe cards, hidden in the quarter. And the dispenser: give it a good kick from me. Spoil it. Spoil it badly.
Suggested line: Three recipe cards, tucked away around the quarter, and then the dispenser. Spoil it for me, and spoil it badly. I've waited ten years to say that.

Effective line: Entry requires the Approved Visitor Standard. You are too tall. You are too short. Your shadow is the wrong length.
Suggested line: Entry requires the Approved Visitor Standard. You are somehow both too tall and too short, and your shadow is the wrong length.

Effective line: However. The Standard has a provision: the Entry Examination. A card battle. Win it, and you are, retroactively, approved.
Suggested line: However, the Standard provides for an Entry Examination, conducted as a card battle. Win it, and you are retroactively approved.

Effective line: You again. Still too tall. Still smiling at the wrong angle. Ready for the Examination?
Suggested line: You again, still too tall and still smiling at the wrong angle. Are you ready for the Examination?

Effective line: I have measured twelve thousand visitors. I approved four. Nine thousand were sent home. The rest, I will not say.
Suggested line: I have measured twelve thousand visitors and approved four. Nine thousand were sent home. About the rest, I would rather not say.

Effective line: Height inspection! Stand against the post. Straighten.
Suggested line: Height inspection! Stand against the post, please, and straighten up.

Effective line: Not that straight. Hm. You are one hair above regulation.
Suggested line: Not that straight. Hm... you are one hair above regulation.

Effective line: One hair. I will let it go. This time. Do not grow.
Suggested line: One hair, I will let go, this time. Please do not grow while you are inside.

Effective line: Queue management. The approved queue is this queue. You are in it.
Suggested line: Queue management! This is the approved queue, and you are already in it.

Effective line: Exit control. You are leaving? You have not arrived. Please arrive first.
Suggested line: Exit control. You wish to leave? But you have not finished arriving. Please arrive first.

Effective line: Exit control. Please have your exit permit ready. Please have your exit interview permit ready. Please have a reason.
Suggested line: Exit control. Please have your exit permit ready, and your exit interview permit, and, if at all possible, a reason.

Effective line: Citizen 4471. I smiled incorrectly. Eleven degrees. The approved angle is eight.
Suggested line: I am Citizen 4471. I was brought here for smiling incorrectly. Eleven degrees, when the approved angle is eight.

Effective line: It was my wife's wedding. I had been crying. They corrected me.
Suggested line: It was our wedding day. I had been crying, the happy kind, and they corrected me for that too.

Effective line: I do not smile any more. Not at all. It is a strange thing, to forget how a face works.
Suggested line: I do not smile at all any more. It is a strange thing, to forget how your own face works.

Effective line: Please. A burial permit is all we want: Form 27-B/6, stamped Final Approval.
Suggested line: All we want is a burial permit: Form 27-B/6, stamped Final Approval, and then he can finally rest.

Effective line: Somebody hid the Stamp of Final Approval in Grave Row, among papers nobody reads. Find it, bring it to our family plot at the north end of Grave Row, and let him rest.
Suggested line: Somebody hid the Stamp of Final Approval in Grave Row, north of the permit office, among papers nobody reads. Find it, take it to our family plot at the north end of the Row, and let him rest.

Effective line: The stamp is somewhere in Grave Row, among papers nobody reads. Then the plot, at the north end of the Row. Please.
Suggested line: The stamp's in Grave Row, north of the permit office, among papers nobody reads. Then bring it to our plot at the north end of the Row. Please.

Effective line: Here. This was his. He'd want a young person to have it.
Suggested line: Here, this was his. He'd want it to go to someone young, who'll use it.

Effective line: And something about the man in the castle. He schedules grief. Thursdays, 3:00 to 3:05. Anyone who cries outside those hours is corrected.
Suggested line: There's something you should know about the man in the castle. He schedules grief: Thursdays, 3:00 to 3:05. Anyone who cries outside those hours is corrected.

Effective line: Thank you, a hundred times. We're at the plot every morning. What I told you is in your journal: he cannot stand a sadness he did not schedule.
Suggested line: Thank you, a hundred times over. I sit with him at the plot every morning now. Remember what I told you, it's in your journal: he can't bear a sadness he didn't schedule.

Effective line: Three wheels in the Transit Yards... three crews nobody ever told to stop. Pull their brake levers... take the foreman's whistle... tell them it's all right.
Suggested line: Three wheels in the Transit Yards... three crews nobody ever told to stop. Pull each brake lever... and tell them it's all right, in plain words.

Effective line: They won't believe you. Say it anyway. And cut the big cable by the east wall. The facade's lights have lived on my crews' legs for ten years.
Suggested line: They won't believe you at first... say it anyway. Then cut the big cable by the east wall. Those facade lights have run on my crews' legs... for ten years.

Effective line: Three wheels in the Transit Yards... free the crews. Cut the big cable by the east wall. Keep telling them they can stop.
Suggested line: Three wheels in the Transit Yards... free the crews, then cut the big cable by the east wall. Keep telling them they can stop... it takes a few goes.

Effective line: Heard the lights flicker from here. Heard the crews sit down. The whole yard... quiet.
Suggested line: I heard the lights flicker from here... then I heard the crews sit down. The whole yard's gone quiet.

Effective line: And something about him. He made lateness illegal. A man who cannot wait for anyone.
Suggested line: One thing about the man in the castle... he made lateness illegal. That's a man who can't bear to wait... for anyone.

Effective line: Wheels are slow. Crews are resting. What I said is in your journal: to him, lateness is disagreement, and disagreement is the one thing he won't forgive.
Suggested line: The wheels are slowing... and the crews are resting. Remember what I told you, it's in your journal: to him, lateness is disagreement... and that's the one thing he won't forgive.

Effective line: And the paste dispenser by the east wall: spoil it. Give it a very bad day.
Suggested line: And the paste dispenser here in the quarter: spoil it for me. Put something in it that tastes of something.

Effective line: Three recipe cards in the Hungry Quarter, and the dispenser to spoil. 'Some' of this, 'a bit' of that. Always a good recipe.
Suggested line: Three recipe cards in the Hungry Quarter, and the dispenser to spoil. You'll know my cards: 'some' of this, 'a bit' of that. That's how a good recipe reads.

Effective line: Look at the stains. Look at the spelling. And that smell from the dispenser: cabbage. Real cabbage.
Suggested line: Look at the stains on them, look at the spelling! And that smell from the dispenser... cabbage. Real cabbage.

Effective line: I am crying. Let me. Here: my real recipe, the one I never dared write down until today.
Suggested line: I'm crying, and you'll let me. Here: my real recipe, the one I never dared write down until today.

Effective line: And something about him. He cannot taste. Not food, not wine, not salt. He never could.
Suggested line: And one thing about the man in the castle: he can't taste. Not food, not wine, not salt. He never could.

Effective line: I'm cooking again. Real food, real mess. What I told you is in your journal: he made everyone eat what he could not taste.
Suggested line: I'm cooking again, real food with a real mess. Remember what I told you, it's in your journal: he made everyone eat what he couldn't taste.

Effective line: Three compost heaps are hiding in the Reek, in cellars and under floors, where they were told to wait. Rescue them. They're alive.
Suggested line: Three compost heaps are hiding in the Reek, in cellars and yards and under floors, where they were told to wait. Rescue them. They're alive, whatever the inspectors say.

Effective line: And there's an old seed in a jar somewhere nearby. Plant it in the Sick Patch, in the Reek. Nobody's planted a thing here in ten years.
Suggested line: And there's a jar of old seed somewhere in the Reek. Plant it in the Sick Patch. Nobody's planted a thing in this city for ten years.

Effective line: Three compost heaps and one jarred seed in the Reek. Rescue the heaps. Plant the seed in the Sick Patch. Give it a chance.
Suggested line: Three heaps to rescue in the Reek, and the seed for the Sick Patch. Find the jar first, then give the seed its chance. It's waited long enough.

Effective line: It took? It TOOK. A flower. In this city.
Suggested line: It took? It TOOK! A flower, in this city, after all this time.

Effective line: Here. Take it. And something about him: he's afraid of anything that grows without asking him first.
Suggested line: Here, take this. And one thing about the man in the castle: he's afraid of anything that grows without asking him first.

Effective line: Weeds. Moss. Children. Anything that surprises him. I think that's the whole of him.
Suggested line: Weeds, moss, children. Anything that might surprise him. I reckon that's the whole of him.

Effective line: Patch is blooming. Heaps are steaming. What I said is in your journal: he's afraid of anything that grows on its own.
Suggested line: The patch is blooming and the heaps are steaming, untidy as you like. Remember what I said, it's in your journal: he's afraid of anything that grows on its own.

Effective line: Good day! The weather is approved! The lawn is regulation!
Suggested line: Good day! The weather has been approved, and the lawn is exactly regulation!

Effective line: Good day! It is a very good day. It is the same day as yesterday.
Suggested line: Good day! It is a very good day, exactly the same as yesterday.

Effective line: The bread is lovely. The bread is... (a fixed smile) I have a permit for four more words. I wish it existed.
Suggested line: The bread is lovely. The bread is... (a fixed smile) I am only permitted to call it lovely. I would like, very much, to see some.

Effective line: I had a name before. I think it started with a B. I am allowed to forget it. I am doing very well at it.
Suggested line: I had a name before. I think it started with a B. We are allowed to forget them, and I am doing very well at it.

Effective line: Isn't it lovely to be exactly the same? I used to be different. I do not remember why. It sounds very tiring.
Suggested line: Isn't it lovely to be exactly the same? I used to be different, I think, though I cannot remember why. It sounds very tiring.

Effective line: Seventy percent, minimum! I am at seventy-one! It is a good day.
Suggested line: Seventy percent cheerfulness is the minimum, and today I am at seventy-one! It is a good day.

Effective line: The Showcase receives visitors from all over! (a pause) Nobody visits. Nobody has visited in six years. We still smile in case they do.
Suggested line: The Showcase receives visitors from all over! (a pause) Nobody has visited in six years. We still smile, in case they do.

Effective line: Do you hear the loudspeaker? It plays the same thing every day. It has said my name once.
Suggested line: Do you hear the loudspeaker? It says the same things every day, but once, years ago, it said my name.

Effective line: I tried to be spontaneous once. On a Tuesday. I said 'hello' to a bird.
Suggested line: I tried to be spontaneous once, on a Tuesday. I said 'hello' to a bird.

Effective line: Approved Hat Size: 1. I wear the one. It is a good hat. I do not know whose it is.
Suggested line: There is one Approved Hat Size, and this is the hat. It is a good hat, although I do not know whose it was.

Effective line: He is not here. He has never been here. The portraits are here.
Suggested line: He is never here, you know. He has never once come down. Only the portraits come.

Effective line: You try the front door. It does not open. It is not a door.
Suggested line: You try the front door, but it does not open, because it is not a door.

Effective line: It is a very well-painted rectangle on a wall. Somebody has painted a tiny brass knocker. You knock on it.
Suggested line: It is a very well-painted rectangle on the wall. Somebody has even painted a tiny brass knocker, so you knock.

Effective line: You try the door. It does not open. You peek through the window: it is a painting of a window, and beyond it a painting of a living room with a painting of a family.
Suggested line: The door will not open. Through the window you see a painting of a window, and beyond it a painted living room where a painted family sits.

Effective line: They are smiling. They have been smiling for six years.
Suggested line: They are all smiling, and they have been smiling for six years.

Effective line: The door has no handle. The house has no inside. Behind the facade there is just room for a ladder and a young woman painting the same window for the thousandth time.
Suggested line: The door has no handle, and the house has no inside. In the gap behind the facade there is just room for a ladder and a young woman painting the same window for the thousandth time.

Effective line: She looks at you. She looks away. She has the face of someone who has meant to write home for years.
Suggested line: She looks at you, then away. She has the face of someone who has meant to write home for years.

Effective line: You try the door. It is open! It is a closet.
Suggested line: You try the door, and to your surprise it opens. It is a closet.

Effective line: You can go in. You probably should not. Yet.
Suggested line: You could go in now. It would be wiser to wait until the city is back on its feet.

Effective line: The dispenser is spoiled. Lovely. But the paste comes from somewhere.
Suggested line: The dispenser's spoiled, and lovely it is too. But the paste has to come from somewhere, doesn't it?

Effective line: The shuttered stall at the south-west corner hums at night. Stalls are not supposed to hum. Open its ration hatch and look. Gently.
Suggested line: The shuttered stall at the quarter's south-west corner hums at night, and stalls don't hum. Open its ration hatch and have a look down. Gently.

Effective line: The south-west stall, the one with its shutter down. Open the ration hatch. Whatever is down there, it will be very, very grey.
Suggested line: It's the south-west stall, the one with its shutter down. Open the ration hatch, go down, and shut off whatever you find. I'd bet it's very, very grey.

Effective line: I have kept one real onion in my apron for ten years. Tonight, I chop it. You may want to stand back. I will be weeping, and not only from the onion.
Suggested line: I've kept one real onion in my apron for ten years, and tonight I'm chopping it. You may want to stand back. I'll be weeping, and not only from the onion.

Effective line: By the last energy wheel, a ferret in pinstripes is timing Rollo's crews. The crews are lying in the sun. She is still timing them.
Suggested line: By the last energy wheel, a ferret in pinstripes stands over Rollo's crews with a stopwatch. They are lying in the sun, and she is still timing them.

Effective line: Beside the Sick Patch, a hare in groundskeeper green is measuring Old Fern's seedling with a ruler. It is an inch over regulation. She has written that down.
Suggested line: Beside the Sick Patch, a hare in groundskeeper green is measuring Old Fern's seedling with a ruler. It is an inch over regulation, and she has written that down.

Effective line: Out of regulation. Everything is out of regulation now. The lawns, the hedges. They grow in whatever direction they like.
Suggested line: Out of regulation. Everything is out of regulation now, the lawns and the hedges both. They grow in whatever direction they please.

Effective line: Granny Gristle needs hands on the compost rows down in the Dump. Sorting peel from shell, all day. Messy. You'll hate it. Good.
Suggested line: Granny Gristle needs hands on the compost rows down in the Dump, sorting peel from shell all day long. It's messy work, and you'll hate it. Good.

Effective line: Just measuring. Lot of very tidy people in this city. Tidy is easy to measure.
Suggested line: Just measuring. There's a lot of very tidy people in this city, and tidy is easy to measure.

Effective line: Kestrel. I scout for the Wrinkles. Going into the city? There's an older way in than the gate. Follow the chalk, not the guards. The guards are worse at drawing.
Suggested line: Name's Kestrel. I scout for the Wrinkles. Heading into the city? There's an older way in than the gate. Follow my chalk, not the guards; they're worse at drawing.

Effective line: There's an older way into the city. Nobody remembers it. That's the point.
Suggested line: There's an older way into the city that nobody remembers. That's the whole point of it.

Effective line: Get inside and find the Crease: the manhole near the gate. Knock three times. Not two. Two is rude. Then ask Wren about the tunnels.
Suggested line: Get inside, then find the manhole near the gate and knock three times. Not two; two is rude. Wren's down in the Crease. Ask her about the tunnels.

Effective line: You found them. Told you I'd be here. Didn't say where. That's the fun part. Here, you've earned this.
Suggested line: So you found the Crease. Told you I'd be around; I just never said where. Here, you've earned this.

Effective line: You climb up past the walls. Nobody is watching this way in. Nobody remembers it. That is the point.
Suggested line: You climb up inside the walls. Nobody is watching this way in, because nobody remembers it is here.

Effective line: A queue of grey citizens, a grey ladle, a supervisor timing every scoop.
Suggested line: Grey citizens queue for grey paste while a supervisor times every scoop of the ladle.

Effective line: Beefcake bore, Gourmand vents, Necrocrat signs, Refusemancer drains. The junction crew lifts the scrap. Every Garbage becomes muscle.
Suggested line: A Beefcake bore, Gourmand vents, Necrocrat signs and Refusemancer drains all meet here, and the junction crew turns every scrap of Garbage into muscle.

Effective line: Vats the size of houses. Something in the third one is humming the national anthem.
Suggested line: The vats are the size of houses, and something in the third one is humming the national anthem.

Effective line: Behind a ration hatch: a real kitchen, a locked pantry and a badger in medals.
Suggested line: Behind the ration hatch is a real kitchen, with a locked pantry and a badger in medals standing guard over it.

Effective line: 'HALT. These tunnels do not exist. You are standing in nothing. I cannot allow you to have found it.'
Suggested line: 'HALT. These tunnels do not exist, so you are standing in nothing, and I cannot allow you to have found it.'

Effective line: At the end of the Vat Floor, behind a door with a hatch for rations, is a kitchen. A real one. Copper pans, a cold stove, and a badger in a medal-covered chef's coat guarding a locked pantry.
Suggested line: At the end of the Vat Floor, behind a door with a ration hatch, is a real kitchen: copper pans, a cold stove, and a badger in a medal-covered chef's coat guarding a locked pantry.

Effective line: ATTENTION! This is a restricted pantry! Those recipes are confiscated for the war effort!
Suggested line: ATTENTION! You are standing in a restricted pantry, soldier! Every recipe on those shelves has been confiscated for the war effort!

Effective line: What war? The war on FLAVOUR, son. Every citizen fed the same, at the same time, from the same tap. Perfect discipline.
Suggested line: Which war? The war on FLAVOUR, son! Every citizen fed the same ration, at the same minute, from the same tap, and not one complaint about the seasoning.

Effective line: Marlo says you can't taste it either.
Suggested line: Marlo says you can't taste it either. Is that why everyone else has to eat it?

Effective line: Taste is a weakness. Whisk formation! Golems, to the vats! Nobody touches my pantry!
Suggested line: Taste is a weakness, soldier, and I have none! Golems, whisk formation, to the vats! Nobody touches my pantry!

ID: data/encounters/encounter_scripts.json::Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense/0/line::0
Effective line: Battle rations! Taste is a weakness. Paste is a strategy!
Suggested line: Battle rations, issue! Taste is a weakness, and paste is a strategy!

ID: data/encounters/encounter_scripts.json::Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense/1/line::0
Effective line: Battle stations! This is not a drill, it is a soufflé!
Suggested line: Battle stations! This is not a drill, soldier, it is a souffle! Vats, FIRE!

Effective line: A SMUDGE. Is TREASON. ...It's on me, isn't it.
Suggested line: A SMUDGE is TREASON! ...It's on me, isn't it.

Effective line: The pantry door swings open. Shelves of confiscated jars: pickles, jams, a wheel of cheese with a ration number on it. Somewhere a vat coughs and stops.
Suggested line: The pantry door swings open on shelves of confiscated jars: pickles, jams, and a wheel of cheese with a ration number stamped on it. Out on the floor, a vat coughs and stops.

Effective line: I invented the paste because nobody could get it wrong. You can't burn paste. You can't oversalt it.
Suggested line: I invented the paste because nobody could get it wrong, soldier. You can't burn it, you can't oversalt it, and you can't spoil a regiment's dinner with it.

Effective line: You can't... taste it. I never could, you know. Not since the war that wasn't.
Suggested line: And you can't... taste it. I haven't tasted anything in years, you know. I thought if nobody could, nobody would notice that I couldn't.

Effective line: Then you'll learn. The Grand Chef is taking students. She starts everyone the same way: first, water.
Suggested line: Then you'll learn again. The Grand Chef is taking students, and she starts every one of them the same way: first, water.

Effective line: The great doors swing open, silent and perfectly balanced. Beyond them, a long hall, a red carpet and a smell of floor wax and lemons. Somewhere, a very long way away, someone is humming.
Suggested line: The great doors swing open, silent and perfectly balanced, onto a long hall and a red carpet that smells of floor wax and lemons. Somewhere a very long way off, someone is humming.

Effective line: 'Welcome,' says a quiet, polite voice from nowhere. 'Please wipe your feet. Please wipe your opinions. You are expected.'
Suggested line: 'Welcome,' says a quiet, polite voice from nowhere. 'Please wipe your feet, and your opinions, on the mat provided. You are expected.'

Effective line: 'THE SEED: Nature is untidy. Nature is inefficient. Nature disagrees with itself.
Suggested line: 'THE SEED: Nature is untidy, inefficient and forever disagreeing with itself.

Effective line: A seed, properly corrupted, can be made to agree with me. Plant in the Archdruid. Observe.
Suggested line: A seed, properly corrupted, can be made to agree with me. Plant it in the Archdruid, and observe.

Effective line: NOTE: it will spread. What grows will be orderly. I believe she will thank me.'
Suggested line: NOTE: it will spread, and what grows will be orderly. I believe she will thank me.'

Effective line: Guards in polished armour pour from the gatehouse. Not toward you. Toward her.
Suggested line: Guards in polished armour pour from the gatehouse, and they are not coming for you. They are coming for her.

Effective line: Miss {rescuer_full}, I presume. Former junior Path-ologist. Absent without leave. Removed one item of laboratory property, which has been walking about ever since.
Suggested line: Miss {rescuer_full}, I presume! Former junior Path-ologist, absent without leave, who removed one item of laboratory property that has been walking about ever since.

Effective line: Don't fret, Miss Vey. Your father is very understanding about these things. Take her home, gentlemen. The long way.
Suggested line: Don't fret, Miss Vey, your father is ever so understanding about these things. Take her home, gentlemen, and do take the long way.

Effective line: They are through a side door before you reach it. The door has no handle on this side. Of course it doesn't.
Suggested line: They are through a side door before you can reach it, and on this side the door has no handle at all.

Effective line: {rescuer}. Her name is {rescuer}. I never even asked.
Suggested line: {rescuer}. Her name is {rescuer}, and all that way I never once asked her.

Effective line: Solid gold, ten metres tall, polished until you can see your own worried face in them. They open before you touch them. That is the worst part.
Suggested line: Solid gold, ten metres tall, and polished until you can see your own worried face in them. They swing open before you touch them, which is somehow the worst part.

Effective line: Thousands of portraits of one man, in order. Each is a little taller, a little straighter, a little more perfect than the last. A story event.
Suggested line: Thousands of portraits of one man, hung in order, each a little taller, straighter and more perfect than the last. A story event.

Effective line: A knight made entirely of mirror plates, each of them showing only one face. It moves exactly like you. Then it stops doing that. (A battle.)
Suggested line: A knight made entirely of mirror plates, every one showing the same smiling face. It moves exactly like you, right up until it doesn't. (A battle.)

Effective line: A clerk at a tall desk, stamping everything that moves. Quite fast. Quite sad. His eyes never leave the paper. (A battle.)
Suggested line: A clerk at a tall desk stamps everything that moves, quickly and rather sadly. His eyes never leave the paper. (A battle.)

Effective line: The head of the Ministry of Correction: white gloves, kind eyes, a ruler. She is very, very gentle. That is what makes it frightening. (Elite)
Suggested line: The head of the Ministry of Correction, with white gloves, kind eyes and a ruler. She is very, very gentle, and that is what makes her frightening. (Elite)

Effective line: A narrow back corridor where the castle's servants work, silent and very fast, in matching grey. They do not smile. They have stopped. (A battle.)
Suggested line: A narrow back corridor where the castle's servants work in matching grey, silent and very fast. They do not smile any more; they have stopped trying. (A battle.)

Effective line: The old portraits lean against the wall, face to the plaster. Behind the last one: a small bag someone left. 'In case anyone comes looking for the real one,' says a note. You take it and go back.
Suggested line: The old portraits lean against the wall, faces to the plaster. Behind the last one someone has left a small bag and a note: 'In case anyone comes looking for the real one.' You take it and go back.

Effective line: 'I never once asked what was wrong with them. Please. The door on the left. Go and look.'
Suggested line: 'I never once asked what was wrong with them. Please, take the door on the left and go and look at them.'

Effective line: You take the form. It can be revoked, you suspect, on a technicality. You go back.
Suggested line: You take the form. Somewhere in all this paper there must be a technicality, and you suspect someone will find it.

Effective line: You leave the seed where it fell. Out of its dome it looks smaller. Most things here do. You go back.
Suggested line: You leave the seed where it fell. Out of its dome it looks smaller, as most things here do once you get close, and you go back.

Effective line: The smile never changes. Neither, you realise, does anything else here. It is strangely restful.
Suggested line: The smile never changes, and neither, you realise, does anything else in this place. It is strangely restful, and that frightens you more than the guards do.

Effective line: Heavier than it looks, worth more than it should be, and covered in your fingerprints in a building that remembers fingerprints.
Suggested line: It is heavier than it looks and worth more than it should be, and now it is covered in your fingerprints, in a building that remembers fingerprints.

Effective line: There is always one more than there should be. You wave. He waves second. You are, for a moment, a little less afraid of him.
Suggested line: There is always one more reflection than there should be. You wave, he waves a moment too late, and for a moment you are a little less afraid of him.

Effective line: The sign is older than the rest of the castle. It is painted by hand. Under it, in different ink, someone has written: 'He meant well.'
Suggested line: The sign is older than the rest of the castle and painted by hand. Beneath it, in different ink, someone has written: 'He meant well.'

Effective line: A lectern in the middle of a round room, a book open on it, a pen beside the book. The ink on the last page is still wet. He wrote this today.
Suggested line: A lectern stands in the middle of a round room, with a book open on it and a pen beside the book. The ink on the last page is still wet; he wrote this today.

Effective line: A quiet reading room, a lamp, a chair. Someone used to read here. Rest and restore HP.
Suggested line: A quiet reading room with one lamp and one chair. Someone used to read here every night. Rest and restore HP.

Effective line: A single long shelf where the reforms are filed in order. Each is a little bigger than the last. A deck challenge: can your deck keep its footing?
Suggested line: A single long shelf where the reforms are filed in order, each a little bigger than the last. A deck challenge: can your deck keep its footing?

Effective line: A tall brass automaton that files, stamps and shelves. It has been told the archive is complete. It is very sure. (Elite)
Suggested line: A tall brass automaton that files, stamps and shelves. It has been told the archive is complete, and it is very sure of that. (Elite)

Effective line: A single book on a stand, still open. The last page is still wet. A story event: the moment you see him as he sees himself.
Suggested line: A single book lies open on a stand, its last page still wet. A story event: the moment you see him as he sees himself.

Effective line: You sit in the old reading chair. It is worn exactly where one person sat, every night, for years. Someone made the lampshade by hand. It is a little crooked.
Suggested line: You sit in the old reading chair, which is worn exactly where one person sat every night for years. Someone made the lampshade by hand, and it is a little crooked.

Effective line: Plans for wells. Plans for a school lunch. Plans for a bridge that was actually built.
Suggested line: There are plans for wells, plans for a hot school lunch, and plans for a bridge that was actually built.

Effective line: They are good. They are so good. You roll up the best and take it, with something in your throat.
Suggested line: They are good. They are so good, and something catches in your throat as you roll up the best of them and take it.

Effective line: No one climbs. The stair has been polished. By seventeen people.
Suggested line: No one climbs this stair. It has been polished by seventeen people, and I will not have it scuffed.

Effective line: Roads, rivers, four districts, a hundred thousand tiny houses. Every one of them is exactly where he wants it.
Suggested line: Roads, rivers, four districts and a hundred thousand tiny houses, and every one of them is exactly where he wants it.

Effective line: Do hold still. You are very slightly out of alignment. There. Better.
Suggested line: Do hold still. You are a fraction of a degree out of alignment, and I find I cannot leave it. There, that is better.

Effective line: I only wanted it to be nice. For everyone. For their own good.
Suggested line: I only wanted it to be nice, for everyone. It was for their own good. Why won't anyone let it be for their own good?

Effective line: Each one is a little straighter, a little taller. By the last he is eleven feet tall, with no wrinkles and a smile that does not move. Under each: 'IMPROVED.'
Suggested line: Each one is a little straighter and a little taller, until by the last he is eleven feet tall, with no wrinkles and a smile that does not move. Under every one: 'IMPROVED.'

Effective line: In the ninth he looks so tired, and so sincere. You will not forget it. You see through the frame.
Suggested line: In the ninth he looks so tired, and so sincere, that you know you will not forget it. After that, none of the frames can fool you.

Effective line: You look at your feet. The carpet is red, and a little worn in the middle. That, at least, is honest. You feel a little steadier.
Suggested line: You look down at your feet. The red carpet is worn a little in the middle, which is the one honest thing in the room, and you feel steadier for it.

Effective line: The frame comes off with a squeal. Somewhere an alarm goes off, very politely: 'Please do not remove the improvements.' A hand-sized portrait falls and cuts your hand. The frame is worth a lot.
Suggested line: The frame comes off with a squeal, and an alarm goes off somewhere, very politely: 'Please do not remove the improvements.' A small portrait falls and cuts your hand, but the frame is worth a lot.

Effective line: Your face. Tired, dusty, crooked, entirely your own. It is the most welcome thing in the castle.
Suggested line: It is your face, tired and dusty and a little crooked, and entirely your own. It is the most welcome thing you have seen in this castle.

Effective line: A long white ward. Fifty beds. In each, a citizen in a grey gown with a small, fixed smile, looking at nothing.
Suggested line: A long white ward holds fifty beds, and in each lies a citizen in a grey gown with a small, fixed smile, looking at nothing.

Effective line: You sit by the bed and listen, for as long as it takes. It takes a long time. They tell you their names.
Suggested line: You sit by the beds and listen for as long as it takes, which is a long time, and one by one they tell you their names.

Effective line: You carry him out through a window. He is heavier than you expected. It costs you a little. It costs him far more.
Suggested line: You carry him out through a window. He is heavier than you expected, and it costs you something, though it has cost him far more.

Effective line: The first page is enough. Somebody will pay for this book. Somebody, one day, will read it aloud.
Suggested line: The first page is enough. Somebody will pay well for this book, and somebody, one day, will read it aloud.

Effective line: You sit on step two hundred and fifty, and look up at the very large clock. It has no hands. It has only a plate that says 'ON TIME'.
Suggested line: You sit on step two hundred and fifty and look up at the very large clock. It has no hands, only a brass plate that says 'ON TIME'.

Effective line: I have drawn up plans for six new ones. The Council has approved them. I did not sleep. It was wonderful.'
Suggested line: I have drawn up plans for six new ones, and the Council has approved every one. I did not sleep at all. It was wonderful.'

Effective line: It goes on. They are good. They are so good.
Suggested line: It goes on like that for years, and they are good. They are so good.

Effective line: He is not lying. That is the worst of it. You understand him a little, and you understand exactly what you will have to do.
Suggested line: He is not lying, and that is the worst of it. You understand him a little now, and you understand exactly what you will have to do.

Effective line: Ah. A visitor. Do come in.
Suggested line: Ah, a visitor. Do come in; I so rarely receive anyone who has not been summoned.

Effective line: Sorry. That's forest mud. I've walked a long way, and everyone I met on the way here was afraid of you.
Suggested line: Sorry, that's forest mud. I've walked a long way to get here, and everyone I met on the road was afraid of you.

Effective line: Afraid? Of what? Of order?
Suggested line: Afraid? Of order, perhaps, or of comfort, or of the dreadful burden of being safe?

Effective line: Of comfort? Of being safe? I have given them roofs, and hats, and rules.
Suggested line: I have given them roofs, and hats, and rules, and I have given each of them exactly the same amount of each, which is more than anyone before me ever managed.

Effective line: Every one of them has a number. Nobody is ever overlooked. Do you know how few kingdoms can say that?
Suggested line: Every one of them has a number, so that nobody is ever overlooked. Do you know how few kingdoms can say that? I do. I counted.

Effective line: Every unit, equal, in every way. Why must some of them be five? Why must anything be five?
Suggested line: Every unit was to be equal, in every way. Why must some of them be five? Why must anything ever be five?

Effective line: You took ten years from me. Whatever you took, it was not the part that matters, and strength is not control.
Suggested line: You took ten years from me, and whatever you took, it was not the part that matters. Strength is what you do with what's left, and strength is not control.

Effective line: You took ten years from me. I don't know everything you took. I know it wasn't the part that matters.
Suggested line: You took ten years from me. I don't know everything you took, but I know it wasn't the part that matters.

Effective line: Then they must be made the same. For their own good. Do you not see?
Suggested line: Then they must be made the same, for their own good. I had rather hoped that you, of all people, would see that.

Effective line: You are not listening. Nobody ever listens. (a breath) Very well. If you will not follow my rules, I shall use yours.
Suggested line: You are not listening; nobody ever listens. (a breath) Very well. If you will not follow my rules, I shall simply have to use yours.

Effective line: Your cards. Your plays. Your own deck, in my hands.
Suggested line: Your cards, your plays, your very own deck, held in my hands and played rather more tidily than you ever played it.

Effective line: And you still beat me. How?
Suggested line: And still you beat me. I should very much like to know how.

Effective line: You copied my cards. What I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.
Suggested line: You copied my cards, but what I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.

Effective line: And nobody files me under 'subject' again. No order outranks treating people with respect.
Suggested line: And nobody files me under 'subject' ever again. No order you could write outranks treating people with respect.

Effective line: You copied my cards. What I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.
Suggested line: You copied my cards, but what I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.

Effective line: I'm not your subject. You don't get to decide who I am.
Suggested line: Copying a face never made anyone a cook. You don't get to decide who I am.

Effective line: Nobody files me under 'subject' again. No order outranks treating people with respect.
Suggested line: Nobody files me under 'subject' ever again. No order you could write outranks treating people with respect.

Effective line: That is not true. I made the wells. I made the roads.
Suggested line: That is simply not true. I made the wells, and I made the roads.

Effective line: NO. No, no, no. The rules are PERFECT.
Suggested line: No. No, no, no. The rules are perfect. I checked every one of them myself, twice.

Effective line: The rules ARE perfect. If the rules are not perfect then I have been... then I have been...
Suggested line: The rules are perfect. They have to be, because if they aren't, then I have been... then all this time I have been...

Effective line: Everything is coming apart. Why is everything coming apart? I only wanted it to be nice!
