Suggested line: Everything is coming apart, and I don't understand why. I only wanted it to be nice.

Effective line: 'The heart and the mind, son. You brought both. We are with you.' (Grandmaster Flex's Heart: Beefcake units get +1 power, and you gain 2 max HP.)
Suggested line: 'Strength is the heart and the mind, son, and you brought both. We're with you.' (Grandmaster Flex's Heart: Beefcake units get +1 power, and you gain 2 max HP.)

Effective line: The Grand Chef, in a clean apron, ladle in hand. 'Have you eaten? No. Of course you have not.'
Suggested line: The Grand Chef, in a clean apron, ladle in hand. 'Have you eaten? No, of course you haven't. Here. Eat first, fight after.'

Effective line: 'Ten years of sauce that tasted of nothing. Let us feed this kingdom something real.' (The Grand Chef's Feast: Gourmand units get +1 defense, life gain is stronger, and you gain 2 max HP.)
Suggested line: 'Ten years of sauce that tasted of nothing. Let's feed this kingdom something real again.' (The Grand Chef's Feast: Gourmand units get +1 defense, life gain is stronger, and you gain 2 max HP.)

Effective line: Nobody stands beside you. The Paths are not free yet: their leaders are still behind wheels, behind sauce and behind paperwork. You step into the chamber alone.
Suggested line: Nobody stands beside you. The Paths are not free yet, and their leaders are still held behind wheels and sauce and paperwork and thorns, so you step into the chamber alone.

Effective line: The model lies in pieces. A hundred thousand tiny houses on the floor, all in the wrong places, and somehow they look better.
Suggested line: The model lies in pieces, a hundred thousand tiny houses scattered across the floor in all the wrong places, and somehow they look better.

Effective line: ...It is over. The rules were not enough.
Suggested line: ...So it is over. I wrote such good rules, and they were not enough.

Effective line: I did it for them. I did it for the people. You do see that?
Suggested line: I did it for them, for the people. You do see that, don't you?

Effective line: You took my mother and father. I can't even remember their faces. I'm not burying that in a jar. I'm letting it go.
Suggested line: You took my mother and father, and I can't even remember their faces. I'm not going to keep that under glass the way you keep everything. I'm letting it go.

Effective line: You took my mother and father. I can't even remember their faces. I'm letting it go anyway. Watch.
Suggested line: You took my mother and father, and I can't even remember their faces. I'm letting it go anyway. Watch me.

Effective line: It was the mirrors. Wasn't it. I wanted a world where nothing could surprise me.
Suggested line: It was the mirrors, wasn't it? I wanted a world where nothing could ever surprise me.

Effective line: I'm not going to correct you. That was your way. Start smaller. Say sorry to one person.
Suggested line: I'm not going to correct you; that was always your way. Start smaller than that. Say sorry to one person.

Effective line: No crown. No perfect smile. Only a tired man kneeling above a very small kingdom.
Suggested line: There is no crown and no perfect smile, only a tired man kneeling above a very small kingdom.

Effective line: Somebody downstairs will pay for them. Nobody upstairs will miss them. That is the whole plan.
Suggested line: Somebody downstairs will pay for them and nobody upstairs will miss them, which is as much of a plan as you need.

Effective line: It is perfect. It is horrifying. Your face stays like that for a while, and the guards leave you alone.
Suggested line: The smile comes out perfect, which is horrifying, and your face stays like that for a while. The guards leave you alone.

Effective line: Where is the Lab?
Suggested line: Where is this Lab? Where did you take her?

Effective line: He withdraws, bravely, at a run. You fold the memo into your pocket. Beneath the forest. Her father.
Suggested line: He withdraws, bravely, at a run. You fold the memo into your pocket, and two phrases go with it: beneath the forest, and her father.

Effective line: Leaving the Capital ends this visit. Town heals you fully. Nobody will ask for your exit permit. Nobody has a permit machine. The road is just a road.
Suggested line: Leaving the Capital ends this visit, and Town heals you fully. Nobody will ask for an exit permit on the way out; the road is just a road again.

Effective line: The doors of {villain}'s Castle stand open. The gold is flaking. A pigeon has built a nest in the crown above the lintel and nobody has asked it for a permit.
Suggested line: The doors of {villain}'s Castle stand open, and the gold is flaking off them. A pigeon has built a nest in the crown above the lintel, and nobody has asked it for a permit.

Effective line: You wake up on a cot in the Crease. Nurse Hesper Dray is writing on a clipboard. It says 'NOTES', and then, in small letters, 'finally'.
Suggested line: You wake on a cot in the Crease. Nurse Hesper Dray looks up from her clipboard as if she has been expecting you for some time.

Effective line: 'Fell over. We rolled you in. The fee is still yours. The tea is not free just because the kingdom is.'
Suggested line: 'You fell over, so we rolled you in. The fee's still yours, mind. The tea isn't free just because the kingdom is.'

Effective line: Now: some houses. A very tidy lawn. A lot of citizens who would like to go home.
Suggested line: Now: some houses, a very tidy lawn and a lot of citizens who would like to go home.

Effective line: The tears are sealed. The pigeons have moved in. The pigeons are staying.
Suggested line: The tears are sealed. The pigeons have moved in, and they are staying.

Effective line: You did it. Sit. I am Wren: Royal Archivist, and for ten years the only honest record in this city.
Suggested line: You did it. Sit down a moment. I'm Wren, Royal Archivist, and for ten years I kept the only honest record in this city.

Effective line: The Crease is just a cellar now. We are keeping it anyway, for the stories.
Suggested line: The Crease is just a cellar now, but we're keeping it. Too many true things were written down there to let it go.

Effective line: The kingdom is mending, one argument at a time. It is dreadfully inefficient. I have never been happier. Take your time.
Suggested line: The kingdom is mending one argument at a time, and it's dreadfully inefficient. I've never been happier. Take your time.

Effective line: Old Fern. Composter. Allowed to say it out loud now.
Suggested line: Old Fern, composter, and I'm allowed to say so out loud now.

Effective line: The patch came in, the heaps are steaming and nobody's hit me in a week. Untidy and proud.
Suggested line: The patch came in, the heaps are steaming, and nobody's thumped me for it in a week. I'm untidy, and I'm proud of it.

Effective line: Smell that? Honest compost. I could cry. Won't. Waste of good water. Come back any time.
Suggested line: Smell that? Honest compost. I could cry, but it'd be a waste of good water. Come back any time.

Effective line: Widow Pell. My husband is at rest. I visit him every morning.
Suggested line: I'm Widow Pell. My husband is finally at rest, and I visit him every morning, the way I always meant to.

Effective line: We're lifting again. Real things. On purpose. Come and watch the crews. Bring a snack.
Suggested line: We're lifting again, real things and on purpose this time. Come and watch the crews, and bring a snack.

Effective line: And chaotic. There is flour on the ceiling. I have never been so happy to have a mess.
Suggested line: And chaotic, I'll grant you. There's flour on the ceiling, and I've never been so happy to see a mess.

Effective line: I do not measure anyone any more. I just stand here. Yesterday a man walked by at exactly the approved height, and I wept.
Suggested line: I don't measure anyone any more; I simply stand here. Yesterday a man walked by at exactly the approved height, and I wept, and I could not tell you why.

Effective line: I smile now, when I want. It comes out crooked. My wife says it is the best thing she has ever seen.
Suggested line: I smile now, when I want to. It comes out crooked, and my wife says it's the best thing she's ever seen.

Effective line: Aldous. Crooked. I'm practising.
Suggested line: It's Aldous. Still crooked, but I'm practising.

Effective line: I do not know the hat size and I do not care! It is wonderful to be alive.
Suggested line: I don't know the approved hat size and I don't care! It's wonderful to be alive.

Effective line: I blinked just now. Twice. Nobody came.
Suggested line: I blinked twice just now, and nobody came to write it down.

Effective line: The bakery is painted on. There is going to be a real one, as soon as someone learns to bake. I have a recipe. The recipe is: try.
Suggested line: The bakery's only painted on, but there's going to be a real one as soon as someone learns to bake. I have a recipe. It says: try.

Effective line: My name is Berta. I had forgotten. It was on the tip of my tongue for ten years.
Suggested line: My name is Berta! I'd forgotten it. It was on the tip of my tongue for ten years.

Effective line: My house is different from my neighbour's now. He has painted his purple. I am furious. I am so happy to be furious.
Suggested line: My house is different from my neighbour's now, because he's painted his purple. I'm furious about it, and I'm so happy to be furious.

Effective line: I go behind the house and look at the wall, still. It is a good wall. It is just a wall.
Suggested line: I still go round the back and look at the wall sometimes. It's a good wall, and it's only a wall.

Effective line: I smiled at a funeral yesterday. Nobody corrected me. It was a good funeral.
Suggested line: I smiled at a funeral yesterday, and nobody corrected me. It was a good funeral.

Effective line: I will not smile at all today if I do not want to. I am enjoying it.
Suggested line: I'm not going to smile at all today unless I want to, and I'm enjoying it enormously.

Effective line: The hedge is round. The hedge wanted to be round. I asked it. I did not have to submit a form.
Suggested line: The hedge is round because it wanted to be round. I asked it myself, and I didn't have to submit a form.

Effective line: The loudspeaker is silent. I stood under it for an hour. I said my name aloud, myself.
Suggested line: The loudspeaker's gone quiet. I stood under it for an hour and said my own name out loud, just because I could.

Effective line: I do not know what to do on a Thursday, now it is all of them.
Suggested line: Now that every day is Spontaneity Thursday, I don't know what to do with any of them.

Effective line: My daughter came home. With the little green hat. I have never seen a hat I loved more.
Suggested line: My daughter came home in her little green hat. I've never loved a hat more in my life.

Effective line: I am not going to be polite today. I am going to be honest. Your hat is awful. I love it.
Suggested line: I'm not going to be polite today, I'm going to be honest: your hat is awful, and I love it.

Effective line: I opened the door at the back. It was raining. I stood in it for an hour.
Suggested line: I opened the back door and it was raining, so I stood out in it for an hour.

Effective line: The Showcase is not the best of all places. It is a place. It is mine. It is a good place.
Suggested line: The Showcase isn't the best of all places any more. It's just a place, and it's mine, and it's a good one.

Effective line: I am going to go somewhere else. Just to see. Then I will come back, if I want.
Suggested line: I'm going to go somewhere else, just to see what it's like. Then I'll come back, if I want to.

Effective line: He was not kind. He was afraid. I think both can be true.
Suggested line: He wasn't kind, he was afraid, and for ten years none of us could tell the difference.

Effective line: I am not sure I forgive him. I am not sure I need to.
Suggested line: I'm not sure I forgive him, and I'm not sure I need to.

Effective line: He is gone. I looked away. I looked away for a whole minute. It was a very long minute.
Suggested line: He's gone, so I looked away from his portrait for a whole minute. It was a very long minute.

Effective line: The closet is a closet. The sign says: IF YOU ARE READING THIS, YOU DO NOT HAVE TO SMILE.
Suggested line: The closet is just a closet now. A sign inside says: IF YOU ARE READING THIS, YOU DO NOT HAVE TO SMILE.

Effective line: Attention, citizens. (a cough) The weather is no longer approved. It is just weather. It seems to be managing.
Suggested line: Attention, citizens. (a cough) The weather is no longer approved; it is just weather, and it seems to be managing on its own.

Effective line: Attention, citizens. The exits are open. The entrances are open.
Suggested line: Attention, citizens. The exits are open, and so, it turns out, are the entrances.

Effective line: Attention, citizens. All is not well. It will be.
Suggested line: Attention, citizens. All is not well yet, but it will be.

Effective line: Attention, citizens. The Wrinkles were real. Please thank anyone who exists.
Suggested line: Attention, citizens. The Wrinkles were real all along, and they kept the true record. Please thank them.

Effective line: Queue management. There is no queue any more. I am standing here out of habit.
Suggested line: Queue management. There's no queue any more, so I'm only standing here out of habit.

Effective line: Nobody has told me where else to stand. I thought I might go for a walk. If that is... No. I am not asking. I am telling you. I think.
Suggested line: Nobody's told me where else to stand, so I thought I might go for a walk. If that's... no. I'm not asking permission, I'm telling you. I think.

Effective line: Exit control. You may leave whenever you like. I am just standing here. It is a very open exit.
Suggested line: Exit control. You may leave whenever you like; I'm only standing here. It's a very open exit.

Effective line: Still unapproved. Nothing's approved any more. Best thing that ever happened to my tea.
Suggested line: My tea's still unapproved, but then nothing's approved any more. Best thing that ever happened to it.

Effective line: Sit down, dearie. Word came from the Capital this morning, by way of a pigeon who was very rude about it.
Suggested line: Sit down, dearie. Word came from the Capital this morning, and you won't like it.

Effective line: Plume's men took a girl at the castle gate. The one who carried you out of the woods. {rescuer_full}.
Suggested line: Plume's men took a girl at the castle gate, the one who carried you out of the woods. {rescuer_full}, they called her.

Effective line: I knew that face the day you walked in here. Her father worked in my laboratory, once. I never trusted her for a minute.
Suggested line: I knew whose girl she was the day she brought you to my door. Her father worked in my laboratory once, and I never trusted her for a minute because of it.

Effective line: I have been wrong about people before. Once. In 1987. It seems I've gone and done it twice.
Suggested line: I've been wrong about people before. Once, in 1987. It seems I've gone and done it twice.

Effective line: Back where she came from, I expect. Somewhere with glass walls and no windows. That's a door I can't open. Not yet.
Suggested line: Back where she came from, I expect: somewhere with glass walls and no windows. That's a door I can't open for you. Not yet.

Effective line: We saw them take her at the gate. Four guards and a peacock with a speaking trumpet. We couldn't get close.
Suggested line: We saw them take her at the gate: four guards and a peacock with a speaking trumpet. We couldn't get anywhere near her.

Effective line: Her name goes in the true record. Whatever else happens.
Suggested line: Her name goes in the true record, whatever else happens.

Effective line: The scale model cracks in half. Then the table cracks. Then, with the sound of a very large drawer being pulled from a very large cabinet, the castle walls begin to come down.
Suggested line: The scale model cracks in half, and then the table under it, and then, with the sound of a very large drawer being pulled from a very large cabinet, the castle walls begin to come down.

Effective line: Shopfronts topple. Hedges wilt into their own shapes. The loudspeakers cough once and go quiet.
Suggested line: Shopfronts topple, hedges slump back into their own shapes, and the loudspeakers cough once and go quiet.

Effective line: Behind the facade: houses, lawns and people, all of them a bit crooked. A child paints the new sign at the gate: PATHORDIA.
Suggested line: Behind the facade are houses, lawns and people, all of them a little crooked. At the gate, a child paints the new sign: PATHORDIA.

Effective line: The Beefcakes are late. The Necrocrats have brought a form. The Gourmands are overdressed. The Refusemancers smell, faintly, of compost.
Suggested line: The Beefcakes are late, the Necrocrats have brought a form, the Gourmands are overdressed, and the Refusemancers smell faintly of compost.

Effective line: The point was never to be the same. The point was the argument. Different Paths, working together.
Suggested line: The point was never to be the same; the point was the argument. Different Paths, working together.

Effective line: You are back in {pathordia}. It is mostly the same streets, but it sounds quite different: people are shouting at each other cheerfully, in every direction.
Suggested line: You are back in {pathordia}. The streets are mostly the same, but they sound quite different now: people are shouting at each other cheerfully, in every direction.

Effective line: Rollo's crews are lying in the sun. I told them rest is a rep. They believed me. Heart and mind, son. You used both.
Suggested line: Rollo's crews are lying in the sun, because I told them rest is a rep and they believed me. You used heart and mind both, son. That's the whole lift.

Effective line: The sauce is gone from every stove in the kingdom. Real onions again. I have not wept so much since I was a girl.
Suggested line: The sauce is gone from every stove in the kingdom, and I'm cooking with real onions again. I haven't cried this much since I was a girl.

Effective line: You did something worth signing, you know. Now sit. Eat. Eat a mess.
Suggested line: Sit. Eat. You did something worth putting your name to, and you look as if you haven't had a proper meal since.

Effective line: I think I am going to cry. I have wanted to for a very long time.
Suggested line: I think I'm going to cry, dear. I've wanted to for a very long time.

Effective line: Look at this crack in the marble. Something is growing out of it.
Suggested line: Look at this crack in the marble, child. Something's growing out of it.

Effective line: I am going to let it. It has earned the right. So have you, child.
Suggested line: I'm going to let it. It's earned the right, and so have you.

Effective line: Your power has kept this kingdom lit for ten years. I have only been looking after it. Surely you can see that.
Suggested line: Your power has kept this kingdom lit for ten years, and I have only ever looked after it. Surely you can see that.

Effective line: The castle does not fall. It opens. Where the Model Room floor was, a stair of four colours winds down into the old heart of the Capital.
Suggested line: The castle does not fall; it opens. Where the Model Room floor was, a stair of four colours winds down into the old heart of the Capital.

Effective line: Cracked streets. Real faces. A boy he kept in a cell.
Suggested line: Cracked streets, real faces, and a boy he kept in a cell.

Effective line: Slowly, he understands how much he broke. The wells were good. The schools were good. He made one choice for everyone, and nobody will trust him with another.
Suggested line: Slowly, he understands how much he broke. The wells were good, and so were the schools, but he made one choice for everyone, and nobody will trust him with another.

Effective line: Ah. You did it, then. The castle.
Suggested line: Ah. You did it, then, the castle and all.

Effective line: Then I've two graves to finish properly, up in the city. Grave Row. Come by when you're ready. No rush. There never is, with me.
Suggested line: Then I've two graves to finish properly, up in Grave Row in the city. Come by when you're ready. No rush; there never is, with me.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's see now... you're not down for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.

Effective line: Eight years. Gate stayed open. Every night. In case.
Suggested line: Eight years. Kept the gate open every night, in case.

Effective line: You're the one who knocked the castle over? Dad says thank you. That's what the 'Hm' meant. Thank you from me, too.
Suggested line: You're the one who knocked the castle over? That 'Hm' was Dad saying thank you. Thank you from me, too.

Effective line: Half the city has come. Nobody was told to. Wren holds the true record. Maren holds a pie she has forgotten about.
Suggested line: Half the city has come, and nobody told them to. Wren holds the true record; Maren holds a pie she has forgotten she is carrying.

Effective line: Notebook's full of her name. Started a new one. First page says yours. Spelled right, this time.
Suggested line: Notebook's full of her name, so I've started a new one. First page says yours. Spelled it right, this time.

Effective line: In the Capital's square, the leaders of the four Paths clasp hands. Nobody trips. Several people cry.
Suggested line: In the Capital's square the leaders of the four Paths clasp hands, and several people in the crowd begin to cry.

Effective line: Only the worthy reach the top. Also bring water.
Suggested line: Only the worthy reach the top, they say. The worthy also bring water, if they've any sense.

Effective line: Mount Swolympus is open. Take the trail behind the station. Mind the thin air... never gets enough credit for being there.
Suggested line: Mount Swolympus is open at last. Take the trail behind the station, and mind the thin air up top... never gets enough credit, thin air.

Effective line: A stone colossus sits at the summit with its hands out, palms up, waiting for a barbell. It has been spotting for a thousand years. It is very, very ready.
Suggested line: A stone colossus sits at the summit with its palms turned up, waiting for a barbell. It has been spotting for a thousand years, and it is very, very ready.

Effective line: A gallery of glass above the cells, a kettle, a cracked mug that says WORLD'S OKAYEST PATH-OLOGIST, and a corkboard of notes on one subject. The newest are a count of days.
Suggested line: A glass gallery looks down on the cells: a kettle, a cracked mug, and a corkboard of notes about one subject. The newest notes are only a count of days.

Effective line: They put me in your cell. My father thinks that's educational. With him it is hard to tell.
Suggested line: They put me in your cell. My father calls it educational, and the worst of it is that he means it.

Effective line: The only room in the Lab with a rug. On the desk, a journal in a neat, slanted hand. The last entry is ten years old.
Suggested line: This is the only room in the Lab with a rug. On the desk lies a journal in a neat, slanted hand, and its last entry is ten years old.

Effective line: He told me the King died of a fever. He told me you were a patient. I brought you soup.
Suggested line: He told me the King died of a fever. He told me you were a patient, so I brought you soup.

Effective line: The only room in the Lab with a rug. On the desk, a journal in a neat, slanted hand, and a child's drawing: 'For Papa, from {rescuer}.' The last entry is ten years old.
Suggested line: This is the only room in the Lab with a rug. On the desk lies a journal in a neat, slanted hand beside a child's drawing: 'For Papa, from {rescuer}.' The last entry is ten years old.

Effective line: Siphon is {rescuer}'s father. He held the door.
Suggested line: Siphon is {rescuer}'s father, and he held the door for them.

Effective line: Subject 1. And my daughter. Both of you home at once. I shall have to rearrange the schedule.
Suggested line: Subject 1, and my daughter too! Both of you home at once. I shall have to rearrange the whole schedule.

Effective line: You have grown. Remarkable. The draining has been very good for your posture.
Suggested line: Remarkable. You've grown at least two inches, and the time away has done wonders for your posture. I'll want measurements.

Effective line: You held the door, Dad. The night they killed the King and Queen. I read it in your own hand.
Suggested line: You held the door, Dad, the night they killed the King and Queen. I read it in your own hand.

Effective line: You told me he was a patient. I brought him soup. For years.
Suggested line: You told me he was a patient, and I brought him soup for years.

Effective line: Subject 1. You came back to us. You have grown. Remarkable, after so many cycles.
Suggested line: Subject 1, you came back to us! And you've grown. Remarkable, after so many cycles; I'll want measurements.

Effective line: Assistants come home. Subjects too. Please, sit. This will only drain a little.
Suggested line: Assistants always come home, and so do subjects, it seems. Please, sit. This will only drain a little.

Effective line: You held the door, Dad. The night they killed the King and Queen. It's in your journal, in your own hand.
Suggested line: You held the door, Dad, the night they killed the King and Queen. It's in your journal, in your own hand.
